title: Mold Process Specialist 2nd Shift
description:
Airlite Plastics is a premier, privately held, family-owned manufacturer headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. Our family style and personal culture is what makes Airlite an amazing place to grow and build a successful career. Airlite’s company values of unquestionable integrity and respect and appreciation for each other are at the core of our success! These values set a strong foundation to build on where we can ‘wow’ our customers with innovative products and sustainable solutions, and continuously improve our processes and efficiencies.

Our product lines include rigid plastic containers and lids for food packaging and cosmetics, dry powder scoops, plastic drink cups, shipping containers, industrial strength insulated concrete forms (ICF) and sustainable permeable paving systems. As pioneers in our industry, focused on sustainable solutions, we strive to provide our customers with top-notch service and quality, which aligns with our award-winning products.

How would you contribute?

This role is a contributing member of Airlite Plastics team, located in Omaha, NE. As a Mold Specialist you are a key to continued growth and success of Airlite. This role is responsible for Setting up and operates high-speed injection molding machines by performing the following duties.

Essential Duties:

  • Is certified to run all molding-related equipment on one half (North or South) of the Traditional building.
  • Performs a daily “Beginning of Shift” audit of assigned area with outgoing Molding Specialist.
  • Performs machine start-up's and shut down's to required procedures.
  • Removes contamination from tip areas of molds to required procedures. Removes and replaces tips to required procedures.
  • Provides product acceptability information to packers after completion of machine adjustments and/or color changes.
  • Reviews production schedule, makes color and material changes during the shift in order to prevent overruns.
  • Reviews with area supervisor and/or quality assurance technicians the floor inspection and diameter size check reports and follows up on items needing technical corrections.
  • Performs quality inspections and documents product quality and color shades to assure product is within specifications.
  • Communicates with quality auditors and/or Lead Molding Specialist regarding questionable product and makes timely adjustments.
  • Monitors cycle times to required procedures.
  • Responsible for quality, scrap and machine efficiency in assigned area.
  • Maintains safety and housekeeping expectations, reports potential machine or work hazards, responds immediately to emergency machine problems, and insures the safety of co-workers within designated work area.
  • Communicates with other shifts about machine problems, quality problems, and changes in molding process and handling.
  • Assists in training and development of others.
  • Must have ability to perform duties in either Traditional or IML
  • Responsible for reporting food safety problems to management.
  • Meets safety, housekeeping and attendance expectations.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Do you have what it takes? Airlite Plastics is a versatile employer; complacency is not one of our strengths! We work hard each day to ensure that equipment efficiency and customer satisfaction never leave our line of sight. Successful candidates for the role will possess the following:

Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required:

  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Associate's degree (AA) or equivalent from two-year college or technical school;
  • Or one year to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals in English.
  • Ability to write routine reports in English. Ability to speak effectively with company employees and supervisors in English.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent.
  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.
  • Basic computer skills
  • Upholds and supports organizational goals and values.
  • Take the initiative to ask for and offer help when needed.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This job has no supervisory responsibilities

Physical Demands Work Environment:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to walk; climb or balance; and stoop and kneel. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is seasonally and moderately exposed to humid conditions and heat. The employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts, the risk of electrical shock and exposure to extreme molten plastic temperature. The employee is frequently exposed to height of 8-10 feet and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is loud.

Our Core Values Drive Us!

  • Do you conduct yourself with unquestionable integrity?
  • Do you demonstrate respect and appreciation for those around you?
  • Are you innovative and strive to challenge the status quo?
  • Do you strive for continuous improvement and to deliver the “wow” factor?
  • Do you care about environmentally sustainable solutions?
  • Do you take meaning and pride in a job well done?

What’s in it for you? As a Full-Time employee, you will be eligible for the following benefits:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance
  • Company paid life insurance
  • Company paid short term disability
  • Generous 401k match
  • Generous Time Off
  • Annual company activities

title: Construction Careers | Healthcare Project Manager, Superintendent, Assistant Superintendent (Jupiter, FL)
description:
CPPI OVERVIEW

Charles Perry Partners, Inc. (CPPI) is a leading general contracting, design-build, and construction management firm with regional offices in Gainesville, Jacksonville, Tampa, Orlando, Fort Myers, and Palm Beach. Since 1968, CPPI has built a strong reputation for delivering exceptional service and results across a broad spectrum of projects. Our mission is to build long-lasting relationships and structures.

JOB SUMMARY

Our Jupiter Operations Team is growing; we are seeking a Healthcare Project Manager, Superintendent, or Assistant Superintendent to join the team!


The Assistant Superintendent/ Superintendent assists the Senior Superintendent and Project Manager in all field-related activities essential to the successful completion of assigned construction projects. Responsibilities include ensuring job site safety, maintaining quality, managing costs, and communicating effectively with architects, consultants, and subcontractors. This role assists in scheduling, coordination, and oversight of daily construction activities while promoting the company’s vision, mission, and core values.



The Project Manager is responsible for managing one or multiple commercial construction projects. This role oversees all phases of project delivery, including budgeting, scheduling, contract administration, subcontractor coordination, quality control, and safety compliance. The Project Manager serves as the primary liaison between the owner, architect, consultants, subcontractors, and internal project teams, ensuring successful execution in alignment with CPPI’s standards and core values.


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation aligned with experience and qualifications.
  • Generous paid vacation and holidays.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  • Short-term and long-term disability plans.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

  • Authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.
  • High school diploma required; Bachelor’s Degree in Construction Management or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience as a Superintendent, Project Manager, or in a similar construction role.
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
  • Strong understanding of job site safety, planning, scheduling, and construction trades.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints and specifications.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite and Outlook.
  • Proven ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
  • Demonstrated commitment to a safety-first mindset.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES (Superintendent)

  • Assist with developing and maintaining project schedules, subcontracts, purchase orders, and project responsibilities.
  • Review and interpret project plans, blueprints, submittals, specifications, and applicable construction codes.
  • Assist with all phases of construction, from demolition through project completion.
  • Coordinate materials, inspections, permits, and field activities.
  • Work closely with Project Managers, Senior Superintendents, subcontractors, suppliers, owners, and project staff to maintain effective communication and coordination.
  • Provide administrative support and leadership to project staff and field personnel.
  • Assist with schedule updates, job cost tracking, labor cost analysis, and project reporting.
  • Review and track change orders, owner payments, and other project documentation.
  • Promote and enforce applicable safety policies, procedures, and training.
  • Assist with project closeout and ensure completion of required documentation.
  • Build and maintain positive, productive relationships with clients, subcontractors, vendors, and team members.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES (Project Manager)

  • Plan, organize, and manage project timelines, budgets, schedules, and contractual requirements.
  • Coordinate project teams and oversee project activities from preconstruction through completion.
  • Review and manage contracts, subcontracts, schedules, pay applications, and other project documentation.
  • Maintain working knowledge of local, state, and federal building codes and regulations.
  • Monitor construction schedules, identify potential issues, and implement corrective action as needed.
  • Coordinate the timely approval of submittals and identify long-lead materials and potential project impacts.
  • Manage owner and subcontractor change orders, invoices, payments, and Certified Payroll when applicable.
  • Facilitate project meetings, maintain accurate documentation, and ensure issues are addressed promptly.
  • Oversee quality control, safety, permitting, insurance, bonds, and compliance with company policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate project closeout, warranty, and post-occupancy activities.
  • Support preconstruction services and project delivery initiatives.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, subcontractors, vendors, and project team members.
  • Participate in ongoing training and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Ensure client needs and expectations are met or exceeded throughout project delivery.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Lastenvalvoja, Perheoikeudelliset palvelut
description:
Satakunnan hyvinvointialueella perhekeskus Lounatuulessa (Pori, Ulvila, Nakkila) on haettavana lastenvalvojan määräaikainen virka ajalle 2.11.2026 - 14.9.2027.

Lastenvalvojan työ sisältää ohjausta ja neuvontaa erotilanteissa ja perheoikeudellisiin kysymyksiin ja sopimuksiin liittyvissä asioissa. Lastenvalvoja vahvistaa vanhempien välisiä sopimuksia mm. lapsen huoltoon, asumiseen ja tapaamisoikeuteen sekä elatukseen liittyen. Satakunnan hyvinvointialueen perheoikeudellisissa palveluissa on kymmenen lastenvalvojaa, joten tukea on saatavilla työyhteisöstä.

Tehtävässä vaaditaan erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja, valmiutta ja ymmärrystä eroon liittyvistä perhetilanteista, perheoikeudesta/ sosiaalityöstä, lapsen edun arvioinnista sekä kokemusta perheiden kanssa tehtävästä työstä. Tehtävä edellyttää kykyä ja valmiutta itsenäiseen asiakastyöhön sekä hyviä työyhteisö- ja työelämätaitoja.

Lastenvalvojan tehtävässä voi toimia sosiaalityöntekijä tai henkilö, jolla on muu tehtävään soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto. (Sosiaalihuoltolaki 1301/2014, 27a § ja Laki sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä 817/2015, 7 §). Lisäksi edellytämme hyvää suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa.

Virkaan valitun tulee esittää nähtäväksi hyväksyttävä lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) 3§:n mukainen rikosrekisteriote ennen viran vastaanottamista.

Palvelussuhteen ehdot ja palkkaus määräytyvät SOTE-sopimuksen mukaan.
Virassa noudatetaan 5 kuukauden koeaikaa.

Hakemukset lähetetään ensisijaisesti sähköisesti työpaikkailmoitukselta löytyvän linkin kautta.

title: Sr. Worldwide Specialist Solutions Architect - Database, Data & AI
description:
Are you a builder that lives and breathes Oracle? Have you spent years tuning production workloads, diagnosing lock contention under heavy OLTP workloads, reasoning about query planner decisions, managing HA & DR solutions, and guiding large-scale migrations? Are you the person your organization turns to when Oracle system is misbehaving at 3 AM and when leadership needs a whiteboard session on where the data platform is headed next? As a Specialist Solutions Architect for RDS for Oracle and Oracle Database @AWS, you will be the technical authority that AWS's largest and most complex customers rely on to architect, migrate, and operate RDS Oracle workloads.

This is not a generalist database role. You will focus on RDS for Oracle and Oracle Database @AWS, going deep where others go broad. You will partner directly with customer engineers and CTOs to design well architected production architectures that hold up under real-world pressure and the operational patterns that distinguish battle-tested practitioners from those with only surface-level familiarity. You will have experience with multi-terabyte database migrations. You will collaborate closely with the RDS service team to surface customer patterns, escalate feature gaps, and drive the product roadmap on behalf of the customers you serve.

Equally important, you will operate as a thought leader and force multiplier across the broader Specialist SA organization, mentoring teammates, publishing technical content, presenting at AWS re:Invent and AWS Summits, and establishing repeatable frameworks that raise the bar for Oracle engagements worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the technical advisor for AWS's key customers running or migrating to RDS for Oracle and Oracle Database @AWS, providing hands-on architectural guidance from design through production operation.
• Guide customers on RDS operational best practices including performance & scaling, high availability & durability, monitoring & observability, maintenance & patching, backup & recovery, security and operational hygiene
• Design and validate RDS Oracle architectures that leverage RDS-specific capabilities, ensuring customers realize the full value of the platform.
• Partner with the RDS service team as the voice of the customer, surfacing recurring pain points, advocating for feature enhancements, and participating in roadmap reviews.
• Engage with customer engineers in whiteboard sessions, architecture reviews, and technical deep dives, providing candid guidance and pushing back diplomatically when a proposed design will not hold up at scale.
• Develop and publish technical thought leadership content including blogs, reference architectures, white papers, and re-usable artifacts, that elevate the broader Oracle community on AWS.
• Advise customers complex database migrations.
• Present at key industry events including AWS re:Invent, AWS Summits, Oracle AI World, and customer-facing workshops.
• Stay current with Oracle developments (new major versions, ecosystem, tooling) and translate those advancements into actionable guidance for AWS customers.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Asiakaspalveluassistentti, B2B
description:
Asiakaspalveluassistentti B2B-tiimiin

Viihdytkö asiakaspalvelun parissa ja tartutko asioihin oma-aloitteisesti? Haluaisitko päästä työskentelemään osana kehittyvää IT-alaa ja oppimaan samalla lisää kaupallisesta toimintaympäristöstä?

Etsimme nyt Tampereen toimistollemme asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja aktiivista asiakaspalveluassistenttia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen B2B-asiakaspalvelutiimiimme, joka on yksi meidän neljästä myyntitiimistä.

Millainen työ sinua odottaa?

Asiakaspalveluassistenttina toimit asiakkaidemme tukena päivittäisissä asioissa monikanavaisesti niin puhelimitse, sähköpostitse kuin chat-palvelun välityksellä. Vastaat asiakkaiden selvityspyyntöihin ja teet samalla tiivistä yhteistyötä muiden osastojemme, kuten tuotemarkkinoinnin ja kuljetustiimin, kanssa.

Työpäiviesi aikana muun muassa:

· palvelet B2B-asiakkaitamme eri kanavissa ja ratkot erilaisia tilanteita

· käsittelet myyntitilauksia ja seuraat toimituksia

· ylläpidät ja päivität asiakastietoja

· avustat myyntineuvottelijoitamme tarjousten tekemisessä

· kartoitat nykyisten asiakkaidemme ostotarpeita.

Tehtävä painottuu asiakaspalveluun ja työssä ollaan päivittäin yhteydessä asiakkaisiin, joten puhelintyöskentelyn pitäisi olla sinulle luontevaa. Pääset myös kehittämään kaupallista osaamistasi ja oppimaan, miten asiakkaiden tarpeisiin löydetään oikeat ratkaisut.

Millaista henkilöä etsimme?

Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva kaupallisen alan koulutus (esim. merkonomi tai tradenomi) tai kokemusta vastaavanlaisista assistentin tehtävistä.

Toivomme, että:

· sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja viihdyt asiakaspalvelutehtävissä

· olet oma-aloitteinen ja aktiivinen

· sinulla on osaamista tai kiinnostusta IT-alan tuotteisiin

· olet valmis hoitamaan asiakaspalvelutilanteita myös englanniksi

· sinulla on hyvät tietotekniset taidot ja hallitset esim. Excelin sujuvasti.

Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata ennestään, sillä tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen ja saat tueksesi kannustavat ja mukavat työkaverit. Ennen kaikkea arvostamme motivoitunutta ja toimeen tarttuvaa asennetta sekä ystävällistä ja huolellista työotetta myös kiiretilanteissa.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

Meillä työskentelet kannustavassa ja ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössä, jossa pääset tekemään yhteistyötä mielenkiintoisten kumppaneidemme kanssa. Tarjoamme sinulle erinomaisen mahdollisuuden kehittyä työssäsi ja työskennellä IT-alan uusimpien tuotteiden parissa sekä kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten liikunta- ja lounasedun.

Yhteinen intohimomme on auttaa asiakkaitamme saavuttamaan tavoitteensa ja toimia alamme parhaina asiantuntijoina.

Alkaako seuraava askel urallasi meiltä? Lähetä hakemuksesi sekä CV palkkatoiveineen keskiviikkoon 30.9.2026 mennessä hakuportaalimme kautta. Kerro meille, mikä tehtävässä herätti mielenkiintosi ja miten voisit meillä hyödyntää osaamistasi. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

title: Sacred Spaces Facilitator
description:
POSITION TITLE: Sacred Spaces Facilitator
DEPARTMENT: McGreal Center
REPORTS TO: Director
PRIMARY PURPOSE/POSITION SUMMARY

The Sacred Spaces project at Dominican University seeks to preserve and digitally archive architectural spaces of the Dominican family across the United States, and other culturally and religiously significant spaces in the Chicago area. This project takes an innovative approach to historic preservation by creating interactive 360 degree captures of significant sacred spaces using panorama and drone photography. The Sacred Spaces Facilitator will assist in all areas of the project including researching sites of interest, onsite digital capture, tour creation, web posting, and digital asset management. The Sacred Spaces Facilitator will join a small team at the McGreal Center for Dominican Historical Studies who all collaborate on planning, troubleshooting, and undertaking scholarly research for the project. Project examples can be found here:

JOB COMPONENTS/PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist in capturing digital footage of interiors and exteriors of sacred spaces using drones, panorama cameras, and phone cameras

  • Create digital tours of spaces using Pano2VR software to build panoramas and embed content

  • Create webpages for individual tours on WordPress site, including editing landing page video

  • Conduct research on individual spaces and communities, build scholarly bibliographies for website using Zotero

  • Assist in identifying new sites of interest, corresponding with representatives of communities

  • Assist Program Coordinator with developing digital preservation plan for generated assets

COMPETENCIES: (Required knowledge, skills, abilities)
  • Background and/or training in library science, programming, photography, history, and/or museums
  • Demonstrated interest in digital exhibitions or archives, digital humanities, and/or digital curation
  • Willingness to learn and troubleshoot complex VR software, camera equipment, and drone photography
  • Self-starting attitude
  • Comfort with troubleshooting, using software documentation to address issues
  • Interest in photography, architecture, and/or religious communities preferred

Preferred Software skills:

Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, Pano2VR, PTGui, WordPress
PHYSICAL DEMANDS
  • Ability to spend long durations of the workday sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times
SALARY AND FLSA STATUS
  • Salary: $25.00/hour
  • FLSA Status: Non-Exempt (Hourly, Part-time (15-20 hours per week)
BENEFITS
  • Professional development opportunities
This is a fully onsite position at the McGreal Center on at Dominican University’s River Forest campus, and will require some driving in Chicago area

This position is funded through May 2028 by a generous grant from the Driehaus Foundation.
Employment at Dominican University is contingent upon the successful completion of a background investigation.
About Dominican University
Dominican University is a Catholic, comprehensive teaching university located in River Forest, a suburb of Chicago, with an additional campus in the Pilsen neighborhood of Chicago. Accredited by the Higher Learning Commission, Dominican University offers associate, baccalaureate, master’s, and doctoral degrees. It is highly regarded for its academic rigor, thoughtful accompaniment of students, intentional affordability, and values-based, relationship-centered learning environment.
Dominican currently enrolls over 3,800 students, including 2,690 undergraduates and 1,114 graduate students. Sixty-eight percent (68%) of undergraduate students identify as Latinx, 5% as Black or African American, and 3% as Asian. Under-represented minority students comprise 77% of the undergraduate enrollment and 38% of the graduate enrollment. Over 90 percent of undergraduates receive some form of financial aid. Nearly half of all undergraduates are first-generation college students; over half are federal Pell Grant recipients, illustrating their families’ level of income; and 58% are eligible for low-income MAP grants from the State of Illinois.
Recognized since 2011 as a Hispanic-Serving Institution (HSI) by the U.S. Department of Education, Dominican is committed to expanding and enhancing educational opportunities for Latinx students and all students from historically underrepresented groups. For more information, visit .
Expectations for all Dominican Employees:
To support the University's mission of preparing students to pursue truth, give compassionate service, and participate in the creation of a more just and humane world, engage in university service work that promotes collaboration and community building. This includes participating in organizational initiatives, supporting campus events, contributing to community outreach, and fostering a diverse and inclusive environment through involvement in various staff-driven activities and groups.
Institutional Statement
Dominican University is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive academic community. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. Upon request, reasonable accommodations in the application process will be provided to individuals with disabilities.
Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
Dominican University is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and protected veterans.

title: Trainee Archaeologist - MILTON KEYNES
description:
Trainee Archaeologists


Milton Keynes


Salary £27,278



Fixed-term (six-month) contracts available, with immediate start dates.


Cotswold Archaeology is one of the largest and most respected archaeological practices in the country, employing over 380 professional staff and carrying out some of the most interesting, complex and largest archaeological and heritage projects across England and Wales.

We are seeking ,Experienced Archaeologists, Archaeologists and Trainees across all four of our offices to work on a range of exciting archaeological projects, spanning different time periods. With a strong ongoing program of fieldwork, we are looking for motivated, dedicated individuals to join our team.

Cotswold Archaeology has projects located in the vicinity of our offices, but for these roles there will be a requirement to be rostered on protracted away projects where we will provide accommodation and the opportunity to accrue lieu and overtime.

Where away work is required good quality accommodation will be provided, along with subsistence payments. (£24 per each night where eligible).

What we offer

Along with a starting salary above the CIfA minimum, we offer a highly competitive benefits package including:

  • 30 days annual leave (including statutory holidays) - please note that the annual leave allowance will be prorated for the duration of contract.
  • Defined contribution pension scheme
  • Life insurance scheme
  • Paid CIfA membership subscription (following qualifying period)
  • Company sick pay - prorated for the duration of contract.
  • A generous lieu scheme operated for all driving time, and time spent in excess of 45 minutes each way as a passenger, outside of the normal 7.5 hour working day (able to accumulate up to 10 days additional lieu time annually)
  • Overnight accommodation and subsistence when working on away projects.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and a network of mental health first aiders across the organisation.
  • Personal protective equipment

Please note all salaries quoted are annual equivalents based on a 37.5-hour week. We are unable to offer contracts with the provision of 7 day a week accommodated away work.

Membership of the CIfA at PCIfA level is desirable, as is possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or CSCS test pass. Although new CSCS cards are not currently being issued to the archaeological sector, successful applicants without a current and valid CSCS card or test pass, will be expected to pass the CITB HS&E Operatives Test, which will be arranged and paid for by CA.


A full manual driving licence is desirable.



The Details

Trainee Archaeologists £27,278

Like many of those that join our award-winning trainee archaeologist program you might be a recent graduate with a degree or masters in a relevant subject; you may have graduated some time ago but never realised your ambitions to enter the profession; or you may have no formal archaeology related qualifications but your passion and interest in the subject is attracting you to developing a career in the sector.

For a candidate without a formal degree, we would expect to see:

  • Exposure to a range of archaeological periods (e.g. prehistoric, Roman, medieval etc.)
  • Experience on multiple site types and contexts (urban, rural, eval etc.)
  • An understanding of core excavation methods including excavation methods, stratigraphy, recording and post-excavation
  • Evidence of working in varied outdoor conditions, which is part of the day-to-day realities of archaeological fieldwork.

Our trainee programme has been developed with the flexibility to accommodate a broad spectrum of educational ability and work experience. The training includes all the core skills required to be effective as an Archaeologist including excavation, drawing, photography and sampling.



How to apply



Please submit a CV and cover letter by visiting our careers page.

Closing date: Applications need to be submitted by 5pm Wednesday 30th September 2026



Cotswold Archaeology is an equal opportunities employer. All applications are assessed solely on the candidate’s relevant skills and experience relevant to the role.

We will take into consideration any reasonable adjustments required to support you. Should you need adjustments during the recruitment process, or require additional support related to neurodiversity or for any other reason, please let us know by contacting careers@cotswoldarchaeology.co.uk

Applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in the UK as defined by UK Visas and Immigration

title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Inference Runtime
description:
As a Software Engineer on our AI Inference Runtime team, you will set technical direction for critical components of distributed Inference runtime for running SOTA AI Models.

You will lead hands-on work across scheduling, batching, KV-cache management, memory allocation, distributed workload execution, kernel development and optimization, and performance benchmarking and analysis. Your work will directly influence how efficiently new models use available compute. Partnering with our AI Infrastructure, compute, and product teams to enhance the performance and efficiency of Arm’s AI platform.

Responsibilities:

  • Define the architecture, interfaces, and roadmap for AI inference runtime capabilities, including abstractions that support evolving models, workloads, and compute platforms.
  • Enable new model architectures end to end through operator support, production validation, and optimization of scheduling, batching, model execution, memory management, and KV-cache efficiency.
  • Profile system bottlenecks and develop optimized kernels and data-movement paths across compute, memory, networking, and framework integration.
  • Evaluate new inference techniques and build benchmarking, regression, validation, and safe-rollout systems to improve latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.
  • Partner with cloud, framework, compiler, hardware, and research teams; lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and establish meticulous performance-engineering practices.

Required Skills and Experience :

  • 5+ years of experience, or equivalent demonstrated impact, in ML systems, high-performance systems, compilers, kernel development, or production AI inference.
  • Deep understanding of modern AI inference, including model execution, Attention, MoE, batching, prioritisation, and KV-cache behavior.
  • Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, Python, or a comparable language, with knowledge of concurrency, parallel programming, handling of memory resources, and data movement.
  • Proven ability to profile, debug, and optimize performance across kernels, runtimes, frameworks, operating systems, and hardware.

“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :

  • Experience developing or modifying inference schedulers, cache managers, batching systems, disaggregated or distributed execution paths.
  • Experience optimizing kernels using accelerator programming tools, assembly, or intrinsics, including attention, matrix multiplication, operator fusion, and low-precision execution.
  • Familiarity with model parallelism, collective communication, high-performance networking, compilers, or graph optimization.
  • Contributions to open-source ML runtimes, frameworks, compilers, or kernel libraries.

In Return:

You will be part of our AI Platforms team - A driven and diverse group passionate about developing foundational production capabilities to support AI inference at Arm. We provide a collaborative setting where your ideas can come to life quickly. The success of our AI projects will be directly influenced by your work, crafting the company’s AI inference capabilities and defining and operating production inference workloads. This is an outstanding opportunity to work with world-class teams and contribute to groundbreaking advances in AI technology. Join us in building the next generation of AI inference infrastructure!

title: Associate Director, Packaging Technology Transfer Lead
description:
Are you ready to lead complex, global technology transfers that make a real difference to patients? As Associate Director, Packaging Tech Transfer Lead, you will drive the transfer of packaging technologies across AstraZeneca's diverse product portfolio, working with pioneering products and cross-functional teams around the world. This is a unique opportunity to influence strategic decisions, shape future ways of working, and deliver medicines safely and reliably to patients!

You will provide both strategic direction and hands-on leadership for the transfer of labelling, packaging, and device assembly processes across AstraZeneca’s internal manufacturing network and external manufacturing partners. You will work across development, transfer, launch, and lifecycle management activities, ensuring that transfers are delivered safely, compliantly, efficiently, and in line with Global CMC priorities.

Your role and accountabilities

In this role, you will:

  • Lead packaging technology transfers for vials, APFS, and autoinjector presentations across internal and external manufacturing sites.
  • Own end-to-end transfer activities, including labelling, secondary packaging, device assembly, documentation, readiness, and implementation.
  • Assess site capabilities and readiness, including equipment, process fit, capacity, technical maturity, materials, and operational risks.
  • Develop robust transfer plans in collaboration with Technical Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Device teams, Drug Product, Engineering, and external partners.
  • Ensure GMP and regulatory compliance by embedding quality, risk management, and inspection readiness into transfer activities.
  • Provide oversight of packaging process readiness, including line readiness, process validation considerations, comparability, material readiness, and transfer documentation.
  • Support device and combination product transfers, considering the interfaces between the primary container, device components, assembly operations, packaging configuration, and market requirements.
  • Consider drug product requirements and their impact on packaging configuration, handling, process conditions, product protection, and transfer strategy.
  • Contribute to shipping qualification and distribution readiness, including transport validation, distribution conditions, and product protection requirements.
  • Lead risk and issue management by identifying critical risks, defining mitigation plans, and calling out decisions when needed.
  • Influence strategic decisions related to transfer approach, site selection, execution priorities, and risk management.
  • Drive continuous improvement by simplifying, standardising, and improving packaging transfer processes, governance, and ways of working.
  • Champion digital enablement, including the use of Digital TT and other digital tools to improve visibility, data quality, knowledge management, and execution efficiency.
  • Lead through a matrix organisation, creating clarity, aligning stakeholders, and maintaining momentum across functions, sites, countries, and external partners.

Essential requirements

You will bring:

  • Significant experience (typically 5-10 years) within CMC, pharmaceutical packaging, technology transfer, manufacturing science and technology, technical operations, or a related field, supported by a Bachelor's or equivalent in a relevant scientific or engineering field.
  • Proven experience leading packaging technology transfers involving vials, APFS, autoinjectors, or similar presentations, with a strong understanding of labelling and packaging operations, device assembly where applicable, and associated transfer requirements.
  • Strong technical knowledge of GMP, quality systems, regulatory expectations, and manufacturing environments, including line readiness, validation, change control, process performance, material flows, and operational risk management.
  • Experience assessing manufacturing site capabilities and readiness, including technical fit, operational capacity, execution risk, and the successful planning and delivery of manufacturing transfers.
  • A solid understanding of drug product considerations relevant to packaging transfers, including the relationship between formulation, primary packaging, process conditions, product protection, shipping qualification, and distribution requirements.
  • Demonstrated leadership, influencing, and communication skills, with the ability to lead through ambiguity, engage stakeholders without direct authority, and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working across functions, cultures, geographies, and organisational boundaries to deliver business outcomes.
  • An improvement attitude with the ability to simplify processes, develop scalable ways of working, and embrace digital tools and digital ways of working, particularly Digital TT.

Desirable requirements

  • Experience with combination products, biologics packaging, or other complex pharmaceutical product environments, including device-related manufacturing and assembly operations.
  • Experience leading transfers across internal manufacturing sites and external contract manufacturing organisations, supporting global supply networks, product launches, and lifecycle change management.
  • Experience working with Global CMC teams and translating CMC priorities into practical transfer plans, supported by experience using digital technology transfer tools or similar systems to manage transfer activities, data, actions, and documentation.

Why AstraZeneca

We're driven by our commitment to deliver accelerated growth and to make people's lives better. We're always working towards our ambition to deliver more medicines to patients quicker and more affordably. If you have the passion and the strive to accelerate growth and make people's lives better, then this is the place for you

What’s next

Own the transfers that keep medicines on shelves and launches on time—send your CV to lead the next wave of digital, data-driven tech transfer excellence.

title: Lähihoitajia kotihoitoon Riihimäelle
description:
Haluaisitko keikkailla tai saada mahdollisesti vakityön kotihoidossa Riihimäellä? Työ sopii loistavasti esimerkiksi opintojen, toisen työn tai vaikkapa eläkepäivien oheen. Jos kotiin vietävät palvelut ovat sinun juttusi, niin kannattaa jatkaa lukemista!

Hoiva on meille henkilökohtainen asia

Toimintamme Riihimäellä on vakiintunutta ja tuotamme kotihoitoa alueella Oma-Hämeen ensisijaisena palveluntuottajana. Asiakasmäärän kasvaessa etsimme joukkoomme uusia koskihoivalaisia. Asiakkaamme ovat ikäihmisiä ja vammaisia henkilöitä, jotka asuvat omissa kodeissaan kotihoidon ja muiden palveluiden turvin. Pääset tekemään kotihoitoa monipuolisesti sen verran, mitä elämäntilanteeseesi juuri nyt sopii. Työvuorot meillä ovat normaalisti välillä 7-22 viikon jokaisena päivänä. Päivittäisessä työssä käytämme Hilkka-mobiilia.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Sinulla tulisi olla lähihoitajan tutkinto tai 2/3 opinnoista suoritettuna ja tartuntatautilain 48 § mukainen rokotussuoja.
- Työssäsi tarvitset ajokorttia ja hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.
- Toivomme sinun olevan positiivinen tiimipelaajaa, mutta tarpeeksi rohkea työskentelemään itsenäisesti asiakkaan kotona. Tavoitteemme on joka päivä erinomainen asiakaspalvelukokemus, johon odotamme kaikkien meillä työskentelevien sitoutuvan.
- Voimassaolevat lääketentit ovat eduksi, mutta eivät välttämättömiä - koulutukset on mahdollista käydä myös työn ohessa.

Meillä sinua kuunnellaan

- Työtyytyväisyys on meillä tutkitusti korkea. Koskihoivalaiset kokevat, että työtä arvostetaan ja erityisen tyytyväisiä ollaan toiveiden huomiointiin työvuorosuunnittelussa.
- KoskiHoivaan luotetaan. Meidät on valittu ensisijaiseksi palveluntuottajaksi Forssassa.
- "Työkotimme" sijaitsee Riihimäen keskustassa.
- Tarjoamme liikunta- ja hyvinvointiseteleitä työsopimuksestasi riippuen 50-200 € vuodessa, jotka toivomme sinun käyttävän oman hyvinvointisi tukemiseen.
- Käytössäsi on auto työpäivän ajaksi.
- Viimeisenä, mutta ehkä tärkeimpänä; koko tiimimme tuki on heti saatavilla ja meillä on käytössämme sisäinen viestiryhmä. Myös esihenkilösi on yhden puhelun päässä. Me olemme #koskihoivalaiset.

Noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta ja palkkasi sijoittuu kokemuksestasi riippuen välille 15,29€/h-16,69 €/h + vuorolisät.

tiimivastaava Jenna Sova vastaa mielellään kysymyksiin sähköpostitse jenna.sova@koskihoiva.fi. Olemme sinuun yhteydessä heti, kun hakemuksesi kilahtaa postiimme, joten haethan pian. Tervetuloa koskihoivalaiseksi! <3

Olemme 100 % kotimainen ja moderni hoivapalveluyritys, joka tuottaa kotiin vietäviä palveluita eri ikäisille asiakkaillemme Kanta-Hämeessä, Pirkanmaalla ja Uudellamaalla. Lisätietoa meistä löydät [www.koskihoiva.fi](https://www.koskihoiva.fi/). Löydymme myös Facebookista ja Instagramista.

title: Intermediate / Sr. Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineer - HYBRID
description:
AEM (Advanced Environmental Monitoring) is the global leader in innovative mission critical weather, wildfire and water monitoring and intelligence solutions. We aim to be the world’s essential source for environmental insights – enabling decisive action and positive outcomes for our customers and their constituents. Our family of innovators offers world-class hydrometeorological technologies and services, including sensors, dataloggers, telemetry, and advanced analytics and software. Our technology and services empower the communities and organizations to survive – and thrive – in the face of escalating environmental risks.


Van Essen Instruments, an AEM brand, was founded in 1938 by Cornelis van Essen in Delft, Netherlands. In the early 1990s, Van Essen began to offer standard water related equipment such as standalone dataloggers, which used external sensors and flow meters for open channels. We also offer telemetric solutions. Since the deployment of the first Diver, Van Essen sold over 200,000 dataloggers worldwide. Its commitment to quality and performance has established Van Essen Instruments as one of the premier brands in the industry. Van Essen has its headquarters in the Netherlands (Delft), and sales locations in Canada and the US. For more information, please visit .


We're looking for a hands-on engineer to take ownership of firmware and embedded systems work across our connected device portfolio — from initial concept through production-ready, certified products. You'll work across hardware, firmware, mechanical design, and cloud connectivity, and you'll be the technical anchor ensuring our products are secure, compliant, and manufacturable. You'll also act as the primary technical liaison between Van Essen (Delft) and our sister site, Lambrecht Meteo (Göttingen, Germany), on hardware, testing, security, and certification alignment.


This role suits an engineer who likes working across disciplines rather than staying in one lane — someone equally comfortable reviewing a schematic, writing firmware, debugging a prototype on the bench, and walking a certification body through a security design.


Job Responsibilities:


Firmware & Embedded Systems

  • Own firmware design, implementation, and maintenance across our connected device portfolio — bootloaders, data acquisition, telemetry interfaces, and OTA update mechanisms.
  • Conduct board bring-up, debugging, and hardware validation for new and existing products.
  • Integrate cryptographic mechanisms (AES, ECC) and evaluate the transition to certificate-based authentication and mutual TLS (mTLS) for end-to-end device security.
  • Review electrical schematics and mechanical designs, providing system-level input so hardware, firmware, and cloud connectivity work together correctly in the finished product.

Product Delivery, Prototyping & Production

  • Guide products from concept through design, testing, and production, determining the engineering work needed and coordinating it across disciplines.
  • Build, test, and debug prototypes during product development.
  • Support the transition from prototype to production and help resolve manufacturing issues, working directly with contract manufacturers and production partners.
  • Provide sustaining engineering support for products already in production or in the field.
  • Lead technical design reviews and help resolve engineering issues across hardware, firmware, and mechanical design.

Compliance & Certification

  • Ensure firmware and product designs meet European cybersecurity and radio regulations, including RED (2014/53/EU) and NIS2.
  • Lead the technical work required for product certification, working with internal regulatory experts and external certification bodies.
  • Support QA and compliance documentation to meet regulatory expectations.

Collaboration

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact between Van Essen Instruments (Delft) and Lambrecht Meteo (Göttingen) on hardware, testing, security, and certification alignment.
  • Maintain firmware repositories and release processes using CI/CD practices (e.g., GitHub Enterprise).
  • Coordinate with product management, hardware engineering, and compliance teams on requirements, schedules, and deliverables.

Andover

title: Academic Counselor
company: Unity Preparatory Charter School of Brooklyn
description:
Counselor of College and Career Readiness

Unity Preparatory Charter School of Brooklyn - High School Reports to: Director of Academic Counseling

The Role

The Counselor of College and Career Readiness (CCR) leads Unity's post-secondary preparation program. This person counsels seniors through their post-secondary plans, teaches the 12th-grade College and Career Readiness course, supports CCR events and culture initiatives, and helps students build the knowledge, habits, and experiences to pursue college, career, and other post-secondary pathways. The work is grounded in David T. Conley's "Think, Know, Act, Go" framework and in Unity's mission: empowering students as scholars and citizens so they may lead fulfilling academic, personal, and professional lives.

About Unity

Unity Preparatory Charter School of Brooklyn is an independent charter school serving central Brooklyn. Now in our fourteenth year, we serve approximately 250 students in grades 6-12 across a middle school and a high school.

Our inaugural class graduated in 2020 at a rate of 98%, and subsequent cohorts have graduated at rates above 90%. Unity alumni continue to outperform their peers in post-secondary matriculation, retention, and persistence. See our results at unityprep.org.

We offer a rigorous liberal arts and sciences program built by teachers who design curriculum for our specific students, an extended school day and year, differentiated academic support, and a growing set of enrichment and real-world learning opportunities. We believe students rise to the expectations placed upon them, that diversity strengthens learning, that strong teaching is the central lever for student growth, and that a positive school culture rooted in our Core Values - Awareness, Initiative, Courage, Inquiry, Kindness, and Integrity - is powerful. We assess students beyond standardized exams, including annual Roundtable portfolio presentations.

Responsibilities

Post-Secondary Counseling

  • Counsel the senior class (~60-80 students), ensuring every student has a formal post-secondary plan and maintaining case notes
  • Conduct quarterly outreach to families on plans, applications, deadlines, and key notifications
  • Advocate for Unity students with post-secondary institutions and assess the quality of student-program matches

Teaching and Curriculum

  • Teach the 12th-grade College and Career Readiness course; develop and update curricula as needed
  • Assess student mastery of academic habits, life skills, and executive functioning skills

Program and Data Management

  • Manage experiential learning opportunities (internships, job shadows, part-time employment)
  • Track performance metrics for all post-secondary initiatives against national and subgroup benchmarks
  • Create and present data reports for families, the board, and school leadership

Events and School Culture

  • Support CCR school-culture initiatives, including in-school displays and website updates
  • Support student and family workshops: post-secondary pathways, applications, financial aid, essay writing, scholarships, and information sessions on niche options (e.g., Opportunity Programs, trade schools)
  • Support college fairs (two per year), the annual career fair, college representative visits, College Signing Day, and Senior Roundtable presentations
  • Co-coordinate grade-level college trips (at least one per year, grades 9-12)

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated commitment to Unity's mission and philosophy
  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's in education or a related field preferred
  • At least 1 year of college and/or career counseling experience (or comparable), including expertise in non-college post-secondary options, college access programming, financial aid, and admissions
  • At least 2 years of high school or college teaching experience
  • Track record of program development and management in a fast-paced environment
  • Expertise in developing resilience and leadership in low-income and/or minority students and families
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, networking, and collaboration skills; strong interpersonal skills with students, families, colleagues, and community partners
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail
  • Openness to feedback and a commitment to continuous professional growth
  • Maturity, humility, versatility, a solution-oriented mindset, a strong work ethic, and a sense of humor
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, MS Office, and college/career platforms (e.g., Naviance, SCOIR)
  • Bilingual Spanish/English highly desirable

To Apply

Visit unityprep.org/careers to submit a cover letter and resume.

Unity Preparatory Charter School of Brooklyn is an equal opportunity employer and hires without regard to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, or disability.

title: Senior MongoDB Database Engineer 3668459 (New York City, NY)
description:

Join a global financial services organization supporting a specialized capital markets technology environment where reliability, security, and data integrity are critical. This team is focused on strengthening enterprise database platforms through modernization, operational resilience, and security governance. The role will contribute to key MongoDB initiatives spanning platform upgrades, migrations, backup and recovery, automation, and security hardening.

  • Contribute directly to MongoDB modernization, migration, operational improvement, and security initiatives.

How You Will Make An Impact

title: Archaeologist - NEEDHAM MARKET
description:
Archaeologists


Needham Market ( please note the office will be relocating to Stow Market later this year)



Salary £28,532 - £29,255



Fixed-term (six-month) contracts available, with immediate start dates.


Cotswold Archaeology is one of the largest and most respected archaeological practices in the country, employing over 380 professional staff and carrying out some of the most interesting, complex and largest archaeological and heritage projects across England and Wales.

We are seeking ,Experienced Archaeologists, Archaeologists and Trainees across all four of our offices to work on a range of exciting archaeological projects, spanning different time periods. With a strong ongoing program of fieldwork, we are looking for motivated, dedicated individuals to join our team.

Cotswold Archaeology has projects located in the vicinity of our offices, but for these roles there will be a requirement to be rostered on protracted away projects where we will provide accommodation and the opportunity to accrue lieu and overtime.

Where away work is required good quality accommodation will be provided, along with subsistence payments. (£24 per each night where eligible).

Archaeologists £28,532 - £29,255 Dependent on Experience

Please submit a CV and cover letter by visiting our careers page.

2026



Cotswold Archaeology is an equal opportunities employer. All applications are assessed solely on the candidate’s relevant skills and experience relevant to the role.

title: Health Resource Specialist
description:
The Wisconsin Women’s Health Foundation (WWHF) is a mid-size nonprofit with a 25+ year history of improving health and well-being across Wisconsin. We are seeking a professional to join our Well Badger Resource Center team, a program of WWHF.


The Well Badger Resource Center is Wisconsin’s health information and referral service, helping people find and connect with health, social service, and government programs in their communities. Our team provides personalized support to people across Wisconsin through phone, text, email, chat, and other communication channels. Community members and professionals can also search the Well Badger Online Directory on their own to find resources and services across Wisconsin.



About the Position

The Specialist will primarily serve as an Information and Referral (I&R) Specialist, working directly with individuals and families to understand their needs, identify appropriate resources, and help them take the next step toward accessing services.


This is a people-centered role that combines problem-solving, resource knowledge, communication, and technology. Specialists listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions, research options, and provide information in a clear and respectful way. No two conversations are exactly alike, and the ability to stay curious and resourceful is essential.

The Specialist will also support Well Badger’s Resource Management team as needed, helping maintain the information in the Well Badger Online Directory. This may include verifying resource information, researching programs and services, reviewing listings for accuracy, and helping ensure that the information available to the public is accurate and up to date.


The ideal candidate will have experience working with pregnant and parenting individuals, children and youth with special healthcare needs, and/or low-income individuals and families, as well as an understanding of the barriers people may face when accessing health and social services.



What You’ll Do


Information & Referral Services

  • Provide personalized information and referral support through phone, text, email, chat, and other communication channels.
  • Conduct real-time, client-focused assessments to understand each person’s needs, provide education, and offer informed choices about available resources.
  • Research health, social service, and community resources using the Well Badger Online Directory and other reliable sources.
  • Help individuals understand their options and take the next steps to access and connect with services.
  • Communicate with service providers as needed to gather information, clarify available services, and support effective referrals.
  • Conduct follow-up with individuals to check in on their progress, confirm they received the help they needed, and provide additional support or referrals when appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of interactions and referrals using Salesforce and other online systems.
  • Offer satisfaction surveys to people who use Well Badger services.
  • Participate in case discussions, case briefings, and team meetings to collaborate on complex or challenging situations and share information with colleagues.
  • Work collaboratively and flexibly with team members to ensure coverage during Well Badger’s hours of operation.


Resource Management

  • Support the Resource Management team as needed in maintaining and updating information in the Well Badger Online Directory.
  • Contact organizations to verify information about their programs and services and research new or updated resources.
  • Review resource information for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Assist with Online Directory and website projects as needed.
  • Provide feedback and recommendations to improve the quality and usefulness of Well Badger’s resource information.


Program, Organizational & Professional Engagement

  • Participate in internal staff meetings, supervisor check-ins, quality assurance activities, training, and professional development.
  • Stay informed about health and social service programs, community resources, and changes that may affect the people we serve.
  • Build and maintain respectful relationships with service providers and community partners throughout Wisconsin.
  • Participate in network and partner meetings, conferences, and outreach events throughout the region as needed.
  • Assist with the development of program tools, materials, and other resources.
  • Provide feedback and recommendations that support program development and continuous quality improvement.
  • Contribute to special projects and other program needs as assigned.



What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is curious, compassionate, resourceful, and comfortable navigating complex information. You enjoy helping people solve problems and can remain calm, focused, and respectful when needs are complex or conversations are challenging.


Successful candidates will demonstrate:

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to listen without judgment, communicate clearly, and treat people with dignity and respect.
  • Strong judgment, problem-solving, and research skills, with the ability to understand complex needs, navigate information, and identify appropriate resources.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate information, and follow through on responsibilities.
  • Independence and initiative, with the ability to work effectively with minimal supervision while contributing as a collaborative team member.
  • Technology skills and adaptability, including the ability to learn and navigate databases and other technology systems, maintain confidentiality, and learn about health and social service programs and resources.



Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate degree, bachelor’s degree, relevant professional certification, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience in health, human services, social services, education, counseling, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in patient care, case management, information and referral, care navigation, health education, counseling, community services, or another health or social service-related field.
  • Ability to work set hours Monday through Friday during Well Badger’s hours of operation. This is an hourly position.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain Certified Resource Specialist (CRS) certification within 12 months of hire. Certification and related training will be paid for by WWHF.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Fluency in Spanish.
  • Experience working with Well Badger’s priority populations, including pregnant and parenting individuals, children and youth with special healthcare needs, and low-income individuals and families.
  • More than five years of experience in health or social services.
  • Experience with database navigation, documentation, or data-entry software.
  • Experience providing information and referral, case management, care navigation, health education, or similar client-centered services.
  • Familiarity with health and social service resources and systems in Wisconsin.



Why Join WWHF?

At WWHF, we believe everyone deserves access to the information, resources, and support they need to be healthy and well. Well Badger is often a first-place people turn when they don’t know where to start, and our team helps make that next step easier.

You’ll join a knowledgeable, collaborative team doing meaningful work that reaches people across Wisconsin. This role offers the opportunity to make a difference directly with the people we serve while also contributing to the systems and resources that make that support possible.

For eligible employees, WWHF offers a competitive paid time off and benefits package, including Medical Insurance (no waiting period), Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending, Disability, and Life Insurance with top-tier providers. WWHF also offers a 401(k) plan with an employer match that vests immediately.

title: Medication Coordinator - Bloomfield, PA
description:
Medication Coordinator | Part-Time | Bloomfield, PA


Help Patients Access the Care They Need

We are seeking a Medication Coordinator to serve as the bridge between our partner clinic and Altruix Pharmacy. In this vital onsite role, you'll build relationships with clinic staff, assist individuals with their medications and insurance, and promote Altruix's pharmacy services. Your work will help ensure patients receive the support and medication management they need to thrive.


This is a part-time, onsite position with the following schedule: Tuesday, 10:00 AM–3:00 PM; Wednesday, 10:00 AM–3:30 PM; Thursday, 11:00 AM–3:30 PM; and Friday, 10:00 AM–3:00 PM.


Each morning, you'll report to the Crossroads Treatment Center of Bloomfield (4105-07 Penn Ave., First Floor Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania 15224) to support patients and clinic staff throughout the day.


This role also offers a unique opportunity to grow your career in pharmacy. Employees hired as Medication Coordinators will be expected to obtain their Pennsylvania Pharmacy Technician Registration. Altruix will provide and pay for the required Pharmacy Technician training and registration process. Once registered, employees may have the opportunity to transition into a Pharmacy Technician role with expanded responsibilities and increased compensation.


If you're passionate about helping others, enjoy building relationships, and are looking for a company that invests in your professional growth, we'd love to hear from you.


What You'll Do

  • Serve as the onsite liaison between Crossroads Treatment Center and Altruix Pharmacy.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clinic staff and individuals receiving care.
  • Educate clinic staff and patients on Altruix's pharmacy services and support offerings.
  • Recruit and enroll patients into Altruix Pharmacy by collecting enrollment forms and insurance information.
  • Collect prescriptions and facilitate timely transmission to the pharmacy.
  • Ensure patient insurance information is current and accurately maintained.
  • Support patients with medication-related questions by coordinating communication with pharmacists.
  • Assist with prior authorizations, insurance issues, and patient assistance programs.
  • Monitor medication compliance through regular patient outreach (at least monthly).
  • Manage prescription refills by monitoring reports and coordinating with prescribers.
  • Assist with medication deliveries when permitted by state regulations.
  • Check medication storage areas and monitor medication expiration dates for both personal and house account medications.
  • Identify medication discrepancies, dose changes, or discontinued medications and communicate concerns appropriately.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


Career Growth Opportunity

At Altruix, we believe in investing in our employees. As a Medication Coordinator, you'll have the opportunity to begin your pharmacy career through our company-sponsored Pharmacy Technician training program.


We will provide and pay for the training and support needed to obtain your Pennsylvania Pharmacy Technician Registration. After successfully obtaining your registration, you'll have the opportunity to transition into a Pharmacy Technician position with expanded responsibilities and a corresponding increase in compensation.


Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of six (6) months of healthcare, behavioral health, customer service, or related experience.
  • Experience working in behavioral health or mental health settings preferred.
  • Sales, outreach, or marketing experience strongly preferred.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with insurance information and healthcare documentation.
  • Willingness to obtain a Pennsylvania Pharmacy Technician Registration through Altruix's company-sponsored training program.
  • Reliable transportation and the ability to travel daily to the Crossroads Treatment Center of Bloomfield, PA using your personal vehicle.
  • Ability to work independently while providing exceptional customer service.


Benefits

  • 401(k).
  • Company-paid Pharmacy Technician training and Pennsylvania Pharmacy Technician Registration.
  • Career advancement opportunities within a growing specialty pharmacy organization.


Join Our Team

If you're looking for a career where you can make a meaningful impact, build lasting relationships with patients and providers, and grow into a Pharmacy Technician role, we'd love to hear from you.


Apply today and help us improve lives—one patient at a time.


Altruix is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all employees. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of pre-employment drug and alcohol screening.


Position Highlights

  • Tuesday–Friday
  • Company-paid Pharmacy Technician training and registration
  • Clear career path into a Pharmacy Technician position

title: Physical SOC Analyst, AWS Security
description:
⚠️ Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance, with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. For more information visit (www.agsva.gov.au.)

You’ve found an opportunity that could define your next chapter.

The Mission — Why This Program, Why Now?
Amazon Web Services is a dynamic and rapidly growing business within Amazon.com. We provide a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. We provide organisations with building block web services that allow them to innovate faster and operate their software more cost-effectively. The AWS team is building and delivering the next generation of cloud computing that supports public AWS offerings like S3, EC2, and CloudFront. We are innovating new ways of building massively scalable distributed systems.

The team you're joining is growing, and the decisions being made now will shape how we operate for years to come.

Your Role

Imagine being the first line of defence for AWS infrastructure. As an AWS Incident Response Team (IRT) Analyst within the Physical Security Operations Centre (PSOC), you'll be the vigilant eyes and decisive mind protecting the physical backbone.

This isn't passive monitoring - this is active, intelligent security operations where your judgment directly safeguards our assets. You'll respond to physical security events in real time, coordinate contracted guard forces, administer access control systems, and gather intelligence that keeps our people, operations, and infrastructure safe.

Every shift brings new challenges. Every decision you make matters. And every improvement you identify raises the security bar for an organisation that refuses to stand still.

Why This Team, Why Now?

You're joining a developing team of physical security professionals who are building something extraordinary. The PSOC is where operational excellence meets purpose - where your customer service instincts, your communication skills, and your security expertise converge to protect what matters most. Whether your background is in security operations centres, dispatch, military, or law enforcement, your experience has prepared you for this moment.

This is where careers accelerate, where diverse paths are celebrated, and where the appetite to continuously improve isn't just welcomed - it's essential.

Shift work will be a requirement for this role.

Key job responsibilities
You'll be the operational heartbeat of the PSOC - the person who turns protocols into protection and intelligence into action.

Protecting AWS Infrastructure

Your core mission is incident response. When physical security events affect AWS infrastructure, associates, or operations, you're the one who assesses, escalates, and resolves. You'll monitor physical access control systems, administer access permissions, and ensure only authorised personnel access our spaces.

Coordinating the Security Ecosystem

You'll oversee contracted guard forces, ensuring they operate to AWS standards. Your intelligence gathering will keep teams informed and prepared. When something changes in the threat landscape, you'll connect the dots and distribute relevant information.

Building the Playbook

You won't just follow Standard Operating Procedures - you'll develop them. Your frontline experience will shape how the PSOC operates, creating frameworks that future team members will rely on.

Keeping Operations Moving

From triaging trouble tickets to managing communications, you'll be the connective tissue between security operations and the broader AWS organisation. You'll handle incoming queries with professionalism, provide technical support to internal stakeholders, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

Every interaction is an opportunity to demonstrate the customer obsession that defines Amazon - and every process you improve raises the bar.

At a Glance — Core Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
• Physical access control administration
• Monitor physical security systems
• Monitor and coordinate a contracted guard force
• Incident response — assess, escalate, and resolve physical security events
• Intelligence gathering and distributing program-wide notifications
• Manage internal and external email and phone communications
• Triage trouble tickets and handle incoming queries
• Provide technical support to internal stakeholders

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Benefits
Learning & Development
AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.

Health, Income Protection & Life Cover
Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you.

Military Differential Pay
Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving.

Employee Assistance Program
Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family — mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.

Family-Building Benefit
Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching.

Amazon Extras & Employee Discount
Cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

title: Program Manager
