Role Purpose:
The Program Manager will support the State Lead in the effective implementation and scale-up of Quest Alliance’s education program in Odisha. The role will work closely with the state and district teams to translate the state strategy into actionable plans, ensure quality implementation across districts, and strengthen engagement with government and implementation partners.
The role will support program planning, capacity building, monitoring and review processes, government coordination, documentation and team development. The Program Manager will also contribute to strengthening the integration of future skills, including digital, computational and life and career skills, within the government school ecosystem.
The role will work closely with state and district government stakeholders, CSOs and other partners to ensure timely implementation, resolve operational challenges and contribute to building sustainable government ownership of the program.

Role Description
1. Strategic Support and Program Planning
Support the State Lead in translating the Odisha state strategy into annual and quarterly implementation plans across districts.
Contribute to the development of program strategies, work plans, concept notes, presentations and proposals based on emerging needs and opportunities in Odisha.
Support alignment of program plans with state education priorities, government frameworks and relevant policy directions, including NEP and the State Curriculum Framework.
Identify opportunities for innovation, convergence and scale within the education ecosystem.
Contribute to strengthening CSO and partner engagement strategies in consultation with the State Lead.

2. Program Implementation and Operational Planning
Coordinate and support timely implementation of program plans across districts, ensuring agreed deliverables and milestones are met.
Work closely with Coordinators and district teams to develop field plans and ensure effective execution.
Undertake regular field visits to understand implementation realities, provide on-ground support and strengthen the quality of program delivery.
Support and, where required, facilitate trainings, workshops, review meetings and planning processes with teachers, government officials and field teams.
Support the team in identifying implementation challenges and developing practical solutions and innovations.
Ensure that program approaches and resources are contextualised to the needs of districts and government schools in Odisha.
Work with relevant state teams to strengthen the integration of digital, computational, life and career skills and other program themes within the school ecosystem.

3. Program Monitoring, Data and Reviews
Ensure that program implementation, field visits, achievements and challenges are appropriately documented in monitoring systems.
Support the team to regularly analyse program data and use evidence to inform planning and implementation decisions.
Facilitate monthly and quarterly reviews with district teams and support the State Lead in state-level reviews.
Track progress against program milestones, identify gaps and follow up on agreed actions.
Support the preparation of program dashboards, updates and analysis for internal and external stakeholders.
Contribute to identifying trends, learnings and evidence from implementation that can inform program strategy and government engagement.

4. Government and Partner Engagement
Support the State Lead in maintaining effective relationships with state and district government stakeholders.
Manage regular coordination with identified government POCs to facilitate approvals, reviews, reporting and implementation requirements.
Coordinate with relevant government departments like School & Mass Education Department, Pancha Sikhya Setu Sangathan, OSEPA, Directorate of Higher Secondary Education, Skill Development & Technical Education Department and district officials to support program implementation and capacity-building initiatives.
Support preparation and participation in government reviews, workshops, consultations and relevant forums.
Ensure that government stakeholders are regularly updated on program progress, achievements and emerging issues.
Identify opportunities for convergence with government initiatives and other organisations working in the education ecosystem.
Support identification of relevant CSOs and potential partners at the district level and explore opportunities for collaboration.

5. Reporting, Documentation and Budget Support
Ensure timely submission of program reports, case studies, success stories and other documentation as per organisational requirements.
Support preparation of reports and program updates for government, donors and internal stakeholders.
Capture and document implementation learnings, innovations and evidence from the field.
Support state-level budget planning, expenditure tracking and periodic review of budget utilisation.
Ensure that program expenditure is aligned with approved plans and organisational processes.
Support the State Lead and relevant teams in providing timely financial and program information.

6. Team Support and Development
Provide regular guidance and support to Coordinators and district teams in planning, implementation and problem-solving.
Support team members in setting clear objectives, tracking progress and identifying professional development needs.
Mentor and coach team members to strengthen their program management and facilitation capabilities.
Support capacity-building initiatives for the field team based on emerging needs.
Facilitate effective communication and coordination between the state and district teams.
Promote a culture of reflection, learning, experimentation and accountability within the team.
Support adherence to organisational policies, processes and standards.

Required Skills and Experience
7–8 years of relevant experience in implementing and managing education programs, preferably within government secondary and higher-secondary school systems.
Experience of managing multi-district programs and working with field teams.
Understanding of blended learning, digital literacy, computational thinking/coding, STEM and/or life and career skills for school students.
Experience of facilitating training, workshops and review processes with teachers, government officials and other education stakeholders.
Experience working with state and district government systems and education departments.
Strong understanding of the Indian education ecosystem, with knowledge of NEP and the Odisha education context preferred.
Ability to use program data and evidence to inform planning, reviews and decision-making.
Strong interpersonal, facilitation, written and verbal communication skills in English and Odia.
Strong documentation, presentation and IT skills.
Ability to independently manage multiple workstreams while working collaboratively with state and district teams.
Willingness to travel extensively across Odisha.
Ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders and navigate complex implementation environments.

title: GIS Project Manager
description:

Point 9 Trailside Eatery is looking for a dependable and guest-focused Shift Supervisor / Lead to help oversee evening operations and ensure every guest has an exceptional experience.

  • Serve as the primary leadership presence during assigned shifts.
  • Make sure guests are welcomed, cared for, and having a positive experience.

  • Calm and professional under pressure.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to take initiative and make sound decisions independently.
  • Team-oriented attitude with a genuine commitment to excellent guest service.

The Shift Supervisor / Lead is focused on leading the shift and taking care of the guest experience.

Bring your leadership, reliability, and passion for hospitality to Point 9 Trailside Eatery.

title: Enterprise Strategy Partner – Evinova
description:
Enterprise Strategy Partner – Evinova

UK Field based

Competitive salary and benefits

Introduction to role

Are you ready to be part of the future of healthcare? At Evinvoa, we pride ourselves on encouraging a culture that champions knowledge-sharing, ambitious thinking, and innovation. As an Enterprise Strategy Partner at Evinova, a fully-owned subsidiary of AstraZeneca Group, you will have the opportunity to transform patients' lives through technology, data, and innovative ways of working. Join us in launching groundbreaking digital solutions that improve patient experiences and deliver better health outcomes. Can you think big, be bold, and harness the power of digital and AI to tackle longstanding life sciences challenges? Then Evinova might be for you!

Accountabilities

As an Enterprise Strategy Partner , you will take on a leadership role in identifying, leading, and implementing strategies that drive sales opportunities and secure contracts with major pharmaceutical companies. Your primary focus will be to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities while developing consultative critical initiatives that position Evinova as a trusted partner in digital clinical solutions employing both SaaS and service delivery models. This role demands an entrepreneurial attitude, with the ability to proactively create sales strategies and business plans that address market gaps and deliver transformational value through innovative Evinova offerings.

Essential Skills/Experience

-Significant experience in management consulting or healthcare consulting, with a strong focus on commercially focused strategies that drive new business. Proven track record of delivering results in a client-facing role.

-Significant experience in managing complex enterprise relationships at executive level, leading account planning and leveraging internal and external stakeholders to win new business

- Sales & P&L Management: Demonstrated success in driving sales and revenue growth and expansion. Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets

Managing P&L responsibilities for each assigned account, including pricing strategy and margin optimization.

- Strategic Eye For Business: Expertise in developing and implementing strategic business plans that align with organizational goals and drive market growth. Development of strategic account plans with stakeholder mapping to drive Evinova share of wallet

- Digital Health Expertise: In-depth knowledge of digital health technologies, including Enterprise SaaS platforms, ePRO/eCOA, remote monitoring solutions, and patient engagement platforms.

- Experience in evaluating and implementing these solutions in clinical settings across different stakeholders and understands and drive change management implementation to support user adoption.

- Financial Modeling & Value Realization: Strong capability in financial modeling, including benefits quantification and post-implementation value tracking.- Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with ICH-GCP, GxP, and other regulatory guidelines applicable to digital health solutions.- Leadership & Communication Skills: Exceptional partner management and executive communication skills, with a proven ability to influence senior collaborators and lead cross-functional teams.- Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in life sciences, engineering, data science, or a related field; advanced degree (MS, MPH, PhD, PharmD, MBA) preferred.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

title: Associate Director, Analytics Consulting (Retail)
description:
Tiger Analytics is an advanced analytics consulting firm. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 100 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning and AI. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.

We are looking for a business-first, analytically strong consultant who can work directly with business leaders to understand complex decisions, challenge conventional thinking, and rapidly translate business needs into data- and AI-enabled solutions.

This is not a traditional requirements-gathering role. The consultant will be expected to understand how the business operates, identify the decisions that matter, determine what information and analysis are needed, and rapidly mobilize AI/Agentic tools, data and specialist teams to solve the problem.

The ideal candidate has operated in an environment where they have regularly used data and analysis to support business decisions and is excited about learning and applying emerging AI technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Understand the business and the decision: Engage business stakeholders to understand objectives, economics, processes, constraints and the decisions they are trying to make—not simply document stated requirements.
  • Challenge and structure problems: Ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and convert ambiguous business issues into clear hypotheses, analyses and decision frameworks.
  • Use data to develop insights: Explore and interpret data, conduct rapid analyses, identify patterns and translate findings into business implications and recommendations.
  • Rapidly prototype solutions: Use GenAI, Agentic AI, analytics and low-code/no-code tools to rapidly explore ideas, analyze information and develop working prototypes.
  • Orchestrate expertise: Recognize when deeper expertise is required and effectively leverage data scientists, engineers, domain experts, product teams and AI agents rather than attempting to build everything independently.
  • Drive from insight to action: Communicate findings in simple business language, recommend actions and work with stakeholders to translate recommendations into measurable business outcomes.
  • Continuously learn: Rapidly experiment with emerging AI and technology capabilities and identify where they can materially improve business decision-making.

Requirements

10+ years of experience in business analytics, strategy/management consulting, commercial analytics, operations, supply chain, finance, marketing/customer analytics, product management or a similar decision-oriented business environment.

The person should demonstrate:

  • Strong business curiosity and problem-solving ability.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Strong analytical orientation and comfort working hands-on with data.
  • Ability to move from business question → hypothesis → analysis → insight → decision/action.
  • Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively rather than simply accepting requirements.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity and solving loosely defined problems.
  • Strong written, verbal and executive communication skills.
  • Working familiarity with analytical tools such as Excel, SQL, BI/visualization tools and/or Python.
  • Strong interest and hands-on aptitude with GenAI, AI agents and emerging productivity/development tools.
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly without needing to be a deep software engineer.
  • Ability to bring together business, analytics, technology and specialist teams to deliver solutions rapidly.

Benefits

Significant career development opportunities exist as the company grows. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a small, fast-growing, challenging and entrepreneurial environment, with a high degree of individual responsibility.

Tiger Analytics provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Material Coordinator
description:
TRIGO Global Quality Solutions is seeking to fill a Material Coordinator Position.

Houston, TX 77095

Contract opening

Overall Purpose

Responsible for dismantling and shipping skid frames, organizing and packing the collapsed frames and associated attachments/mounting brackets for return shipment

Support and contribute to the company Quality Policies and QMS

Reports to

Site Supervisor/Containment Supervisor

Responsibilities

Client relationship & Business development

  • Dismantle frames used to transport parts to manufacturer.
  • Disassemble and organize frame components, attachments, and mounting brackets.
  • Collapse frames for efficient return shipment.
  • Properly pack and secure frames and components for transportation.
  • Maintain an organized work area and ensure components are accounted for.
  • Follow established safety procedures and handling requirements.
  • Perform other general material handling duties as needed.

Operations

  • Count all in-house material daily and balance inventory system
  • Investigate discrepancies immediately and resolve
  • Record all rejects by supplier and part number
  • Maintain and organize quarantine area, balance weekly
  • Conduct ongoing audits of effectiveness of work being performed
  • Return or dispose of material at an established period or at the end of the mission
  • Coordinate new material arrival and timing of completion
  • Demonstrates commitment to reduce the risk of workplace accidents
  • Must comply with local and company Health & Safety legislation, laws, and policies

Organization & management

  • Ensures all site personnel receive corporate communications
  • Monitor materials with regards to buffers being established and expedites being arranged
  • Create and maintain a 6S working environment
  • Assist with inquiries from internal and external staff; TRIGO and customer
  • Provide all information to assist with quoting rework, standard pack, container and sub-container, and daily usage

Technical

  • Update daily system entries in company and Customer portals
  • Maintain Inventory current and up to date status

Other

  • Placing material orders on Quality Alerts, including prioritizing the material to be processed
  • Assisting the Senior Lead and Supervisor in ordering supplies for the cage area
  • Managing the movement of materials, including scanning and forklifting
  • Communicating any inventory discrepancies to Senior Lead, Supervisor and the relevant Customer personnel
  • Completing call down and demand reports daily
  • Splitting rejected materials in the SAP system
  • Processing the materials disposition and obtaining scrap authorization if required
  • Any other duties as assigned

Knowledge, skills, abilities

  • Previous warehouse, material handling, assembly, disassembly, or packaging experience preferred.
  • Comfortable performing hands-on physical work.
  • Ability to use basic hand tools.
  • Ability to lift, move, and handle materials as required.
  • Reliable, safety-conscious, and able to work independently.
  • Manufacturing or agricultural equipment experience is a plus.

Customer focus

  • Client oriented
  • Reliable & trustworthy
  • Flexible

Work experience

  • 1+years of work experience in a materials / logistic – focus w/SAP
  • 1+ year in Quality related position preferred

Education background

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent

About TRIGO Global Quality Solutions

Founded in 1997, TRIGO is a multinational company providing operational Quality Management solutions for the manufacturing sector, especially in the automotive and aerospace industries. With a team of more than ten thousand professionals present in 20+ countries across 4 continents, TRIGO offers a comprehensive portfolio of Quality Assurance services ranging from inspection to expert auditing, consulting and training.

The unrivaled expertise, industrial mindset and extensive global footprint that TRIGO has built up over the last 3 decades has made TRIGO the leading quality solutions provider using the latest innovative and reliable digital systems and standard processes, delivering results in the most demanding industries. TRIGO has recently started to expand its clientele by offering quality services to the medical, chemical and food industries.

TRIGO Global Quality Solutions is committed to the core values of equal employment opportunity. We are committed to treating people fairly, and with respect and dignity. We offer employment opportunities based upon an individual's qualifications and performance, free from discrimination or harassment because of race, ancestry, place of origin, ethnic origin, color, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, family status, and disability.

TRIGO Global Quality Solutions appreciates receiving all expression of interest; however, only those candidates invited for an interview will be contacted.

title: Photo Specialist
description:
Job Summary
Delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience by providing expert photo services, digital passport photos, and support for customer service transactions, including FedEx, Western Union, and online order fulfillment. Owns the inventory, organization, and operational readiness of the photo department by maintaining supplies, monitoring inventory levels, and ensuring product and service availability to meet customer needs. Promotes photo products and services, assists customers at checkout registers, accurately processes transactions and cash handling activities, supports merchandising initiatives, and collaborates with team members to maintain a clean, safe, and customer focused environment while achieving operational and business goals.

Job Responsibilities
Customer Experience
• Engages customers and patients at the photo counter with warmth and purpose by greeting them, proactively offering assistance, and identifying needs to provide personalized products and services. Takes ownership of customer concerns, resolving issues and answering questions to ensure a positive and seamless experience.
• Models and reinforce customer-obsessed behaviors and service best practices across the team to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and behaviors by consistently greeting customers warmly, assisting through proactive and personalized support, and solving customer needs through resolution and follow-through until satisfied.
Operations
• Delivers courteous, friendly, accurate, and efficient service in the photo department, including digital passport photo services and promotion of photo products and services.
• Recommends products, services, upgrades, and companion items to meet customer needs and drive sales opportunities.
• Processes customer transactions accurately, including purchases, returns, refunds, exchanges, and rain checks, while adhering to cash handling procedures.
• Owns the inventory, supplies, organization, and operational readiness of the photo department by monitoring inventory levels, maintaining records, ensuring product availability, and maintaining photo expense, raw material, and supply inventory levels that align with forecasted three-week customer demand.
• Processes and fulfills photo, online, and web pickup orders, ensuring accuracy, timeliness to deliver a seamless customer experience.
• Provides customer support for service offerings, including FedEx, Western Union, and other auxiliary services, while ensuring compliance with applicable policies and procedures.
• Maintains photo equipment and utilizes store systems and technology to support daily operations, troubleshoot issues, and deliver quality results.
• Maintains a clean, organized, safe, and well-merchandised photo department and contributes to overall store appearance and operational standards.
• Supports photo and nearby departments in merchandising execution through display maintenance, promotional and seasonal setups, inventory activities, resets, and revisions.
• Supports the cross-training and development of store team members on photo department operations and services to ensure adequate coverage and operational continuity during times when the Photo Specialist is not scheduled.

corporate.

  • Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English. (Except in Puerto Rico)

  • Prefer six months of experience in a retail environment.

title: Cake Artist
description:
Job Description

Since 1940, Dairy Queen® has been one of the world’s best known and loved brands because they have created extraordinary Fan experiences. Lynn Lee Inc. / FalCo. LLC , as a franchisee of forty-one Dairy Queens and growing, works hard every day to protect and maintain the continued success of the Dairy Queen Brand by treating all team members and fans in a way that creates smiles and loyalty. We are a performance-driven organization and firmly believe that our employees are the catalyst to the success of the company. With success as the ultimate goal, we strive to create and provide an environment that offers challenging, stimulating and financially rewarding opportunities through a strong performance and values-minded culture.

Cake Artists assemble and prepare soft serve and cakes, including decorating with icing, gel, drawings, decorating kits, air brush, edible images and letterings. They ensure all cake products meet the Dairy Queen standards of quality and excellence.


RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Prepare and decorate cake products according to customer specifications and all applicable standards and procedures.
  • Properly and safely operate and maintain cake and soft serve equipment while following all health and safety standards.
  • Maintain an adequate inventory of decorated cakes at all times, including back-up cakes during holidays, national promotions and other peak cake occasions.
  • Keep display freezer full at all times to the proper level with a variety of cakes attractively displayed.
  • Conducts sampling and actively sells products.
  • Take and fill customer cake orders in a professional and timely manner.
  • Be pleasant and alert to customer needs.
  • Work as a “team” member to assure constant and consistent quality, service, cleanliness and value to each customer.
  • Clean work area, organize and stock needed items.
  • Keep cake production area and equipment clean and sanitary throughout shift using the PRIDE cake area checklist.
  • Wash counters, tables, restrooms, trash receptacles, gather trash and remove from dining/service areas to proper receptacle, sweep, mop, stock and other cleaning tasks. Occasional need to be out of the building (i.e., parking lot, freezer, trash container areas, etc.) for parking lot pick-up, trash removal and other maintenance and cleaning activities.
  • Inform immediate supervisor promptly of all problems or unusual matters of significance.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as requested by management staff.



WORKING CONDITIONS


Must have ability to:

  • Position requires prolonged standing, bending, stooping, twisting, lifting products and supplies weighing 50 pounds, and repetitive hand and wrist motion.
  • Must be able to work in and out of different temperature ranges.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Qualified candidates must exhibit exceptional decorating skills including gel, icing, air brush, decorating kits, edible images, floral designs, and licensed character designs through examples such as a portfolio.
  • Cake decorator’s certification is strongly preferred.
  • Must be able to perform under pressure in a high volume restaurant including moving and responding quickly for long periods of time.
  • Coordination skills to follow instructions and duplicate drawings and letters from projected images.
  • Practice established food-handling procedures to meet any local health regulations.
  • Must have excellent customer service skills, exhibit good manners, proper personal hygiene, positive attitude, and promptness.
  • Must be eligible to work in the United States.
  • AND MOST IMPORTANTLY must be able to contribute to a fun and friendly culture that thrives off of productivity and helping others!

title: Kiinteistöinsinööri
description:
Haluatko työskennellä elinvoimaisessa, kasvavassa ja luonnonläheisessä kunnassa loistavien liikenneyhteyksien varrella? Hattula on noin 9 300 asukkaan moderni ja kehittyvä hämäläiskunta kasvukäytävän sydämessä, aivan Hämeenlinnan kupeessa ja reilun tunnin matkan päässä Helsingistä sekä Tampereesta. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme pienen organisaation ketteryyden, suuren työnantajan vakauden sekä mahdollisuuden jättää oma kädenjälkesi kunnan kehitykseen.

Etsimme asiantuntevaa ja kehittämishaluista kiinteistöinsinööriä vastaamaan kuntamme kiinteistökannan hallinnasta ja tulevaisuuden korjaushankkeista. Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva 1.11.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan. Kunnan taseessa on noin 40 omaa kiinteistöä rakennuksineen, joten tehtävässä onnistuminen edellyttää kokonaisvaltaista otetta kiinteistöomaisuuden hallintaan. Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva toimi.

Nykyisen kiinteistöpäällikkömme tuleva eläköityminen tarjoaa sinulle pitkällä aikajänteellä loistavan mahdollisuuden edetä omalla urapolullasi. Pääset aluksi kasvamaan osaksi organisaatiotamme ja vaikuttamaan tehtäväkuvasi sisältöön, mikä mahdollistaa sujuvan vastuunoton ja roolin kehittämisen tulevaisuudessa.

Tehtävä sijoittuu kunnan organisaatiossa elinvoimatoimialan kiinteistöpalvelut-palvelualueen kiinteistöpalvelut-palveluyksikköön. Kiinteistöpäällikön alaisuudessa toimii lisäksi muutaman henkilön käsittävä kiinteistötiimi, jonka kanssa teet tiivistä yhteistyötä kunnan kiinteistöjen ylläpidon ja kehittämisen parissa.

Keskeiset työtehtävät
Hankehallinta: Korjausvelkaan liittyvien saneeraushankkeiden ja korjausprojektien läpivienti alusta loppuun. Kasvanutta korjausvelkaa pyritään pienentämään hallitusti ja mahdollisimman nopeasti kunnan kehittyvien tilatarpeiden ja taloudellisten resurssien mukaan. Korjaukset ja saneeraushankkeet rytmitetään ja aikataulutetaan vuosikelloon vuotuisen kunnan talousarviopäätöksenteon ohjaamana.
Projektijohto: Korjausrakentamisen projektien johtaminen, valvonta ja raportointi.
Budjettivastuu ja talouden seuranta: Osallistua kiinteistöpäällikön johdolla talousarviovalmisteluun. Lisäksi tehtäviin kuuluu saneeraushankkeita koskevan budjetin valmistelu, seuranta ja raportointi sekä taloudellisten vaikutusten arviointi osana päätöksentekoa ja projektien johtamista.
Järjestelmät ja hankinnat: Kiinteistöohjelman ylläpito ja päivitys sekä hankintojen kilpailutus.
Strateginen hallinta: Kunnan kiinteistökannan kokonaisvaltainen hallinta yhteistyössä kiinteistöpäällikön kanssa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?
Koulutusta: Soveltuva teknisen alan korkeakoulututkinto tai muu vastaava tutkinto.
Kokemusta: Näyttöä onnistuneista rakennus- tai korjausprojekteista, vähintään kahden (2) vuoden soveltuva työkokemus.
Osaamista: Rakennusalan projektihallinnan tuntemisen lisäksi julkisten hankintojen ja kilpailutusprosessien tuntemusta sekä kiinteistöjärjestelmien hallintaa.
Taloudellista osaamista: Taloudellisen näkökulman hallinta, budjettien seuranta ja raportointi sekä niihin liittyvä osaaminen ovat välttämättömiä tehtävässä onnistumisen kannalta.
Valmiutta liikkua kentällä: Tehtävä edellyttää laajaa perehtymistä kunnan kiinteistökantaan ja säännöllistä jalkautumista kentälle. Paikalliseen liikkumiseen tarvitset käytännössä omaa autoa, ja toimenkuvan luonne saattaa asettaa rajoitteita etätyöskentelylle.
Asennetta: Itsenäistä työotetta, hyviä yhteistyötaitoja sekä halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi pitkällä tähtäimellä.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
Urapolun ja kehitysmahdollisuuden: Tilaisuuden muokata ja laajentaa tehtävänkuvaasi tulevan organisaatiomuutoksen myötä.
Vakauden: Toistaiseksi voimassa olevan työsuhteen, hyvän perehdytyksen ja kunta-alan varmat edut.
Merkityksellisyyden: Pääset konkreettisesti vaikuttamaan kunnan elinvoimaisuuteen ja taloudellisesti fiksuun kiinteistöomaisuuden hoitoon.
Työsuhde-edut: Liikunta- ja kulttuuriharrastusten tuki (E-passi), kattavat työterveyspalvelut, mahdollisuus kunnan omien kuntosalien käyttöön maksutta. Lisäksi työnantaja suhtautuu kouluttautumiseen ja osaamisen kehittämiseen positiivisesti.

Työehtosopimus: Kunta-alan teknisen henkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimus (TS)
Työaika: Toimistotyöaika 36,25 h/viikko, liukuva työaika
Palkka: Tehtäväkohtainen palkka 4 000 €/kk
Muut ehdot: Koeajan pituus kuusi (6) kuukautta, tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä lääkärin myöntämä todistus terveydentilastaan ennen tehtävässä aloittamista
Hakuaika: Hakuaika tehtävään on 9.-27.9.2026 klo 23:59. Haastattelut pyritään saamaan päätökseen lokakuun puoliväliin mennessä.

title: Sähköasentaja / Kokoonpanija Tampereelle
description:
Etsimme sähköalan osaajaa vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Tampereelle kasvavaan tuotantoon. Tehtävä tarjoaa monipuolista tekemistä sähköasennusten, mekaanisen kokoonpanon ja modernien sähkövarastoratkaisujen parissa.

Työssä osallistut sähkövarastojärjestelmien, akkukonttien ja akkumoduulien kokoonpanoon sekä erilaisiin sähköistys- ja käyttöönottoasennuksiin. Tehtävä soveltuu henkilölle, joka viihtyy käytännönläheisessä tuotantotyössä ja osaa tulkita teknisiä piirustuksia.

- akkukonttien ja akkumoduulien mekaanisia asennuksia
- sähköistyksiä

Tuotanto toimii projektimaisessa ympäristössä, jossa tuotteet ja ratkaisut kehittyvät jatkuvasti. Työhön kuuluu ajoittain muutostöitä ja vaihtelevia tilanteita, minkä vuoksi joustava asenne ja ongelmanratkaisukyky ovat tehtävässä hyödyksi.

- Sähkötyöturvallisuuskoulutuksen

- Tulityökortin
Tarjoamme

- vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen
- monipuoliset työtehtävät nykyaikaisessa tuotantoympäristössä
- mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamista ja edetä uralla
- Teknologiateollisuuden TES:n mukaisen työsuhteen
Palkka

- Teknologiateollisuuden TES
- noin 14,50-17,00 €/h kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan
Jos sinulla on sähköalan tausta ja etsit pitkäaikaista työpaikkaa, jossa pääset hyödyntämään sekä sähkö- että kokoonpano-osaamistasi, lähetä hakemuksesi jo tänään. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
Job Overview:

Our Solution Engineering division develops IPs for various SoC projects, using TPIP products from other vendors.

We are looking for a creative and hard-working Senior Verification Engineer to verify RTL implementing upcoming features in the ARM SoC, ensuring both new functionality and existing features meet architectural requirements.

Responsibilities:

In addition to bringing your accomplishment of either Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Electrical/Computer Engineering or a similar related field, you will demonstrate:

  • Collaborate closely with the RTL team to understand microarchitecture details
  • Develop new verification environments and enhance existing verification environments, including stimulus generators, and checkers
  • Verify new features function as specified and do not impact existing functionality
  • Implement verification strategies in partnership with other verification engineers
  • Contribute to continuous improvement in verification methodology based on learnings
  • Mentor early-tenure verification engineers

Required Skills and Experience :

  • Minimum of 3 years of proven experience in an IP/SOC verification
  • Advanced proficiency in SystemVerilog and Verilog, with deep knowledge of UVM Methodology.
  • Solid understanding of SoC Verification using C Testcases
  • Experience writing verification plan and test plan.
  • Experience with Testbench development using any standard verification methodology
  • Experience with ARM-based designs and/or ARM System Architectures
  • Experience with Perl, Python or other scripting language
  • Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate with multi-functional and geographically distributed teams to accomplish tasks

“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :

  • Experience with AMBA protocols (CHI, AXI, AHB, APB), JTAG/SW/TAP.
  • Experience with power, clock domain crossing, and reset domain crossing
  • Exposure to low-power design techniques (UPF/CPF).

title: Coordinator Pharmacy Integrity
description:
Job Summary :

Responsible for researching and analyzing manual controlled substance orders and controlled substance override requests. Generates Ad-Hoc and standardized reports for DEA agents within mandated timeframes by writing queries and using advanced features of Excel. Acts as a subject matter expert in controlled substance ordering procedures, DEA licensing, and the Good Faith Dispensing policy. Educates store users and supervisors on proper procedures. Reviews and audits controlled substance loss forms to ensure proper reporting. Validates and updates prescriber profiles as needed.

Job Responsibilities :
  • Researches and analyzes controlled substance orders placed manually at store level. Determines if the orders are suspicious based on ordering patterns and circumstances, and takes appropriate actions to educate the user on proper ordering procedures.
  • Generates reports and provides data to DEA agents on store dispensing patterns, and prescriber or patient profiles within a 48 hour window. Builds Ad-Hoc queries to pull data outside of normal reporting requirements.
  • Maintains up-to-date knowledge about issues such as controlled substance ordering procedures, GFD policies, and DEA licensing requirements. Assists stores and field supervision with questions via email and phone on a variety of related topics.
  • Assists analysts in creating and reviewing store audits for controlled substance losses. Collaborates with Pharmacy Managers and Supervisors to ensure that losses are reported within the required timeframe and with 100% accuracy.
  • Manages prescriber ticket resolution system. Validates and updates prescriber records. Collaborates with Pharmacists to ensure that any prescription blocking is legitimate.
  • Researches and analyzes requests for increases to controlled substance allocations. Makes informed decisions based on collaboration with Pharmacy Managers, Supervisors, and item vendors. Mitigates risk to the company by ensuring that due diligence is completed and documented.
  • Assists in the implementation and updating of the Good Faith Dispensing and Target Drug Good Faith Dispensing policies.

title: Chief Development Officer
description:
PURPOSE OF POSITION

Covenant House Missouri (CHMO) welcomes youth who are runaway, trafficked, at-risk, or experiencing homelessness with unconditional love, absolute respect and a place to call home. Beyond shelter and basic needs, we deliver transformative solutions to help young people ages 16 to 24 build productive, independent and sustainable lives.

The Chief Development Officer (CDO) plays a critical role in driving the organization's growth and is responsible for leading growth strategies, fundraising, partnerships, and overall business development. The ideal leader in this role is a skilled and experienced fundraiser, strategic, and a mission-driven leader who ensures sustainable growth, deepens donor engagement, and maximizes the impact of an organization. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, the CDO is expected to align fundraising and development efforts with the organization's mission, vision, and long-term goals.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Chief Development Officer (CDO) is a full-time position. The CDO is responsible for all aspects of successful fundraising and development, inclusive of strategy and planning, crafting the case for support, annual events and campaigns, individual giving, corporate and foundation grants, online and digital fundraisers, legacy gifts, donor research and prospecting, engagement and stewardship, marketing and communications, technology and data management, and compliance and ethics. In partnership with the Chief Executive Officer, this position is responsible for leading growth strategies, fundraising, partnerships, and overall business development. The CDO serves as a member of the Executive Leadership Team.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Fundraising Leadership and Revenue Generation

  • Create Organizational Fundraising Strategy: Develop a detailed plan that outlines fundraising methods (events, capital campaigns, online campaigns, community appeals, major gift solicitation, stewardship, etc.), timelines, budget, resource allocation, and methods. This plan will guide the team's actions and help in managing resources efficiently.
  • Set Clear Goals: Define specific, measurable financial targets including the amount to be raised, purpose, timeline, a methods in align with the organization's mission and needs. Focus fundraising efforts and gives a clear direction for fundraising.
  • Building Relationships: Establish and cultivate long-term relationships with donors, foundations, and corporate sponsors through stewardship, appreciation, and regular communication, rather than just focusing on a one-time gift
  • Engage Stakeholders: Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders, government agencies, investors, the board, staff, the media, sponsors, and community partners. Ensure all internal and external stakeholders are aligned and engaged in the fundraising process.
  • Ambassador: Represent the organization at industry conferences, networking events, and public forums. Prepare and facilitate presentations about CHMO to community groups, corporations, foundations, and civic organization.
  • Identify Target Donors: Understand and segment potential donors, including individuals, corporations, foundations, and others. This also includes identifying the most likely contributors and determining strategies for approaching them.
  • Donor Stewardship: Develop and implement creative and customized stewardship plans for support investments. Ensure donors feel valued and appreciated for their contributions. Recognize them appropriately and providing updates on how their donations are being used. Communicate impact and success stories to encourage continued support. Develop donor recognition and appreciation programs.
  • Grant Management: Oversee research of grant opportunities, the writing of grant proposals, and reports to funders. Maintain compliance with grant requirements.
  • Evaluating Success: Track and report fundraising income and expenses. Analyze data, what worked, and what did not work to improve future fundraising strategies. Ensure transparency and compliance with legal and ethical fundraising standards.
  • Event Planning and Campaigns: Organize and oversee fundraising events, ensure that the logistics, marketing, and volunteer involvement for events is solidified, and host engaging and successful events and campaigns.
  • Marketing and Outreach: Develop and share compelling messaging, storytelling, and promotional materials. Use multiple channels to share messaging including local media, CHMO website, emails, social media, direct mail, annual report, impact report, and newsletters.

Organizational Leadership

  • Strategic Leadership: Leads the creation, implementation, and continuous evaluation of all facets of the organization's development strategy, including corporate, foundation and government grants; major and planned giving programs; online strategy (e.g. social media, blogs, and emails); annual events; capital campaign; marketing and outreach, financial management and reporting, volunteer and team coordination, and peer-to-peer fundraising. Expands presence and builds strategic alliances. Actively participate in quarterly CHMO Board meetings and Board committee meetings.
  • Make Critical Decisions: Make data-informed decisions that impact the direction, performance, and success of the organization. Allocate necessary resources to champion the implementation of the Strategic Plan and meet department objectives, KPIs, and organizational priorities.
  • Growth-Mindset: Identify new business opportunities for growth, partnerships, and revenue streams.
  • Monitor and Report: Ensure compliance of all grants in accordance with applicable city, state and federal guidelines; oversee the development and use of monitoring, tracking, and reporting protocol and report out on KPI's and organizational wellness metrics. Partner with programs to identify potential fund-raising activities. Ensure protocols are in place for adequate reporting to funders. This would include the collection and management of data necessary for statistical and grant reporting. Oversee data for grant, contract, and stakeholder reporting. Regularly tracking progress toward fundraising goals and adjusting strategies as needed.
  • Forecast: Communicate identified needs to the Chief Executive Officer and staff, proactively problem solve, and identify potential solutions using critical thinking skills.
  • Collaboration: Partners with Covenant House International to implement federation initiatives at the local level (e.g., brand roll out, events and corporate partnerships). Establishes and maintains an effective working relationship with coworkers on other teams, supervisor, and representatives of other agencies, the board, and the public. Actively participates in executive leadership meetings. Works closely with the board of directors' development committee to execute the organization's strategic plan and the development team's fundraising and communication goals.
  • Financial Oversight & Fiduciary Responsibility: Manage budget efficiently, responsibly, and sustainably. Manage requisition and approval of all expenses within areas of responsibility. Provide ongoing administrative budget analysis, monitoring, financial forecasting, expenditure review, and accountability for development expenses to ensure that expenses are executed within budget.
  • Time and Priorities: Prioritize initiatives and allocate resources to achieve key objectives while managing time effectively.
  • Utilization: Ensure maximum utilization of resources.

Talent Leadership, Management & Development

  • Hiring and Talent Development: Oversee the talent acquisition life cycle, which may include the recruitment, selection, development, supervision, training, support, evaluation, retention of committed, skilled, and motivated workforce for areas of, and offboarding process. Ensure the effective, efficient, and timely on-boarding of new staff in alignment with regulatory requirements. Oversee learning & development programs and initiatives that provide internal professional development opportunities for employees - this includes, but is not limited to, all training required for compliance audits.
  • Empower Teams & Effective Communication: Inspire, motivate, and empower teams by fostering collaboration, trust, and effective communication. Ensure clear and effective internal and external communication between all organizational departments and functions to foster teamwork and enhance operational success. Lead on cross-functional teams to support communications, problem management and process improvement.
  • Conflict Resolution: Address conflicts timely to maintain a productive and harmonious work environment.
  • Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to emerging leaders within the organization to ensure a strong leadership pipeline. Provide direction to staff to handle development transactions necessary for agency; ensure that their efforts are well-coordinated with strategic business goals.
  • Transparency: Keep everyone informed about organizational goals, changes, and growth opportunities.
  • Succession Planning: Identify and develop internal talent for future leadership roles.

Performance Excellence, Monitoring, Impact Evaluation, & Accountability

  • Measure Success: Monitor key performance indicators to consistently track progress and regularly analyze data, impact reports, and evaluate the development team's progress toward its goals to inform decision-making.
  • Accountability: Hold individuals and teams accountable for their roles and outcomes.
  • Critical Thinking: Analyze trends and practices of similar organizations at local and national levels and identify and propose strategies for improvement within the organization.

SUPERVISORY DUTIES

This position directly supervises the Director of Development, Volunteer & Community Relationship Coordinator, Donor Database and Stewardship Specialist, Grant Management Specialist, and Marketing and Communications Specialist.


WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

Regular internal contact with all CHMO staff, members of the Board of Directors, outside contact with vendors and suppliers, and regular contact with outside agencies.


REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree required in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration, Communications, Human Services or related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years professional experience overall, with a minimum of five years' experience in direct fundraising across many public and private channels.
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience managing a team of at least three staff members.
  • A proven track record of successfully soliciting six- and seven-figure gifts from both individuals and institutions.
  • Have an understanding of and appreciation for the importance of developing operations and cross-team collaboration, especially with finance and program.
  • Know how to support a CEO to be an effective fundraiser.
  • Use data to inform strategies and decisions.
  • Would enjoy working as a part of a federated organizational system.
  • Are a passionate and engaging public speaker with excellent negotiation skills.
  • Experience in managing cross-functional teams and scaling business or nonprofit initiatives.
  • LOVE fundraising!
  • Non-profit youth serving or housing focused leadership experience preferred.
  • Knowledge in mental health, trauma, substance abuse, homelessness, and the impact of poverty.

In addition to the above requirements, candidate must

  • Have a valid driver's license.
  • Follow all agency policies;
  • Pass State Child Abuse and Neglect and criminal background checks;
  • Carry out the essential functions of the position with, or without, accommodation.
  • Perform all job duties in a manner which demonstrates a commitment to organizational values and mission.
  • Demonstrate awareness, understanding, and cultural competence and ethnic diversity of clients, staff and other community partners.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Demonstrated history of leading high-performing development teams with integrity, transparency, and accountability in fundraising practices.
  • Strong relationship management skills with donors, board members, and stakeholders.
  • Understands financial management, budgeting, and ROI on fundraising initiatives.
  • Demonstrated history of using analytics and donor data to refine fundraising strategies.
  • Ability to navigate changes in donor behavior, market trends, and technology.
  • Ability to cultivate and steward donor relationships for long-term support.
  • Creative approach to solving fundraising challenges.
  • Comfortable with digital transformation and new fundraising technologies.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, assessment tools, database systems, and Windows environment.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/ PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Moderate concentration.
  • Frequent interruptions.
  • Moderate noise level.
  • Moderate travel
  • On-call responsibilities.
  • Moderate sitting, standing and eye strain, light walking, bending and lifting.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Evinova
location: Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States of America
description:
WHY JOIN US?Evinova is a health-tech business focused on accelerating better health outcomes by advancing digital transformation across the life sciences sector. By combining science-based expertise, evidence-led rigor, and deep human insight, we design digital solutions that enable healthcare to work better for everyone. Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, data, and analytics, we are helping unlock the full potential of digital health, transforming how clinical research is conducted, how care is delivered, and how patients experience healthcare. Our solutions are built to scale, driving efficiency, improving decision-making, and ultimately delivering better outcomes for patients worldwide.

At Evinova, we are driven by a shared purpose to transform health through data and digital innovation. Our teams collaborate across disciplines to solve complex challenges, continuously learning and evolving in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

We also recognize the importance of flexibility and balance. Our ways of working support both individual needs and team collaboration. To foster connection and collaboration, employees are expected to work from the office three days per week, creating opportunities for in-person teamwork, innovation, and meaningful connection.

About the OrganizationWe are looking for a software engineer who builds things that last and ships things that work — someone who holds both as a standard, not a trade-off.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will write code every day, own features from design through deployment, and be a meaningful contributor to a product used by clinical teams at scale. The work sits at the intersection of complex domain logic (clinical study design) and a fast-moving technology landscape, including AI. Neither of those things should intimidate you.

The engineers who thrive here are the ones who treat a working system as something to understand before they change it, who can move fast without leaving a mess, and who know the difference between a decision that should be revisited and one that should be made carefully the first time.

What the Work Looks Like

You will be part of the product engineering team building Study Designer — a product that helps clinical teams design, plan, optimize and execute trials more effectively. The team ships continuously and owns its deployments. That means you are responsible for your code in production, not just in a pull request.

Day to day you will:

  • Develop and ship features across the full stack — frontend, backend, infrastructure

  • Collaborate directly with product, design, and domain experts to turn requirements into good software

  • Participate in code review as someone who gives and receives meaningful feedback

  • Contribute to how the team works: surfacing problems early, improving processes, raising the quality bar

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

  • 5+ years of hands-on software development experience, with a track record of shipping production systems

  • History of working across the stack, not deep in one layer

  • Comfortable in fast-moving environments where the requirements and the technology are both evolving

What We're Looking For

  • You build things end-to-end. You are comfortable across the stack and don't draw hard lines at the edge of your comfort zone. You understand how your code lands in production — what the deployment looks like, how it behaves under load, how it fails, and how you'd know. Infrastructure is not someone else's problem.

  • You have judgement about quality. You write code that the next engineer can read, extend, and safely change. You know when 'good enough' is genuinely good enough and when cutting corners creates debt you'll be paying back for months. You test your own work meaningfully, not just to hit coverage numbers.

  • You use AI fluently, not blindly. AI tooling is a standard part of how you work. You use it to move faster — on coding, on learning unfamiliar patterns, on working through problems. But you evaluate the output rather than accepting it. You understand that generating code and understanding code are different things, and you don't confuse them. You bring judgment to what the model produces; the model accelerates that judgement, it doesn't replace it.

  • You are curious about the domain. Clinical trial design is a specialized space. You don't need to know it coming in, but you need to be genuinely interested in learning it — because the best solutions come from understanding the problem, not just the ticket.

  • You raise the room. At this level, your impact extends beyond your own output. You give clear, useful feedback in code review. You share context instead of hoarding it. You flag problems before they become incidents. You make the people around you better at what they do.

Technical Skills

This is a representative view of our stack. We don't expect full coverage — but given the scope of the role, you should be able to pick up unfamiliar parts quickly and deliberately.

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

  • Backend: Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Next.js, Kafka, PostgreSQL (SQLAlchemy / asyncpg), DynamoDB (PynamoDB), MongoDB

  • Infrastructure: AWS (primary), Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), AWS CDK (TypeScript), ECS Fargate, RDS, S3, ElastiCache

  • DevOps: GitHub Actions, NX, pnpm, Docker/Buildx

  • AI / ML Infrastructure: AWS Bedrock, LiteLLM, LangFuse (observability), OpenTelemetry, RAG pipelines, MCP

  • AI Tools: Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot — or equivalents

SO, WHAT’S NEXT?

To be considered for this exciting opportunity, please complete the full application on our website at your earliest convenience – it is the only way that our Recruiter and Hiring Manager can know that you feel well qualified for this opportunity. If you know someone who would be a great fit, please share this posting with them.

Where can I find out more?

  • Explore what we’re building:
  • Stay connected and see our impact in action:

Apply today to bring smarter, faster clinical trials to life!

title: Archaeologist - MILTON KEYNES
description:
Archaeologist



Milton Keynes


Salary £28,532 - £29,255



Fixed-term (six-month) contracts available, with immediate start dates.


Cotswold Archaeology is one of the largest and most respected archaeological practices in the country, employing over 380 professional staff and carrying out some of the most interesting, complex and largest archaeological and heritage projects across England and Wales.

We are seeking ,Experienced Archaeologists, Archaeologists and Trainees across all four of our offices to work on a range of exciting archaeological projects, spanning different time periods. With a strong ongoing program of fieldwork, we are looking for motivated, dedicated individuals to join our team.

Cotswold Archaeology has projects located in the vicinity of our offices, but for these roles there will be a requirement to be rostered on protracted away projects where we will provide accommodation and the opportunity to accrue lieu and overtime.

Where away work is required good quality accommodation will be provided, along with subsistence payments. (£24 per each night where eligible).

What we offer

Along with a starting salary above the CIfA minimum, we offer a highly competitive benefits package including:

  • 30 days annual leave (including statutory holidays) - please note that the annual leave allowance will be prorated for the duration of contract.
  • Defined contribution pension scheme
  • Life insurance scheme
  • Paid CIfA membership subscription (following qualifying period)
  • Company sick pay - prorated for the duration of contract.
  • A generous lieu scheme operated for all driving time, and time spent in excess of 45 minutes each way as a passenger, outside of the normal 7.5 hour working day (able to accumulate up to 10 days additional lieu time annually)
  • Overnight accommodation and subsistence when working on away projects.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and a network of mental health first aiders across the organisation.
  • Personal protective equipment


Please note all salaries quoted are annual equivalents based on a 37.5-hour week. We are unable to offer contracts with the provision of 7 day a week accommodated away work.

Membership of the CIfA at PCIfA level is desirable, as is possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or CSCS test pass. Although new CSCS cards are not currently being issued to the archaeological sector, successful applicants without a current and valid CSCS card or test pass, will be expected to pass the CITB HS&E Operatives Test, which will be arranged and paid for by CA.

A full manual driving licence is desirable.



The Details



Archaeologists £28,532 - £29,255 Dependent on Experience

We are seeking enthusiastic and skilled individuals to join our existing team. Your core skills and experience should include manual excavation, the recording of archaeological features, proven experience in commercial archaeology and the recovery of artefacts or samples. title: BERT OGDEN MCALLEN NISSAN WINDSHIELD INSTALLER
description:
The Windshield Installer is responsible for removing and installing automotive windshields and related glass components in accordance with manufacturer specifications, company standards, and safety requirements. This position also performs or assists with sensor calibration after windshield replacement to help ensure cameras, sensors, and related safety systems operate properly. The role requires strong attention to detail, proper use of glass installation and calibration equipment, safe handling of adhesives and materials, and a commitment to quality workmanship and customer satisfaction.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES

· Review work orders with service staff to confirm vehicle information, glass replacement needs, calibration requirements, and customer concerns.

· Inspect vehicles before service and protect interior and exterior surfaces during windshield removal, installation, and calibration work.

· Safely remove damaged windshields, moldings, trim, adhesives, and related components while minimizing risk of damage to the vehicle body, paint, interior, and electrical systems.

· Prepare pinch welds, glass surfaces, primers, urethane, and related materials according to manufacturer procedures and company quality standards.

· Install windshields and related automotive glass components using proper tools, materials, alignment methods, and safe drive-away time requirements.

· Reconnect, transfer, or verify attached components such as mirrors, rain sensors, cameras, moldings, clips, and trim panels as required.

· Perform or assist with camera and sensor calibration after windshield replacement using approved calibration targets, scan tools, and equipment.

· Follow pre-scan, post-scan, static calibration, and dynamic calibration procedures as required by the vehicle manufacturer and company process.

· Verify completed installations for proper fit, seal, appearance, leaks, noise concerns, warning lights, and proper operation of related safety features.

· Accurately document work performed, materials used, calibration results, scan reports, and any concerns or recommendations related to the service.

· Maintain glass tools, calibration equipment, adhesives, primers, personal protective equipment, and installation supplies in good working condition.

· Follow company procedures, manufacturer guidelines, safety standards, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements while performing glass and calibration services.

· Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area, including proper disposal of glass, urethane, blades, liners, and used materials.

· Provide courteous customer service and communicate professionally with team members, advisors, vendors, and management.

· Other duties as assigned.

title: Palvelupäällikkö, terveyssosiaalityö, Tampere
description:
Oletko johtamistaitoinen, esihenkilötyöstä innostuva ja muutostyön tekemisestä nauttiva sosiaalityön ammattilainen? Haemme vakituiseen virkaan palvelupäällikköä vastaamaan terveyssosiaalityön ammatillisesta johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä.

Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueelle on 1.1.2026 perustettu kuntoutuksen toimialue, joka kokoaa yhteen kuntoutuksen palvelut erikoissairaanhoidosta ja peruspalveluista. Toimialue sijoittuu avopalvelujen linjalle ja muodostuu kolmesta vastuualueesta: fysiatria ja vaativa kuntoutus, erityishenkilöstö ja lääkinnällinen kuntoutus sekä lähikuntoutus. Henkilöstöä on noin 740. Uudella toimialueella pääset kuntoutuksen uudistamisen ytimeen.

Kuntoutuksen toimialueen sosiaalityöntekijät ja sosiaaliohjaajat (yhteensä 61 henkilöä) kuuluvat erityishenkilöstön ja lääkinnällisen kuntoutuksen vastuualueelle ja he tuottavat terveyssosiaalityön palvelua erikoissairaanhoidossa, lähisairaaloissa ja jonkin verran myös perusterveydenhuollossa. Erikoisairaanhoidossa terveyssosiaalityötä teemme somatiikalla ja lasten sekä nuorten psykiatrian palveluissa, mutta aikuisten psykiatrian palvelulla on omat sosiaalityöntekijänsä. Lähiesihenkilöinä toimivia vastaavia sosiaalityöntekijöitä on neljä, ja he vastaavat alueillaan henkilöstöhallinnosta, toiminnan operatiivisesta johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä yhdessä johtavan sosiaalityöntekijän kanssa.

Terveyssosiaalityö tarjoaa kehittyvän, merkityksellisen ja vastuullisen tehtäväkentän johtajalleen. Terveyssosiaalityön lähtökohtana on kokonaisnäkemys terveydellisten haasteiden yhteydestä asiakkaan ja hänen läheistensä arjessa selviytymiseen. Tavoitteena on vahvistaa asiakkaan terveyttä, kuntoutumista, arjen sujumista, psykososiaalista toimintakykyä sekä yhteiskunnallista osallisuutta. Asiakkaan elämäntilannetta tarkastellaan kokonaisvaltaisesti, ja koordinoidaan etuus-, palvelu- ja kuntoutusjärjestelmä osaksi asiakkaan hoito- ja kuntoutusprosessia. Tehtävänä on myös edistää asiakkaan ja potilaan oikeuksien toteutumista sekä asiakkaiden asemaa yhteiskunnassa rakenteellisen sosiaalityön keinoin. Terveydenhuollon palvelutehtävän lisäksi Kuntoutuksen toimialueen sosiaalityöhön on integroitu rajattuja sosiaalihuollon virkatehtäviä.

Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat:
Terveyssosiaalityön kokonaisuudessa ammatillisesta johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä, toiminnan, talouden ja henkilöstön johtamisesta sekä kehittämisestä.
Taloudesta, budjetti- ja henkilöstösuunnittelusta sekä niiden toimeenpanosta ja henkilöstön kehittämisestä, työnjaosta ja yhteistyöstä.
Toiminnan sekä talouden arvioinnista ja raportoinnista, viestinnästä, sisäisestä valvonnasta sekä riskienhallinnasta sisäisen valvonnan ohjeiden mukaisesti.
Toimit vastaavien sosiaalityöntekijöiden, sosiaalityöntekijöiden ja sosiaaliohjaajien esihenkilönä.
Johdat toiminnan suunnittelua, toimeenpanoa ja kehittämistä, toimintojen yhteensovittamista ja integraatiota.
Osallistut palvelu- ja hoitoprosessien sekä toiminnan, resurssien ja talouden suunnitteluun. Tehtävään sisältyy taloudellista ja henkilöstöhallinnollista päätösvastuuta.

Saat tueksesi kokeneet johtavat erityistyöntekijät, johtotiimin ja osaavan henkilöstön.

Kelpoisuusehtona on Suomessa laillistettu sosiaalityöntekijä. Edellytämme sinulta kokemusta esihenkilönä toimimisesta.
Eduksi katsomme terveydenhuollon ja sosiaalihuollon sosiaalityön tuntemuksen, palvelujärjestelmän ja lainsäädännön tuntemuksen, kokemuksen muutoksen johtamisesta ja uusien toimintatapojen ja työmuotojen johtamisesta käytäntöön. Arvostamme erityisesti hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja viestintätaitoja, esiintymiskykyä, hyvää suomen kielen kirjallista ilmaisua ja paineensietokykyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä:
Toivomme, että voit aloittaa tehtävässä 12.10.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.
Tehtävässä on kuuden kuukauden koeaika.
Työaika on toimistotyöaika - säännöllinen työaika, 36 h 15 min / vk.
Valitun on toimitettava vaadittavat todistukset terveydentilastaan kuukauden sisällä työn aloittamisesta, työhöntulotarkastuksen tekee työterveyshuoltomme Pirte.

Tule joukkoomme kehittämään uutta kuntoutuksen toimialuetta. Laita hakemuksesi Kuntareryssä.

title: Physiatrist 1099
description:
As a 1099 physiatrist, you will be responsible for the diagnosing and providing direct specialist services to patients for pain management and physical rehabilitation from work related injuries. You will work in a team environment with physical therapists, chiro, acupuncture among other clinical staff under the referral of the occupational medicine physician. You’ll also collaborate with employers in active case management.

The specialty division of Agile Occupational Medicine is a rapidly growing business emphasizing quality care with the highest standards. The Agile approach is focused on speed of recovery while we keep the patient engaged in the process, with aggressive scheduling and follow-up, getting injured workers back to work and life as soon as possible. You will enjoy state-of-the-art equipment and well-trained staff to assist with providing excellent care. It is important to us that all patients are given the highest quality of care, and we are dedicated to recruiting like-minded individuals to join our team!


Specialties: Orthopedics, sports medicine, manual therapy, ergonomics, injury prevention.


Responsibilities

  • Diagnose and manage a wide range of physical disabilities and conditions, including musculoskeletal issues, chronic pain, and neurological disorders from work-related injuries; assess patients’ medical history, physical exams, and x-rays
  • Develop individualized treatment plans that may include physical therapy, therapeutic exercises, medications, injections, and non-surgical interventions to improve function and mobility
  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, including physical therapists and medical doctors, to ensure comprehensive patient care.
  • Monitor patient progress and adjust treatment plans as needed to achieve optimal outcomes.
  • Educate patients on their conditions and its prevention and the rehabilitation process
  • Complete timely and accurate documentation in EMR

title: Loss Prevention Specialist II
description:
SUMMARY: The Loss Prevention Specialist II (aka “Client Advisory Services Specialist II”) will primarily provide responsive risk management advisory services to CPA firms that are CAMICO policyholders through CAMICO’s Loss Prevention Hotline, and e-mail. This position will work closely with and provide support to other CAMICO departments including, but not limited to, Marketing/Communications, Claims, and Underwriting. The Loss Prevention Specialist will also assist with the development and implementation of risk management educational programs; identify and develop proactive risk management tools; build and support external resources; and contribute/write articles for CAMICO’s newsletter and other publications. Counseling policyholders in a variety of practice and risk management areas will require the individual to (a) have passed the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination and to have practiced in public accounting for a minimum of four (4) years or (b) have a minimum of six (6) years of equivalent professional experience.

This position has high visibility to CAMICO's policyholders, agents and external resources and some travel is required. Must have the ability to succeed in a fast-paced environment.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Share risk management expertise in response to inquiries received from CPA Firms.
  • Stay current with emerging practice issues, developing risk areas, current professional/regulatory concerns, as well as more foundational risk management matters, such as engagement letters, conflicts of interest, and disengagements.
  • Assist the Loss Prevention department with building and managing external and educational resources to enhance and support the demands for risk management content.
  • Develop/conduct presentations on risk management and other topics of interest to CPAs in public practice.
  • Consult as needed with other CAMICO Departments and CAMICO agents.
  • Assist with projects as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

COMPETENCIES:

This position requires demonstrated skill and ability in the following competencies:

· Ability to Prioritize

· Action Oriented

· Customer (Policyholder) Focus

· Integrity and Trust

· Interpersonal Savvy

· Strong Communication Skills:

o Listening

o Oral Communication

o Written Communication

· Highly Organized

· Practical Judgment

· Risk Identification and Analysis

· Quick Learner

· Good Time Management Skills

· Self-Starter - Able to Work Independently

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Individuals must be flexible and maintain composure in difficult situations and must work well as part of a team.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor's degree (B.A. or B.S.) from four-year college or university.

A Certified Public Accountant who has practiced in public accounting for a minimum of four (4) years or six years of professional experience.

LANGUAGE SKILLS:

Strong communication and organization skills and excellent analytical skills are required. Ability to respond, identify issues, and practically communicate with CPA firms. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret professional literature, including but not limited to, regulatory/professional standards and other professional guidance. Ability to contribute to or write risk management articles, reports, business correspondence, and other documents as required. Advanced presentation skills are also desired.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:

Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions and percentages.

REASONING ABILITY:

Ability to demonstrate sound judgment (i.e., recognize and define issues, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions). Able to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, and diagram form. Ability to assess and resolve problems involving complex situations.

DESIRABLE SUPPLEMENTAL EXPERIENCE/CREDENTIALS

Additional credentials and/or experience that are not required but would be beneficial include those related to offering risk management advice related to fraud prevention or detection, or forensic accounting (e.g., CFE or CFF), information technology (CITP), financial planning (“PFS”), valuation (e.g., ABV or CVA), cybersecurity, servicing cannabis clients, and/or having performed Service Organization Control (“SOC”) engagements.

A CPA certification is preferred.

The employee is occasionally required to stand and walk. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception.

title: Lab Engineer II
description:
Amazon's is building next-generation robotics systems for multi-purpose use, and we need hands-on lab engineers to own and operate the test environments that prove these robots are ready for production. With multiple new test labs coming online in the months ahead, this is a chance to join a growing System Verification and Validation team at a pivotal moment and directly shape how we build, test, and scale our robotics prototypes.

As a Lab Engineer II, you will operate and maintain test fixtures, lab equipment, and motion capture systems while also performing robot repairs to keep test uptime high. As the team grows, you will have the opportunity to mentor new technicians and associates, and potentially step into a lab manager role. If you are energized by working with robotics and automation hardware, solving hands-on problems, and helping a small team grow, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot test environments, fixtures, and lab equipment to ensure high availability and uptime for prototype development and verification and validation efforts.
- Perform robot repairs and hardware rework to maintain test readiness, diagnosing root causes and implementing corrective actions efficiently.
- Build, test, analyze, and validate robotic prototypes and subsystems using tools such as motion capture systems, test fixtures, and standard lab instrumentation.
- Deliver high-quality engineering artifacts including test reports, work instructions, and lessons-learned documents that support team knowledge and reproducibility.
- Assess lab operations proactively, identify process improvements, and lead initiatives that simplify workflows and remove bottlenecks as new lab spaces come online.

A day in the life
You might start your morning running a motion capture session to validate robot movement, then pivot to repairing a prototype that failed during an overnight test run. After documenting your findings and updating test records, you could spend the afternoon setting up a newly delivered test fixture and calibrating equipment in one of our expanding lab spaces. You will partner closely with hardware and software test engineers to keep verification activities on track, and as the lab team scales you will help onboard and guide new team members.

About the team
We are a small, collaborative group of hardware and software test engineers, and these Lab Engineer II roles will be the first dedicated lab engineering positions on the team. Our mission is to validate robotic systems across multiple dimensions of performance and reliability as we scale from prototype to production. As we expand, there is a clear path to take on mentorship and leadership responsibilities. If you want to help build a lab organization from the ground up and leave your mark on the next generation of Amazon robotics, this is the team to join.
