title: Technology Systems - Project Designer
description:
Interested in making your mark at a 100% employee-owned architecture and engineering firm? Wiley|Wilson is home to more than 180 employee-owners across five offices, and we are looking for the right person to grow with us.

We are seeking a Technology Systems Project Designer to join our team in Richmond, VA. In this role, you will design telecommunications networks, structured cabling, audio/visual systems, and electronic security systems for a variety of vertical building projects. You will work closely with senior Technology Systems staff and multidisciplinary project teams to deliver high-quality designs while continuing to build your technical expertise.

The right candidate will bring strong technical skills along with good time management, communication, and organization. We are looking for someone who enjoys working as part of a collaborative design team and takes a proactive approach to learning and problem solving.

What We Offer

Wiley|Wilson offers a competitive salary along with employee ownership through our ESOP and work-from-home flexibility, with details provided upon inquiry. Our benefits package includes multiple group health insurance options, a 401(k) with up to a 6% matching contribution, 24 days of paid time off, five paid holidays per year, tuition reimbursement, and other benefits.

We also place a strong emphasis on work-life balance and professional growth, with benefits including 80 hours of parental leave for the birth or adoption of a child, a hybrid work schedule, and accommodations for individuals with disabilities.

What We're Looking For

Candidates should have 3-7 years of experience designing telecommunications networks, structured cabling systems, audio/visual systems, and electronic security systems for vertical building projects. Experience within the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry is required. An Associate's degree or higher in Engineering, Architecture, or a related field is preferred, although an equivalent combination of education and experience will also be considered.

Proficiency in Autodesk Revit is required, including model setup, linking, navigation, and the ability to develop Technology Systems designs from project initiation through completion. Candidates should also be proficient with Microsoft Office and have the organizational and time-management skills needed to manage multiple assignments.

Strong communication and collaboration skills are important in this position. You will work regularly with other Technology Systems team members, engineering and architectural disciplines, subconsultants, and clients.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States and eligible to obtain a security clearance.

Experience with federal government projects is a plus. BICSI Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD) or AVIXA CTS certification is also desirable, as is an interest in pursuing either certification as part of your professional development.

What You'll Do

  • Design telecommunications networks, structured cabling systems, audio/visual systems, and electronic security systems for a variety of vertical building projects.

  • Develop and coordinate Revit models and construction documents from design through completion.

  • Work with senior Technology Systems staff to deliver quality designs and continue developing your technical expertise.

  • Coordinate Technology Systems designs with architectural and other engineering disciplines.

  • Participate in client and project meetings to coordinate project scope and design requirements. Approximate travel is 10%-15%.

  • Help ensure work meets project quality standards, schedules, and budgets.

Why Wiley|Wilson?

As a 100% employee-owned company, Wiley|Wilson gives you the opportunity to build your career while sharing in the success of the firm through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Our diverse project portfolio, emphasis on professional development, and collaborative environment provide opportunities to take on meaningful work and grow over time.


About Wiley|Wilson

Wiley|Wilson is a full-service architecture and engineering firm specializing in innovative and functional design solutions for government, institutional, and private-sector clients worldwide. We have offices in Alexandria, Lynchburg, and Richmond, VA; Raleigh, NC; and Atlanta, GA.

  • Technology Systems Project Designer, telecommunications networks, structured cabling systems, audio/visual systems, electronic security systems, Autodesk Revit, RCDD, AVIXA CTS

title: Developer Advocate - Remote
description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data use.

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 2,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

About the role:

You’re a natural connector who combines hands-on technical knowledge with the confidence to engage developers and build lasting relationships. You’re curious about how developers work, the challenges they face, and where Zyte API and Scrapy can fit into their workflows. You’re excited by how LLMs are changing software development and keen to help developers take an AI-first approach, using web data to build useful applications.

As a Developer Advocate at Zyte, your work will focus on three key areas:

You’ll grow Zyte’s presence at conferences, meetups, and developer-focused events, identifying valuable opportunities and delivering engaging talks, workshops, and live demos. You’ll build relationships with developers, event organizers, and technology partners, connecting real-world challenges with practical ways to use Zyte.

You’ll create tutorials, demos, videos, and technical resources that help developers integrate Zyte API and Scrapy into their projects. You’ll explore emerging workflows, including LLM-powered applications and AI agents, showing how reliable web data supports them.

You’ll stay close to developers through open conversations, useful guidance, and ongoing engagement. Working with product, technical, and marketing teams, you’ll turn community feedback into improvements to our tools and resources, helping developers learn, connect, and build with Zyte.

Responsibilities:

  • Represent Zyte at developer conferences, meetups, community events, podcasts, webinars, and other relevant industry forums.
  • Identify and evaluate speaking, sponsorship, partnership, and community engagement opportunities that align with Zyte’s goals.
  • Develop and deliver engaging conference talks, technical workshops, live demonstrations, webinars, and panel contributions, external and our own industry event, Extract Summit.
  • Build and maintain meaningful relationships with developers, community leaders, event organizers, technology partners, and external advocates.
  • Grow a network of independent advocates and support them in sharing their experiences with Zyte, Scrapy, and web data extraction.
  • Engage consistently with developers across social channels, forums, events, and relevant technical communities.
  • Create written content, videos, presentations, demonstrations, and code samples that help developers adopt and integrate Zyte’s tools.
  • Showcase practical approaches to solving web scraping and data extraction challenges.
  • Write technical articles for Zyte’s blog and relevant third-party publications.
  • Identify opportunities for Zyte to contribute to and collaborate with developer and open-source communities.
  • Represent the developer perspective within the marketing team and across the wider organization.
  • Identify opportunities to improve developer documentation and contribute directly to those improvements.
  • Contribute regularly to Zyte’s social channels with content created for a developer audience.
  • Track the impact of events, speaking engagements, partnerships, and community activities, using those insights to shape future initiatives.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in developer advocacy, community engagement, or related technical roles, plus a proven established following
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, APIs, web scraping, and data extraction
  • Demonstrable knowledge of Python.
  • Interest in web data extraction
  • A passion for developers and helping developers.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with some experience with public speaking
  • Proven experience working with communities, social media, and blogging required.
  • A background in community building and event hosting is a plus
  • Self-motivated, self-reliant and able to prioritize tasks.
  • Strong team player

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Scrapy, headless browsers and web scraping is a plus but not a hard requirement.

Benefits

As a new Zytan, you will:

  • Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.
  • Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.
  • Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.
  • Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.
  • 35 days paid holidays

title: DD&T Cluster Lead
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. Job Description

Previa verifica dei requisiti professionali, costituisce titolo preferenziale l’appartenenza alle Categorie Protette ai sensi dell’art 1 L. 68/99 e/o alle categorie di lavoratori che risultino percettori di interventi a sostegno del reddito e/o risultino disoccupati a seguito di procedure di licenziamento collettivo e/o lavoratori delle aziende del territorio di riferimento coinvolte da tavoli di crisi attivi presso il MIMIT.

ROLE OBJECTIVE

Working in close collaboration with the cross-functional partners in the Cluster, IBU and ICC teams, you will:

  • Serve as the Cluster’s DD&T Business Partner and single point of accountability for upfront problem framing, requirement shaping, prioritizing, and progressing technology and AI demand into enterprise delivery pathways with a strong emphasis on upfront solution discovery, process understanding, and value framing before demand enters delivery.

  • Represent DD&T in Cluster leadership forums (and key function/LOC governance), ensuring business strategy, pain points, and opportunities are translated into an outcome-led DD&T roadmap.

  • Provide clear, structured communication to DD&T Area Heads on cluster health: demand pipeline, delivery status, adoption/value realization, risks, and escalations

  • Drive innovation, transformation, & adoption of enterprise DD&T solutions and services within the cluster.

  • Act as a thought leader and show the organization the art of the possible with respect to technology and AI

  • Ensure that operations and support for DD&T solutions and services initiatives are established within the cluster to promote sustainability and adoption.

  • Be hands-on and drive selected flagship DD&T initiatives within the cluster and ensure that solution discovery, requirement quality, and demand sequencing remain core responsibilities of the role, even when delivery is delegated.

  • Ensure that all DD&T Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) are adhered to and followed within the cluster.


KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Own the Cluster DD&T Business Partner (“front door”) model. Establish a clear engagement pathway for LOCs/functions, including transparent decision-making for priorities and trade-offs.

  • Lead portfolio governance for the cluster. Maintain an integrated view of demand, initiatives, dependencies and capacity constraints; ensure work is sequenced to maximize business outcomes and adoption (not just delivery).

  • Provide effective communication and escalation management. Produce concise updates to DD&T Head Europe/Intercontinental covering: top challenges, opportunities, delivery risks, adoption KPIs, compliance issues, and decisions required

  • Own the cluster Technology & AI adoption agenda. Maintain the cluster portfolio of enterprise DD&T capabilities to be adopted (Data, AI, Digital/Omnichannel platforms & engagement with Digital & Campaign Operation), with clear priorities, sequencing, dependencies, KPIs, and outcomes and ensure alignment with strategic priorities and enterprise roadmap

  • Translate business demand into enterprise-ready requirements, including clear problem statements, business process flows, automation and integration needs (e.g., PSP, SAP, CRM), data dependencies, and adoption considerations

  • Be hands on and personally lead 1–2 flagship cluster initiatives () by shaping the use case, defining requirements, validating solution fit, and driving adoption and engage other clusters, IBU DD&T and ICC/GCC teams for delivery

  • Act as a Technology & AI thought leader and ambassador. Continuously identify where enterprise AI/automation/digital capabilities can materially improve outcomes; Communicate and inspire the organization on what is feasible now vs later, and what the prerequisites (e.g. data quality) are to move to the future.

  • Lead responsible AI adoption and guardrails. Promote use of approved enterprise AI platforms and patterns; ensure AI use cases include practical controls (data provenance, human oversight, monitoring, change control, documentation) and actively prevent unapproved tools/solutions that create compliance risk or technical debt.

  • Partner with ICC/GCC for scalable delivery. Ensure that DD&T products and services are delivered by ICC/GCC delivery teams and act as the main ICC/GCC contact point in cluster for prioritization, escalation, defect/incident trends, enhancement requests, etc.

  • Ensure a lean operating model exists for supported solutions. Ensure a minimum viable but complete support model exists in cluster, i.e. process & data ownership with business escalation into global support/vendor teams etc.

  • Own cluster DD&T Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) execution and audit readiness. Ensure all adopted solutions and local configurations follow required controls (privacy, security, access governance, third-party risk, documentation/evidence, retention), and that cluster teams follow compliant ways of working without slowing delivery unnecessarily.

  • Operating Cadence & Reporting. Establish a regular operating cadence with DD&T Head Europe to review cluster portfolio, adoption/value, risks, resourcing constraints, and escalations; ensure early visibility of issues and opportunities

DESIRED BEHAVIOUR

  • Influences without authority to drive adoption and outcomes. Aligns LOC and global stakeholders, builds momentum, and removes blockers through credibility, evidence, and persistence.

  • Operates effectively in ambiguity with a structured, pragmatic approach. Breaks complex problems into actionable steps, makes decisions with imperfect information, and adapts quickly as facts change.

  • Builds and leverages cross-functional networks to get work done. Creates trusted relationships across business, DD&T, data, digital/omnichannel, security/privacy, and vendors to accelerate delivery in a lean setup.

  • Communicates with clarity and technical depth (verbal and written). Translates technology and AI topics into business implications; produces crisp requirements, decision logs, and adoption communications.

  • Leads by example with a standard-first, value-realization mindset. Champions reuse of enterprise solutions stays hands-on in key discussions and focuses on measurable adoption and benefits beyond go-live.

  • Demonstrates executive presence and consultative partnering. Builds credibility with cluster leaders; challenges constructively, frames options with trade-offs, and drives decisions.

COMPETENCIES and EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • 8+ years of commercial IT/technology experience preferably within the Life Sciences Industry

  • In-depth understanding of the commercial business. Ability to translate between technical and non-technical language.

title: Data Engineer II, AR Data Egineering, FinAuto
description:
After building a proven Data Mesh architecture serving thousands of users, we are re-imagining our data ecosystem as an AI-First, Native-AI platform that powers the next generation of intelligent financial automation. At the heart of this transformation is Graphite — our AI Enablement Layer that makes financial data products discoverable, queryable, and consumable by AI agents and human users. The FinAuto team at Amazon is looking for a Data Engineer to play a critical role in building AI-ready, high-scale financial data products that fuel Graphite-powered self serve insights and data-driven decision making at enterprise scale.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape a our data foundation — building highly discoverable, governed, and reusable data products that power analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic applications across Amazon Finance. Your work will directly feed into Graphite's ability to orchestrate AI-driven data access — ensuring datasets are semantically rich, well-governed, and optimized for both human analysts and AI agents. You will modernize our architecture using technologies such as Zero ETL, AWS DataZone, end-to-end lineage, real-time observability, and automated data quality frameworks.

The ideal candidate is passionate about building next-generation distributed data systems on AWS and believes in democratizing access to high-quality data — whether consumed through dashboards, APIs, or AI-native interfaces. You will work on scalable, secure, and AI-compatible data platforms that enable self-service analytics, semantic data discovery, and intelligent financial operations.

Key job responsibilities
1. Build and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines and datasets on AWS (S3, EMR, Redshift, Glue) to support Finance analytics, reporting, and AI-powered financial automation
2. Develop and enhance AI-ready data products, ensuring high quality, usability, clear data definitions, and semantic richness to support consumption by both human analysts and Graphite-powered AI agents
3. Implement robust ETL/ELT workflows and contribute to modern patterns such as Zero ETL, data mesh, and standardized ingestion frameworks that reduce data movement and accelerate time-to-insight
4. Ensure end-to-end data quality, observability, and governance through validation, monitoring, lineage, and metadata management (e.g., AWS DataZone), building trust in datasets across the organization
5. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (analytics, finance, data science, ML engineering) to translate business needs into scalable, well-modeled data solutions
6. Drive Operational Excellence through Full CD Pipeline adoption and AI-first approaches — including proactive anomaly detection, automated root cause analysis, and self-healing workflows — to shift from reactive operations to predictive, autonomous data platform reliability

About the team
The AR Data Engineering (ARDE) team builds the data foundation that powers every Accounts Receivable decision at Amazon — trusted, near real-time, and self-serve. We develop entity-centric data products spanning collections, cash management, customer contacts, and billing, enabling FinOps leaders, automation platforms, and analytics partners to discover, access, and act on AR data independently. We are evolving from a proven Data Mesh serving thousands of users into a cognitive data layer — powered by Graphite — that compounds institutional knowledge, accelerates decision velocity, and drives operational autonomy across Amazon Finance.

title: Computer Specialist 23
description:
PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Home Energy Assistance Program (HEAP), which provides eligible low-income households with financial assistance to cover heating and cooling expenses. The program offers several types of assistance, including regular emergency benefits, as well as assistance with heating equipment repairs and replacements. Regular HEAP benefits are available to eligible households once per program year. The amount of assistance varies depending on household size, income, and energy costs. Emergency HEAP benefits are available to eligible households in crisis situations, such as a heating emergency or danger of a utility shut-off. Emergency benefits are available from January through March and can provide a one-time payment to cover energy costs. HEAP also helps with heating equipment repairs and replacements through the Heating Equipment Repair and Replacement Program (HERR). Eligible households can receive assistance with repairs or replacement of malfunctioning heating equipment, such as furnaces or boilers. Overall, HEAP aims to assist eligible low-income households in New York City with their heating and cooling needs to ensure they can maintain a safe and healthy living environment. The HEAP application is designed using hybrid architecture that incorporates Microsoft Azure Cloud, Power Platform, Synapse Analytics, and on-premises services, enabling seamless data integration, advanced analytics, and scalable infrastructure.



Tasks & Duties

  • Monitor production systems to ensure stability and optimal performance during the stabilization phase.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve system, data, and integration issues in a timely manner.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive measures.
  • Collaborate with technical and business teams to address production incidents and service requests.
  • Support performance tuning and optimization across Azure, Power Platform, Synapse Analytics, and on-premises components.
  • Manage Payment Processing Operations
  • Execute monthly payment processes, including PA/NPA and HEAP365, in accordance with business rules and timelines.
  • Manage and run annual autopayment processes, including Autoheaters and SSI.
  • Validate payment data for accuracy, completeness, and compliance prior to execution.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve payment processing issues and discrepancies.
  • Ensure timely completion of all payment cycles and coordinate with stakeholders on status and outcomes.
  • Develop and Deliver Reporting Solutions
  • Design, develop, and maintain real-time, scheduled, and ad hoc reports based on business requirements.
  • Provide rapid turnaround for urgent reporting requests from business stakeholders.
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of all reported data across systems.
  • Develop and optimize queries, dashboards, and data extracts using Synapse Analytics and related tools.
  • Perform data validation and reconciliation to support reporting outputs and business decisions. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Support System Enhancements and Continuous Improvement
  • Analyze business requirements and implement system enhancements and configuration changes.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to design and deploy new features and improvements.

  • Provide knowledge transfer and guidance to team members as needed.

MANDATORY SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

Note: Candidates who do not have the mandatory skills will not be considered

  • A minimum of 4 years of experience with the following skill sets:
  • Microsoft Azure (Cloud & Hybrid Architecture) and Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate)

title: Senior Preconstruction Manager, AMER, GREF – Workplace Design & Construction (WD&C)
description:
The Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) team provides real estate transaction expertise, business partnering, space & occupancy planning, workplace design and construction, capital investment program management and facility maintenance and operations for Amazon’s corporate office portfolio across multiple countries. We partner with suppliers to ensure quality, innovation, and operational excellence with Amazon’s business and utilize customer driven feedback to continuously improve and exceed employee expectations.

GREF’s Workplace Design and Construction team is looking for a Preconstruction Manager for tenant improvements and renovations. This individual is responsible for scoping, design, and preconstruction activities. This individual will collaborate with internal GREF stakeholders and customers through the project planning and initiation phases to align on scope, budget, and schedule. This individual must be comfortable operating on both strategic and tactical levels, acting as an internal ambassador, educator, analyst, and implementer from a design and construction perspective. The role involves procuring and managing vendor/contractor performance to ensure timely completion, compliance with cost requirements, organizational standards, and other requirements and regulations.

This position requires travel up to 40% within assigned regions.




Key job responsibilities
- Work closely with GREF stakeholders, including portfolio managers, portfolio strategy, occupancy planning, design/sustainability/engineer managers, transaction managers, and finance
- Focus on due diligence, scope creation, draft project charters for renovations and new build design direction
- Prepare budgets for forecast and approval, estimate schedules for renovations and new build construction, and prepare the project to hand off to the design and construction execution teams
- Procure and manage external architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, and/or subcontractors
- Ensure decisions are made at the appropriate level and Amazon's priorities remain the driving factor. Lead constructive dialogue to resolve and prevent project issues
- Identify and mitigate risk, keep the scope under control, accelerate progress with timely decisions, identify and clear blockers, escalate appropriately, and ensure compliance with contracts and regulations
- Understand design and construction contracts, exhibits, and provide detailed analysis and approvals of technical matters
- Review and advise on landlord delivery conditions in LOI and lease documents, including premises delivery timing and condition





A day in the life
Each day you will represent GREF providing input for the on time and in budget execution of Amazon construction projects, while improving processes. Daily tasks may comprise of long-range strategy discussions, early scope and budget creation, project team procurement, supporting LOI and lease language negotiations, and utilizing the Amazon information systems to record and update key project developments. Each day you will be navigating through uncertainty, proactively unblocking project barriers and influencing the best project decisions. You will be negotiating terms of contracts with designers, contractors, and consultants all the while driving to meet or exceed schedules of the approved scope. Daily tasks may be comprised of stakeholder management, coordinating with internal teams/vendors/contractors on projected changes and status, providing input to for strategy and lease docs, ensuring vendors and contractors are meeting their obligations, seeking sustainable environmentally friendly solutions throughout the design and construction process. You will participate in weekly meetings providing input on root causes and corrective action as may be required. You will be tactical and strategic working independently, interacting with leadership to resolve issues. You will provide estimating support, interpret drawings, create budgets, and review/approve lease exhibits. Preconstruction management includes site validation due diligence, scope development, validation of checklists, and construction documentation of existing conditions. You will understand zoning/planning, life safety/fire, and building code. You act as the primary escalation point for project team members and customers; owning and tracking issues to ensure that they are addressed, documented, and resolved using influence to manage team members.

About the team
At Amazon, we are all owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the design review, permitting, to construction bidding and consultant during construction execution prior to final hand-off to our internal stakeholder. We are a diverse, upbeat, creative, team of designers, engineers and managers working daily to develop innovative sustainable facilities and efficient innovative buildings for our customers. We focus on Delivering Results, our speed for Bias for Action and Insisting on the Highest Standards for our customers.

description:

This is not a developer-only or task-oriented role. The position requires strong hands-on UiPath expertise combined with a production-first mindset, analytical troubleshooting ability, incident ownership, client communication, and operational leadership.

Apply today and help us improve lives—one patient at a time.

title: Director of Growth
description:
About Vaultes

Vaultes is a rapidly growing engineering firm focused on Frictionless cybersecurity and digital government services headquartered in the Washington DC metro area. Serving customers across the Federal government and commercial sectors, we use our broad experience and deep technical expertise to implement customized solutions that enable mission achievement and secure the world through technology.

Frictionless Collaboration: We lead with humility and are easy to work with. Our ego-less, one-team mindset keeps progress moving.

Accountable & Adaptable: We do what we say we will and own our outcomes. Rooted in a growth mindset, we flex with change and stay aligned to mission needs.

Secure by Design: We protect what matters most. Security and integrity guide our decisions, ensuring resilience and confidence for our clients and partners.

Trusted Partners: We work side by side with clients and colleagues, earning trust through accountability, openness, and shared success.


About the Role

The Director of Growth is a strategic, results-driven leader responsible for growing Vaultes's portfolio across Federal and SLED markets. The successful candidate takes a proactive, mission-focused approach to identifying, qualifying, and shaping opportunities, building trusted relationships with government stakeholders, and positioning Vaultes as a long-term partner of choice.


As a small, agile firm, our BD professionals operate across the full business development lifecycle. The title says Director, but this role requires someone who leads from the front and isn't afraid to do the work. While the primary focus is relationship-focused, pipeline development, and opportunity pursuit, the right candidate will also step into capture leadership on select strategic pursuits, owning the win strategy from early shaping through proposal delivery.


The ideal candidate is equal parts strategist and executor, someone who brings deep market knowledge, strong relationships and relationship instincts, and the hunger to build something meaningful. For the right person, this is more than a job title. It is a chance to grow with Vaultes, shape the BD function, and one day lead a team of their own.


The annual salary range is $155,000 - $225,000 which is based on qualifications, skills, and relevant experience. This position is also eligible for performance-based bonuses.


Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of Federal and SLED opportunities, leveraging market intelligence, contract vehicles, industry networks, and strategic partnerships to meet revenue targets and long-term growth goals.
  • Develop and refine Vaultes messaging for specific markets, agencies, and opportunities from capability briefs and one-pagers to executive presentations and white papers.
  • Navigate the full government procurement lifecycle, including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and contract vehicle utilization (e.g., IDIQs, BPAs, GWACs), with an understanding of small business set-asides, socioeconomic categories, and teaming strategies.
  • Lead capture on select strategic opportunities, driving win strategy, competitive positioning, price-to-win analysis, teaming decisions, and proposal development from early shaping through delivery.
  • Maintain and manage CRM and pipeline tools such as NextStage, Salesforce, HigherGov or GovWin, ensuring accurate forecasting, opportunity tracking, and pipeline hygiene.
  • Protect and grow existing accounts by identifying recompete risks early, strengthening client relationships, and positioning Vaultes for contract renewals and expansions.
  • Partner with delivery teams to ensure a seamless transition from capture to execution, including client onboarding and project kickoff.
  • Establish, maintain, and strengthen trusted relationships with government stakeholders, industry partners, and decision-makers to foster long-term growth and repeat business.
  • Represent Vaultes at industry events, conferences, and forums, and actively participate in organizations such as ACT-IAC, AFFIRM, NVSBC, and AFCEA to expand visibility and strategic relationships.
  • Monitor federal and SLED market trends, including budget cycles, policy changes, and the competitive landscape, to proactively identify and shape new opportunities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of business growth objectives.

title: Hammashoitaja, Hämeenlinna
description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt hammashoitajaa Hämeenlinnaan.

Mitä työ hammashoitajana pitää sisällään?Hammashoitajana Terveystalon Suunterveydessä pääset mukaan tarjoamaan potilaslähtöistä ja kustannustehokasta suunterveydenhoitoa. Terveystalossa tulet työpaikkaan, jossa sekä hoidon laatu että potilaidemme ja ammattilaistemme hyvinvointi ovat aina etusijalla. Tarjoamme monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia yli kolmessakymmenessä toimipaikassamme ympäri Suomen. Yksityisen sektorin suunterveyden palvelumme kattavat kaikki hammaslääketieteen erikoisalat.Hämeenlinnan hammashoitolamme sijaitsee samoissa tiloissa Terveystalon lääkäriaseman kanssa kauppakeskus Goodmannissa, joten pääset mukaan suureen työyhteisöön. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat hammashoitajan työtehtävät, kuten hammaslääkärin avustaminen, välinehuollon työtehtävät ja osaamisesi mukaisesti erikoishammaslääkärin avustus. Pääset siis hyödyntämään ja kartuttamaan osaamistasi monipuolisten palveluidemme parissa. Tiimissämme työskentelee hammashoitajien ja suuhygienistien lisäksi hammaslääkärit, erikoishammaslääkärit ja asiakaspalvelun henkilökunta. Suunterveydessä hoidamme instrumenttihuollon itse.






Työsuhde on määräaikainen ja osa-aikainen (20h/vk, kolmen viikon tasoittumisjaksolla) 31.5.2027 asti. Työpäivien pituus vaihtelee ja otamme aina sinun toiveesi huomioon. Kehittämällä jatkuvasti toimintaamme varmistamme, että voimme tarjota asiakkaillemme parhaan mahdollisen hoidon. Näemme potilaan terveydenhoidon kokonaisuutena, johon suunterveys kuuluu olennaisena osana. Potilaskeskeinen, ammattirajat ylittävä yhteistyö on meillä mahdollista: sisäisen lähettämisen mallimme tuo potilaan keskiöön ja edesauttaa terveysvaikutteista työtämme uudella tavalla. Tule mukaan vahvistamaan moniammatillista yhteistyötä!

Lue lisää Terveystalossa työskentelystä täältä.

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Meillä arki rakentuu sujuvuudesta ja toisista välittämisestä, jatkuvasta halusta kehittyä ja ennen kaikkea inhimillisistä kohtaamisista. Vaikka maailma muuttuu, meidän tapamme tehdä työtä säilyy: Terveystalossa sinä voit keskittyä tekemään sitä, mikä on tärkeintä – terveyttä.

- Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö, joustavuus ja edistykselliset hoitopolkumme tukevat arjen työtä.
- Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä.
- Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun.
- Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme.
- Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen.
Terveystalossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia riippumatta sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä tai kansallisesta taustasta, kansalaisuudesta, kielestä, uskonnosta, vakaumuksesta, mielipiteestä, vammasta, terveydentilasta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta tai muusta ominaisuudesta.
- Houkutteleva kokonaispalkitseminen monipuolisine etuineen. Tarjoamme ammattilaisillemme monipuoliset työsuhteen edut, kuten lounas- sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun, kumppanialennukset ja kattavan työterveyshuollon, joka sisältää peruspalveluiden lisäksi muun muassa lähetteelliset erikoislääkärikäynnit ja laajasti mielen hyvinvoinnin palveluita, mm. lyhytpsykoterapian. - Kattava tuki ja perehdys esihenkilötyöhön, kuten esihenkilöakatemia ja kuukausittaiset esihenkilöinfot.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Pätevyysvaatimuksena on hammashoitajan tai lähihoitaja suunterveyden tutkinto. Arvostamme asiakaslähtöistä ja ammatillista osaamista sekä rentoa asennetta.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Jätä yhteystietosi hakulomakkeen kautta viimeistään 20.9.2026. Meille jokainen hakija on tärkeä. Siksi meillä jokaisen hakemuksen lukee aina ihminen. Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Mahdollisiin kysymyksiin vastaa mielellään palveluvastaava suunterveys Anne Suontausta (p. 040 561 8572, anne.suontausta@terveystalo.com).

Tervetuloa Terveystaloon!

title: Senior Director, Analytical Sciences
description:
ABOUT VERRICA PHARMACEUTICALS

At Verrica Pharmaceuticals Inc. (“Verrica”) we are passionate about developing innovative therapies for dermatological diseases, including skin cancers. Our commercial product, YCANTH, is the first FDA-approved treatment for molluscum contagiosum, a skin infection commonly affecting children, and we have several future products in development. If you love having direct access to senior leaders and an opportunity to excel in a fast-paced, small-pharma environment, we’re the team for you.

POSITION SUMMARY

As Senior Director, Analytical Sciences, you will be responsible for providing analytical strategy and oversight, for testing of Verrica's pharmaceutical products, including: vendor management; document preparation for regulatory submissions; specification setting; analytical test method development, method validation, method transfer, and stability programs for drug substances, raw materials, and drug products; and device characterization and performance testing.

SUMMARY OF POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Analytical Sciences Strategy and Execution

  • Develop CMC Department’s analytical strategy in alignment with company objectives and drive execution of such strategy.
  • Set specifications and provide technical oversight of all analytical testing to advance R&D clinical projects and deliver commercial supplies.
  • Direct analytical method development, validation, and transfer for small molecule and peptide drug substances, raw materials, and drug products.
  • Manage product and analytical lifecycle changes and drive improvements for drug substance, raw materials, and drug product.
  • Direct external consultants, contract labs, contract supplier technical teams, and other external technical resources.
  • Design and execute appropriate drug substance and drug product stability programs to support product development, registration, and commercial supply.
  • Prepare supporting documentation for technical projects including risk assessments, data analysis, and technical reports, as required.

Data Quality and Regulatory Analysis

  • Review analytical release and stability data and perform data analysis and trending in support of projects.
  • Prepare analytical sections of regulatory submissions including IND, IMPDs, milestone briefing packages (Pre IND/NDA Meetings, EOP2 Agency Meetings), NDA, SNDA, MAA and other global regulatory submissions.
  • Work with Quality and Technical Operations teams and provide SME input to ensure all Out-of-Specification and Laboratory Investigation issues are investigated and resolved in a timely manner.
  • Interact with international regulatory agencies on CMC analytical topics, as appropriate.
  • Contribute to authoring and maintenance of SOPs appropriate for cGMP compliance.

Maintain Operational Excellence

  • Act as Subject Matter Expert across the company to support decisions, solve problems, and drive improvements in clinical, non-clinical, regulatory, operations, and product development functions.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and external SMEs, as needed.
  • Monitor and drive vendor performance.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • PhD degree in Analytical Chemistry or related field. At least 15+ years of progressively responsible experience in Analytical Sciences within the pharmaceutical and/or medical device industries, combination products, peptides, small molecules, CMC, drug substance and drug product, clinical and non-clinical.
  • Must have knowledge of the relevant regulations, regulatory process, and requirements
  • Extensive experience in Drug Product analysis including Raw Materials, Specifications, method development, method validation, and method transfer
  • Must have demonstrated experience in managing teams of diverse analytical backgrounds including analytical work at CRO/CDMOs
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Commitment to Verrica’s vision, mission, core values and culture.

PHYSICAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Must be able to sit for extended periods of time at a desk. Normal requirements for office operations with respect to lifting, standing and walking.

JOIN US!

For the opportunity to be part of a ground-floor commercial team at a growing pharmaceutical company

  • Autonomy, trust, and the ability to help shape access strategy—not just execute it
  • A fast-moving culture where your voice matters and your work has real impact
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits
  • Performance-based discretionary bonus compensation
  • This position includes medical, dental, vision insurance as well as a 401k plan and paid time off

If you’re passionate about helping patients access medicines, energized by challenge, and excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of dermatology — let’s talk!

title: Principal Software Engineer, AI Inference Runtime
description:
As a Principal Software Engineer on our AI Inference Runtime team, you will set technical direction for critical components of distributed Inference runtime for running SOTA AI Models.

You will lead hands-on work across scheduling, batching, KV-cache management, memory allocation, distributed workload execution, kernel development and optimization, and performance benchmarking and analysis. Your work will directly influence how efficiently new models use available compute. Partnering with our AI Infrastructure, compute, and product teams to enhance the performance and efficiency of Arm’s AI platform.

Responsibilities:

  • Define the architecture, interfaces, and roadmap for AI inference runtime capabilities, including abstractions that support evolving models, workloads, and compute platforms.
  • Enable new model architectures end to end through operator support, production validation, and optimization of scheduling, batching, model execution, memory management, and KV-cache efficiency.
  • Profile system bottlenecks and develop optimized kernels and data-movement paths across compute, memory, networking, and framework integration.
  • Evaluate new inference techniques and build benchmarking, regression, validation, and safe-rollout systems to improve latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.
  • Partner with cloud, framework, compiler, hardware, and research teams; lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, and establish meticulous performance-engineering practices.

Required Skills and Experience :

  • 8+ years of experience, or equivalent demonstrated impact, in ML systems, high-performance systems, compilers, kernel development, or production AI inference.
  • Deep understanding of modern AI inference, including model execution, Attention, MoE, batching, prioritisation, and KV-cache behavior.
  • Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, Python, or a comparable language, with knowledge of concurrency, parallel programming, handling of memory resources, and data movement.
  • Proven ability to profile, debug, and optimize performance across kernels, runtimes, frameworks, operating systems, and hardware.

“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :

  • Experience developing or modifying inference schedulers, cache managers, batching systems, disaggregated or distributed execution paths.
  • Experience optimizing kernels using accelerator programming tools, assembly, or intrinsics, including attention, matrix multiplication, operator fusion, and low-precision execution.
  • Familiarity with model parallelism, collective communication, high-performance networking, compilers, or graph optimization.
  • Contributions to open-source ML runtimes, frameworks, compilers, or kernel libraries.

In Return:

You will be part of our AI Platforms team - A driven and diverse group passionate about developing foundational production capabilities to support AI inference at Arm. We provide a collaborative setting where your ideas can come to life quickly. The success of our AI projects will be directly influenced by your work, crafting the company’s AI inference capabilities and defining and operating production inference workloads. This is an outstanding opportunity to work with world-class teams and contribute to groundbreaking advances in AI technology. Join us in building the next generation of AI inference infrastructure!

$262,700-$355,400 per year

title: Engineer - Electric Controls
description:
Wisconsin Electric Power, a subsidiary of WEC Energy Group, is seeking an Engineer - Electric Controls in our Milwaukee, Wisconsin location.

This position is part of a job family (Associate Engineer, Engineer, and Senior Engineer) where experience will be the determining factor.

About Us

WEC Energy Group is one of the nation’s largest electric generation and distribution and natural gas delivery holding companies serving 4.7 million customers across the Midwest. We are committed to providing clean, reliable, and affordable energy in an environmentally sustainable manner. Customers are the heart of our business, and we work every day to help grow and support communities where we provide vital energy services.

As a Fortune 500 company, we value and develop our employees who are making a difference in a mission that matters. We don’t just offer a job; we provide fulfilling careers where safety and well-being are paramount. Join our team and experience first-hand our commitment to your success. We offer competitive pay and benefits to recognize your hard work and dedication.

If you’re talented, energetic and ready for a career with a future, we want you on our team. We are powered by a diverse and inclusive workforce fueled by the pride in what we do. If you're driven by the passion to change lives, this is the place for you.

Job Summary

This Engineer is part of the Distribution Automation unit within the Electric Distribution Asset Management department. The Engineer will provide engineering expertise in the management of SCADA equipment and services for electric distribution substations, electric distribution line devices, balancing authority metering, and generation facilities (both new renewable and existing sites).

Job Responsibilities

  • Engineer, design, procure, install and commission automation, control, communication, and metering solutions for electric distribution substation and line devices, electric generation facilities, and balancing authority metering.
  • Analyze and upgrade existing substation RTUs and control systems (communications reliability, cost reductions, service hours, obsolescence, required maintenance, etc.)
  • Support SCADA and Relay Technicians with field support, training, and engineering guidance
  • Provide technical support for corporate functions in NERC CIP compliance.
  • Manage electrical/controls projects during the engineering, design, and execution phases to ensure changes to scope and schedule are warranted, understood, controlled, and documented.
  • Troubleshoot resolve, and evaluate unique equipment and communication issues.
  • Provide work direction to other engineering groups and field employees to ensure proper implementation of projects and/or solve problems.
  • Occasional travel to We Energies Distribution and Power Generation facilities throughout Wisconsin and the Upper Peninsula of Michigan is expected in addition to attendance at conferences and other business travel.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering degree (December 2026 graduates are eligible to apply)
  • Valid driver’s license and meet the company’s requirements for driving
  • Candidates must be willing to travel to other company locations and be willing to be called in during off hours if a problem arises

This position requires unescorted access to certain critical cyber assets which would require applicants to satisfy all Company and NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection Standard 004 security requirements, which includes a background investigation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written are essential
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Experience engineering, programming, troubleshooting, or testing programmable logic controllers, distribution control systems, and human machine interfaces

title: Project Supervisors - NEEDHAM MARKET
description:
PROJECT SUPERVISORS



Needham Market ( Suffolk) Please note the office will be relocating to Stow Market later this year



Salary - £32,977 - £35,665



PERMANENT CONTRACTS

Subject to successful completion of 6-month probationary period.


Cotswold Archaeology continues to grow as a sustainable and strong business, which currently employs over 350 full-time staff, working as one company across four offices.

Our success relies on the talent and hard work of all our employees, and we are looking to recruit Project Supervisors along with Project Officers and Senior Project Officers who are ready to take the next step in their career able to lead large and complex archaeological projects.

All of our Project Supervisors and Project Officers are expected to take leading roles in the publication of our work; publication, dissemination and outreach being the fundamental drivers for everything we do.

For Project Supervisor and Project Officer roles, membership of the CIfA at PCIfA level is desirable
(or able to demonstrate that you meet the requirements and a commitment to join if appointed)

Senior Project Officer role membership is essential at least to ACIFA level.


Our awarding winning training programmes provide support throughout all of the stages of your career which is demonstrated by the progression of many colleagues from site archaeologist to managers and technical specialists.



What we offer



A starting salary well above the CIfA minimum,

  • Project Supervisors - £32,977 - £35,665 (Dependent on Experience)
  • Project Officer - £37,021 - £39,718 (Dependent on Experience)
  • Senior Project Officers - £41,075 - £43,792 (Dependent on Experience)

A highly competitive benefits package including:

  • Defined Pension scheme
  • Life assurance scheme
  • 31 days leave (including Bank Holidays) – increasing with length of service
  • A lieu and overtime scheme operated for all driving time, and time spent in excess of 45 minutes each way as a passenger, outside of the normal 7.5 hour working day (accumulate up to 10 days additional lieu time annually)
  • Good quality accommodation, and subsistence payments for all away projects
  • Paid CIfA membership subscription
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Personal protective equipment will be issued for the duration of employment.

Possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or recent CSCS test pass is desirable. Currently new CSCS cards are not being issued to the archaeological sector, successful applicants without either a current and valid CSCS card or test pass, will be expected to pass either the CITB HS&E Operatives or Managers Test, which will be arranged and paid for by CA.





A full driving licence and ability/willingness to drive company vehicles (4x4s, Transit Vans) is essential.

Cotswold Archaeology has projects located in the vicinity of our offices, but in these roles, there will be a requirement to be rostered on protracted away projects where we will provide accommodation and the opportunity to accrue lieu and overtime.

Where away work is required good quality accommodation will be provided, along with subsistence payments (£24 per each night where eligible)

Please note all salaries quoted are annual equivalents based on a 37.5-hour week. We are unable to offer contracts with the provision of 7 day a week accommodated away work.



How to apply



To submit an application and cover letter please visit our recruitment page where you will also find full job descriptions for each role.

Closing date: Applications need to be submitted by 5pm -Wednesday 30th September 2026 however, we will be reviewing applications as they are submitted and making offers where possible.

If you are interested the roles and would like to know more, we would recommend an informal discussion with

Richard Greatorex – Principal Fieldwork Manager – Andover (07703 684031)

Steve Sheldon, Principal Fieldwork Manager – Kemble (07711 849780)

Adrian Scruby, Principal Fieldwork Manager – Milton Keynes (07718 485229)

Stuart Boulter, Principal Fieldwork Manager - Needham Market (07885 223524)

Alternatively, we can arrange for you to speak to one of our existing Project Officers about their experience of working at Cotswold Archaeology.

Cotswold Archaeology is an equal opportunities employer. All applications are assessed solely on the candidate’s relevant skills and experience relevant to the role.

We will take into consideration any reasonable adjustments required to support you. Should you need adjustments during the recruitment process, or require additional support related to neurodiversity or for any other reason, please let us know by contacting careers@cotswoldarchaeology.co.uk

Applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in the UK as defined by UK Visas and Immigration





Job Description

Role - Project Supervisor

Pay Scale: 14-16

Department - Fieldwork

Location: Needham Market

Report to: Project Officer

Responsible for: Archaeologists and Trainees



Purpose of role

To lead specified fieldwork projects, ensuring performance targets are met (or exceeded), and assuring the quality of archaeological recording and understanding. To assist in the supervision of larger/more complex projects led by a Senior Project/Project Officer



Main duties and responsibilities:

  • Deliver own fieldwork projects to time, budget, quality and health and safety requirements.
  • Assist in the development of Archaeologists and Trainees through regular performance reviews and constructive feedback, providing appropriate tool-box talks and coaching.

Assure the quality of archaeological understanding and site records, and oversee the compilation of archaeological archives to required standards (assist the Senior Project/Project Officer in these tasks on larger projects).

  • Author typescript fieldwork reports efficiently and accurately.
  • Monitor and provide regular reports to Project Manager/Senior Project/Project Officer on project progress (budgetary and archaeological), logistical, staff and health and safety issues, and to maintain appropriate liaison with clients, Local Government officers, and contractors.
  • Ensure accurate completion of appropriate administrative records, including timesheets, plant and allocation sheets.
  • Assist the Project Officer/Senior Project Officer with the supervision of larger fieldwork projects deputising for the PO/SPO where appropriate.
  • Ensure effective deployment, maintenance and care of vehicles, plant and equipment, and maintain/provide accurate records ensuring accidents, damage and malfunctions are reported promptly and appropriately.
  • Ensure fieldwork is carried out in accordance with the CA Health and Safety policy, and to prepare Risk Assessments and other relevant documentation.
  • Assist Project Managers in pre-project planning and preparation including undertaking the preparation of written schemes of investigation, trench plans, obtaining service information, notifying utility companies prior to excavation and making appropriate contact with landowners and agents and other relevant parties.
  • Contribute to departmental processes and working practices via Learning Reports, feedback to Committee Representatives and/or project leaders, and discussion at performance reviews.
  • Undertake additional duties appropriate to the role as required.


Personal specification

Essential

  • Sound knowledge of archaeological practice, including a general familiarity with the archaeology of Britain at all periods.
  • Experience of the supervision of small to medium-sized fieldwork projects (including evaluations and excavations).
  • The ability to author typescript fieldwork reports efficiently and accurately.
  • The ability to organise, motivate, train, appraise and direct staff.
  • Good working knowledge of all relevant Health and Safety requirements, and other relevant legislation.
  • The ability to communicate efficiently and courteously with sponsors and clients of CA, officers of other bodies and members of the public.
  • Administrative ability in the keeping of accurate records and accounts and the submission of reports.
  • A full manual driving licence.
  • Basic competence in Microsoft applications including Word and Excel.
  • Competent in carrying out first aid.

Desirable

  • Demonstrable potential to undertake stratigraphic analysis and contribute to post-excavation analysis and reporting.
  • Survey skills, including ability to operate Leica GPS/TST, and basic knowledge and understanding of CAD.
  • Experience of driving 4x4 vehicles, vans and minibuses.
  • Possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or recent CSCS test pass.
  • Membership of the Chartered Institute for Archaeologists

title: Ratkaisumyyjä, Palvelin-, Tallennus- & Verkkoratkaisut
description:
Ratkaisumyyjä, Palvelin-, Tallennus- & Verkkoratkaisut

Haluatko päästä mukaan rakentamaan IT-ratkaisuja, joita oikeasti myydään eikä vain suunnitella?

Haemme Tampereen toimistollemme Ratkaisumyyjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen vahvistamaan tuotemarkkinoinnin ja ratkaisumyynnin tiimiämme.

Tässä roolissa olet keskeinen osa myyntiä, jossa yhdistät teknisen osaamisen ja kaupallisen tekemisen. Olet luontevasti mukana asiakastapaamisissa, ratkaisujen suunnittelussa sekä tarjousten rakentamisessa aina kaupan syntymiseen saakka.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Rooli tarjoaa monipuolisen yhdistelmän teknistä asiantuntijuutta, kaupallista tekemistä ja yhteistyötä eri sidosryhmien kanssa. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

  • palvelin-, tallennus-, ja verkkoratkaisujen suunnittelu ja tuotteistaminen jälleenmyyjille

  • tarjousten laatiminen sekä myynnin kaupallinen tuki

  • tiivis yhteistyö myynnin, asiakkaiden ja teknologiavalmistajien kanssa

  • osallistuminen markkinointiaktiviteettien ja kampanjoiden suunnitteluun

Menestyt tehtävässä, jos

sinulla on tekninen tai kaupallinen tausta (koulutus tai työkokemus) sekä kokemusta tai kiinnostusta IT-tuotteista ja asiakasrajapinnassa toimimisesta. Haluat tehdä tuloksellista ratkaisumyyntiä ja syventää osaamistasi palvelin-, tallennus- ja verkkoratkaisuissa.

Toivomme, että:

  • olet tavoitteellinen, aktiivinen ja itseohjautuva

  • sinulla on myynnillinen asenne sekä halu saada asioita tapahtumaan

  • olet kiinnostunut asiakkaiden tarpeista ja sinulla on ratkaisukeskeinen työote

  • pystyt työskennellä myös englanniksi sekä omaat hyvät tietotekniset taidot.

Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata entuudestaan, sillä etsimme henkilöä, joka haluaa kehittyä ja on valmis ottamaan vastuuta nopeastikin. Voit olla urasi alkuvaiheessa tai kerryttänyt hieman kokemusta, meille tärkeintä on kuitenkin motivoitunut asenne.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Meillä työskentelet kannustavassa ja ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössä, jossa pääset tekemään yhteistyötä mielenkiintoisten kumppaneidemme kanssa. Tarjoamme sinulle erinomaisen mahdollisuuden oppia ratkaisumyynnin ydinosaamisen ja näköalapaikan IT-alan viimeisimpiin teknologioihin sekä kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten liikunta- ja lounasedun.

Yhteinen intohimomme on auttaa asiakkaitamme saavuttamaan tavoitteensa ja toimia alamme parhaina asiantuntijoina.

Alkaako seuraava askel urallasi meiltä? Lähetä hakemuksesi sekä CV palkkatoiveineen sunnuntaihin 27.9.2026 mennessä hakuportaalimme kautta. Kerro meille, mikä tehtävässä herätti mielenkiintosi ja miten voisit hyödyntää osaamistasi meillä. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

title: Painepesutyöntekijä, töitä lumien tuloon saakka, aloitus HETI, NOKIA/ PIRKANMAA
description:
Sinä fyysisestä työstä tykkäävä henkilö, tule meille Nokialle/ Pirkanmaan alueelle tekemään mm. painepesurilla tehtävää pesutyötä! Työt alkavat heti ja jatkuvat lumien tuloon saakka. Palkka on vähintään 14€/h ja töitä on tarjolla 30-40h/ vko.
Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat painepesut, korkeapainepesut jne. Tarvitset työssäsi ajokortin ja oman auton, jotta pääset liikkumaan kohteille. Asiakasyrityksen hallitilat sijaitsevat Nokialla, töitä tehdään Nokialla ja Pirkanmaan alueella. Työssä käytetään erilaisia kemikaaleja, joten tulet käyttämään erilaisia suojaimia työskennellessäsi.
Työ on fyysisesti raskasta. Haemme tehtävään henkilöä, joka pystyy tekemään töitä itsenäisesti ja pääsee aloittamaan työt heti saman tien! Eduksi tehtävässä on se, mikäli sinulta löytyy työturvallisuuskortti.
Työsuhteessa sovelletaan kipan työehtosopimusta. Palkka on vähintään 14€/h kokemuksesta ja osaamisesta riippuen. Töitä on tarjolla 30-40h/ vko.
Työstä, asiakkaastamme ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää työhaastattelussa.
Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!



---




Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.


Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Lakeview Recovery Community - Program Lead
description:
Program Lead

Lakeview Recovery Community



*This position is located onsite in Gunn, AB, 45 minutes outside of Edmonton*

At ROSC Solutions Group (RSG), we prioritize individuals' well-being and long-term recovery from addiction through a holistic, person-centered approach. Our evidence-based practices empower and foster hope, promoting personal growth. We collaborate with government officials and stakeholders to develop customized strategies grounded in recovery-oriented care principles. We drive positive change in creating pathways of recovery from addiction.

Our dedicated team brings together professionals with expertise and passion for addiction recovery. Recognizing the unique needs and challenges of each government, we customize our solutions to align with their specific goals, ensuring a maximum and lasting impact. Our services are firmly rooted in the latest research and evidence-based practices, staying ahead of emerging trends to provide the most effective solutions. Through successful partnerships with government entities and policymakers, we've played a key role in transforming addiction recovery systems into comprehensive, recovery-oriented care networks. Committed to excellence, our team offers continuous support and guidance throughout the entire process, from the initial needs assessment to the implementation and evaluation of programs. Together, we aim to make a significant difference in the lives of individuals affected by addiction, fueled by our passion for creating systems that prioritize long-term recovery, reduce stigma, and promote holistic well-being.

Reporting to the Program Director- the Program Lead will assist in leading our Therapeutic Community situated on a 40-acre facility approximately 45 minutes outside of Edmonton. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality addiction recovery services and maintaining compliance with internal and external quality standards, team supervisor and resident care.

Role-specific Accountabilities:

  • Provide visionary leadership for the addiction recovery program.
  • Facilitate therapeutic and psychoeducational groups that support the emotional, cognitive, and behavioural recovery of residents, using evidence-informed practices.
  • Ensure the adherence to evidence-based models in addiction treatment.
  • Implement and maintain governance structures to ensure quality program delivery.
  • Program facilitation for both one-to-one and group sessions, ensuring high standards of care.
  • Conduct regular evaluations of program effectiveness and make data-driven improvements.
  • Manage, nurture, and lead a team of dedicated staff, providing guidance and support.
  • Foster a positive and collaborative work environment.
  • Conduct regular performance evaluations and professional development for staff.
  • Utilize counseling expertise to contribute to the therapeutic aspects of the program.
  • Stay abreast of the latest developments in addiction counseling and treatment.
  • Manage a small caseload and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Ensure seamless coordination and execution of daily operations.
  • Ensure an excellent quality of care for clients by overseeing all aspects of the program.
  • Foster an environment that promotes the well-being and recovery of clients.
  • Maintain open and effective communication with both the immediate team and wider organizational stakeholders.
  • Promote a culture of transparency, collaboration, and accountability.
  • Implement strategies for client involvement, including observation and feedback mechanisms.
  • Incorporate client input into program improvements and modifications.
  • Ensure compliance with internal and external quality and regulatory standards.
  • Identify and address any gaps in areas of underperformance promptly.
  • Support in program scheduling, development and implementation.
  • Support the delivery of training and development opportunities.
  • Be available for on-call rota duties in a 24/7 facility, handling emergencies and urgent situations.
