title: Provisioning Engineer
description:
JOB SUMMARY:
Oversees moderately to highly complex circuit provisioning orders. Makes modifications to existing configurations as needed. Monitors an organization's telecommunications network. Tests and reviews an organization's telecommunications system to ensure dependable operation. Records and analyzes key performance metrics to monitor network conditions. Drafts and submits reports to assist with the development of telecommunications systems. Identifies network bottlenecks and recommends strategic improvements. Provides training and support on telecommunication functionality to customers.
This role is critical in ensuring accurate and efficient activation of customer services across our network infrastructure. You’ll be responsible for the configuration, deployment, and testing of services—ranging from voice, data, and internet to advanced enterprise connectivity solutions.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES, FUNCTIONS & KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES: (include but are not limited to)
  • Provision and configure customer and network services on telecommunications platforms (e.g., OSS/BSS systems, routers, switches, VoIP platforms).
  • Work with field engineers, NOC, and customer service teams to coordinate service activations, migrations, and upgrades.
  • Interpret service orders and translate them into technical configurations.
  • Maintain and update provisioning databases and documentation.
  • Conduct service verification testing to ensure proper functionality and adherence to SLAs.
  • Troubleshoot provisioning issues and escalate complex problems as needed.
  • Support network expansion and upgrade initiatives through provisioning tasks.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve automation and provisioning workflows.
KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:
  • Ability to analyze complex information, draw conclusions, and communicate findings
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills
  • Attention to quality and detail
  • Strong communication skills
BEHAVIOR:
Upholds and acts in accordance with REV’s Guiding Principles
EVALUATION:
Performance of this job will be evaluated in accordance with procedures established by the company.
QUALIFICATIONS & PREREQUISITES
  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2+ years of experience in a provisioning, network operations, or telecommunications engineering role.
  • Strong knowledge of networking technologies (IP, MPLS, VLANs), and telecom services (DSL, Fiber, T1, Ethernet, VoIP).
  • Experience with OSS/BSS platforms, provisioning systems, and ticketing tools.
  • Familiarity with telecom hardware vendors (Cisco, Juniper, Adtran, etc.) and configuration protocols.
  • Understanding of industry standards and compliance (e.g., MEF, ITU-T, IEEE).
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
PREFERRED:
  • Experience with scripting or automation tools (e.g., Python, Ansible).
  • Telecom certifications (e.g., CCNA, JNCIA).
  • Experience with service providers or carriers.
GENERAL INFORMATION:
This job description does not restrict the company’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job at any time. This job description is subject to change at any time.

title: Project Supervisors - MILTON KEYNES
description:
PROJECT SUPERVISORS



Milton Keynes



Salary - £32,977 - £35,665



PERMANENT CONTRACTS

Subject to successful completion of 6-month probationary period.


Cotswold Archaeology continues to grow as a sustainable and strong business, which currently employs over 350 full-time staff, working as one company across four offices.

Our success relies on the talent and hard work of all our employees, and we are looking to recruit Project Supervisors along with Project Officers and Senior Project Officers who are ready to take the next step in their career able to lead large and complex archaeological projects.

All of our Project Supervisors and Project Officers are expected to take leading roles in the publication of our work; publication, dissemination and outreach being the fundamental drivers for everything we do.

For Project Supervisor and Project Officer roles, membership of the CIfA at PCIfA level is desirable
(or able to demonstrate that you meet the requirements and a commitment to join if appointed)

Senior Project Officer role membership is essential at least to ACIFA level.


Our awarding winning training programmes provide support throughout all of the stages of your career which is demonstrated by the progression of many colleagues from site archaeologist to managers and technical specialists.



What we offer



A starting salary well above the CIfA minimum,

  • Project Supervisors - £32,977 - £35,665 (Dependent on Experience)
  • Project Officer - £37,021 - £39,718 (Dependent on Experience)
  • Senior Project Officers - £41,075 - £43,792 (Dependent on Experience)

A highly competitive benefits package including:

  • Defined Pension scheme
  • Life assurance scheme
  • 31 days leave (including Bank Holidays) – increasing with length of service
  • A lieu and overtime scheme operated for all driving time, and time spent in excess of 45 minutes each way as a passenger, outside of the normal 7.5 hour working day (accumulate up to 10 days additional lieu time annually)
  • Good quality accommodation, and subsistence payments for all away projects
  • Paid CIfA membership subscription
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Personal protective equipment will be issued for the duration of employment.

Possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or recent CSCS test pass is desirable. Currently new CSCS cards are not being issued to the archaeological sector, successful applicants without either a current and valid CSCS card or test pass, will be expected to pass either the CITB HS&E Operatives or Managers Test, which will be arranged and paid for by CA.





A full driving licence and ability/willingness to drive company vehicles (4x4s, Transit Vans) is essential.

Cotswold Archaeology has projects located in the vicinity of our offices, but in these roles, there will be a requirement to be rostered on protracted away projects where we will provide accommodation and the opportunity to accrue lieu and overtime.

Where away work is required good quality accommodation will be provided, along with subsistence payments (£24 per each night where eligible)

Please note all salaries quoted are annual equivalents based on a 37.5-hour week. We are unable to offer contracts with the provision of 7 day a week accommodated away work.



How to apply



To submit an application and cover letter please visit our recruitment page where you will also find full job descriptions for each role.

Closing date: Applications need to be submitted by 5pm -Wednesday 30th September 2026 however, we will be reviewing applications as they are submitted and making offers where possible.

If you are interested the roles and would like to know more, we would recommend an informal discussion with

Richard Greatorex – Principal Fieldwork Manager – Andover (07703 684031)

Steve Sheldon, Principal Fieldwork Manager – Kemble (07711 849780)

Adrian Scruby, Principal Fieldwork Manager – Milton Keynes (07718 485229)

Stuart Boulter, Principal Fieldwork Manager - Needham Market (07885 223524)

Alternatively, we can arrange for you to speak to one of our existing Project Officers about their experience of working at Cotswold Archaeology.

Cotswold Archaeology is an equal opportunities employer. All applications are assessed solely on the candidate’s relevant skills and experience relevant to the role.

We will take into consideration any reasonable adjustments required to support you. Should you need adjustments during the recruitment process, or require additional support related to neurodiversity or for any other reason, please let us know by contacting careers@cotswoldarchaeology.co.uk

Applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in the UK as defined by UK Visas and Immigration


Job Description

Role - Project Supervisor

Pay Scale: 14-16

Department - Fieldwork

Location: Milton Keynes

Report to: Project Officer

Responsible for: Archaeologists and Trainees



Purpose of role

To lead specified fieldwork projects, ensuring performance targets are met (or exceeded), and assuring the quality of archaeological recording and understanding. To assist in the supervision of larger/more complex projects led by a Senior Project/Project Officer



Main duties and responsibilities:

  • Deliver own fieldwork projects to time, budget, quality and health and safety requirements.
  • Assist in the development of Archaeologists and Trainees through regular performance reviews and constructive feedback, providing appropriate tool-box talks and coaching.

Assure the quality of archaeological understanding and site records, and oversee the compilation of archaeological archives to required standards (assist the Senior Project/Project Officer in these tasks on larger projects).

  • Author typescript fieldwork reports efficiently and accurately.
  • Monitor and provide regular reports to Project Manager/Senior Project/Project Officer on project progress (budgetary and archaeological), logistical, staff and health and safety issues, and to maintain appropriate liaison with clients, Local Government officers, and contractors.
  • Ensure accurate completion of appropriate administrative records, including timesheets, plant and allocation sheets.
  • Assist the Project Officer/Senior Project Officer with the supervision of larger fieldwork projects deputising for the PO/SPO where appropriate.
  • Ensure effective deployment, maintenance and care of vehicles, plant and equipment, and maintain/provide accurate records ensuring accidents, damage and malfunctions are reported promptly and appropriately.
  • Ensure fieldwork is carried out in accordance with the CA Health and Safety policy, and to prepare Risk Assessments and other relevant documentation.
  • Assist Project Managers in pre-project planning and preparation including undertaking the preparation of written schemes of investigation, trench plans, obtaining service information, notifying utility companies prior to excavation and making appropriate contact with landowners and agents and other relevant parties.
  • Contribute to departmental processes and working practices via Learning Reports, feedback to Committee Representatives and/or project leaders, and discussion at performance reviews.
  • Undertake additional duties appropriate to the role as required.


Personal specification

Essential

  • Sound knowledge of archaeological practice, including a general familiarity with the archaeology of Britain at all periods.
  • Experience of the supervision of small to medium-sized fieldwork projects (including evaluations and excavations).
  • The ability to author typescript fieldwork reports efficiently and accurately.
  • The ability to organise, motivate, train, appraise and direct staff.
  • Good working knowledge of all relevant Health and Safety requirements, and other relevant legislation.
  • The ability to communicate efficiently and courteously with sponsors and clients of CA, officers of other bodies and members of the public.
  • Administrative ability in the keeping of accurate records and accounts and the submission of reports.
  • A full manual driving licence.
  • Basic competence in Microsoft applications including Word and Excel.
  • Competent in carrying out first aid.

Desirable

  • Demonstrable potential to undertake stratigraphic analysis and contribute to post-excavation analysis and reporting.
  • Survey skills, including ability to operate Leica GPS/TST, and basic knowledge and understanding of CAD.
  • Experience of driving 4x4 vehicles, vans and minibuses.
  • Possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or recent CSCS test pass.
  • Membership of the Chartered Institute for Archaeologists

title: Media Systems Engineer II
company: Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology
location: Burbank, California, United States of America
description:
Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

  • Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
  • Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.
  • Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams.

Disney Media Engineers have a clear charter: to transform the capability and flexibility of how Disney acquires, produces, and distributes content worldwide, all while ensuring the highest levels of quality, efficiency, and resiliency.

Disney Media Engineers often find themselves at the crossroads between hardware and software-based technology and must possess a comprehensive theoretical and practical understanding of the technology that powers the generation, monetization, and distribution of all forms of consumer- facing linear and digital video/audio content. Responsibility includes numerous systems such as Playout Technology, Studios, Production Control Rooms, Remote Production, Post-Production, Contribution/Distribution Systems, Networking, Cloud Compute, Production Software and Virtual Environment and more.

The Media Systems Engineer II position is another step toward technical proficiency. The Media Systems Engineer II primarily focuses on architecting, designing, and constructing the varied technical platforms that power our linear and digital platforms. The Media Systems Engineer II position will work closely under the direction of more senior engineers and 3rd party partners to develop technology that efficiently and effectively delivers on the requirements set forth by technical, business or operations leaders.

Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:

  • Architect, design, source, and construct media technology environments that allow DEEP&T Technology the ability to acquire, produce, store, stream, distribute our content.
  • Resolve issues that affect production, broadcast, and content distribution across multiple DEEP&T networks including system outages, malfunctions, and related technical problems, and conduct diagnostic testing, repair, and replacement activities necessary to solve routine, specialized, and complex problems.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot streaming audio/video signals in traditional SDI and IP 2110 essence flow routing environments.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot cloud platforms as necessary.
  • Manage third-party service providers by enforcing the agreed upon scope of services within the various signed service agreements (i.e., full time, freelance, union agencies, maintenance providers, contractors, service providers, etc.).
  • Select, train, motivate and evaluate technical staff; provide or coordinate staff training; work with employees to correct deficiencies; implement discipline procedures.
  • Specify and procure equipment, supplies and materials for Media technology systems within budget guidelines; receive and maintain equipment and supplies.
  • Develop long range plans for future media technology needs, including capital improvements, to enhance production and distribution capabilities.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of policies and procedures regarding technology facilities with a focus on maximizing the integration of all systems to meet business, marketing, and entertainment goals.
  • Provide operational support of all activities related to operating, maintaining, and programming the audio and video production/distribution systems across the enterprise and other connected properties.
  • Utilize system software health and performance monitoring platforms; troubleshoot and participate in repairing system problems and failures, participates in maintenance of systems, installs software patches, updates etc., to resolve and avoid service problems, and troubleshoots system problems as they relate to these services
  • Performs upgrades to system hardware and software workflows under the supervision of a more experienced engineer or supervisor.
  • Participates in complex engineering projects at the direction of more experienced engineers.
  • Reviews, maintains, and contributes to system/workflow documentation.
  • Participates in training and development objectives. Conducts peer training and development sessions.
  • Extraordinary influencer who is skilled at connecting the dots at the organization, strategy, program, project, and event levels. Able to persuade and change the thinking of others without damaging relationships.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growth environment with minimal direction, delivering under tight deadlines while multitasking, prioritizing projects, and communicating priority updates to team members.
  • Able to operate with limited resources, exhibit dispassionate critical-thinking, and creatively solve problems. Motivated and inventive, always finds a way forward—eternal optimist with a committed drive for contributing and making a difference.
  • Any other duties needed to help achieve Business Objectives

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3 years of demonstrated and relevant experience in leading others ensuring efficient design/build, uptime, and overall stability of the technical environments of live media production and distribution.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in electrical engineering, computer science or equivalent major, and/or equivalent work experience.
  • Scripting proficiency will be an advantage (Python, NodeJS, Bash, PowerShell)
  • Knowledge and experience with integrating, implementing, or refreshing broadcast control room equipment, including familiarity with modern broadcast cabling infrastructure used in broadcast environments.
  • Proficient in SMPTE standards for broadcast television and video production/streaming environments with a current certification such as not limited to ST 292M, ST 424M, ST 2110, ST 2059, IEE1588, ST 2022-7, SCTE-104, etc.
  • Knowledge and experience with on-prem and cloud-based storage and compute infrastructure platforms and current technological offerings. At least one foundational cloud certification required, including but not limited to Microsoft Certified: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, CompTIA Cloud+, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.
  • Knowledge and experience with compression techniques such as MPEG2/4, HEVC, JPEG 2000, and JPEG XS.
  • Knowledge and experience with Evertz software control systems such as frame control via VistaLink or Magnum, EQX/EXE routers, and their monitoring software VLPRO, SDVN, VIP, VUE, MVP.
  • Knowledge and experience with major media systems and the vendors that supply them in areas such as asset management systems, file-based workflows, media acquisition, transcoding/encoding, graphics, and NAS/SAN technologies
  • Knowledge and experience with Nielsen (NACAT), VANC equipment, Linear Acoustics, and other related systems.
  • Knowledge and experience with coordinated receiver decoders IRDs, core devices, edge devices, timing of video and audio systems, audio and video media file formats are a plus.

title: Tuntiopettaja, sähkö- ja automaatioala / Tredu
description:
Ammatillista etumatkaa - Rohkee, Retee ja Reilu Tredu. Tampereen seudun ammattiopisto Tredu on Suomen toiseksi suurin ammatillisen koulutuksen järjestäjä. Tredu toimii kahdeksan kunnan alueella Pirkanmaalla, palveluita tarjotaan valtakunnallisesti. Tredussa opiskelee vuosittain noin 17 000 nuorta tai aikuista. Henkilöstöä on noin tuhat. Tredu palvelee yrityksiä henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämisessä. Tredu tarjoaa yrityksille mm. täydennyskoulutusta, osaavia työntekijöitä ja opiskelijoita oppisopimuksella ja koulutussopimuksella. Ammatilliseen koulutukseen hakeudutaan sekä jatkuvan haun, että yhteishaun kautta.

Haemme ammattitaitoista sähkö- ja automaatioalan päätoimista tuntiopettajaa vakituiseen virkasuhteeseen. Tehtävän aloitus on 1.11.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Työ tehdään Tampereen seudun ammattiopiston toimipisteissä Kangasalla, Nokialla tai Tampereella. Pääasiallinen toimipiste palvelussuhteen alkaessa on Tredun Hepolamminkadun kampus Tampereella.

Sähkö- ja automaatioalan opettajana tehtäviisi kuuluu ammatillisten aineiden opetus sekä lähi- että verkko-opetuksena, opintojen suunnittelu yhdessä opiskelijan ja sidosryhmien kanssa, työpaikalla tapahtuvan oppimisen ohjaus sekä näyttöjen suunnittelu, ohjaus ja arviointi. Työhön sisältyy myös yhteydenpitoa pirkanmaalaisten alan yritysten kanssa.

Sinulla on vankkaa sähköasennusalan työkokemusta ja osaamista joko kiinteistöjen sähköasennuksista, teollisuuden sähköasennuksista tai rakennusautomaatio- ja turvajärjestelmien asennuksesta sekä hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja tietotekniset taidot.

Kelpoisuusehdot määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen 986/1998 § 13 ja sähköturvallisuuslaissa 1135/2016 73 § sähköalan ammattihenkilöstä säädetyn mukaisesti. Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää voimassa oleva B-ajokorttia ja mahdollisuuden oman auton käyttöön työtehtävissä.

Eduksi katsotaan yrittäjäkokemus sähköurakoinnista sekä kokemus työvoimakoulutuksesta.

Virkaan valitun on ennen viran vastaanottamista toimitettava kunnan ja hyvinvointialueen viranhaltijasta annetun lain (304/2003 7 §) perusteella hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan sekä esittää rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentin mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

Pyydämme, että merkitset hakemukseesi kelpoisuutesi ja liität kopiot kelpoisuuden osoittavista tutkintotodistuksista sähköiseen hakemukseen Kuntarekryyn. Alkuperäiset todistukset katsotaan mahdollisessa haastattelussa.

Palkkaus OVTES:n mukaisesti. Palkka koostuu tehtäväkohtaisesta palkasta, vuosisidonnaisesta lisästä sekä mahdollisista muista palkanlisistä. Käytämme viroissa 6 kuukauden koeaikaa.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa virka-aikana koulutuspäällikkö Vesa Helminen, puh. 050 587 0121.

Hakuaika päättyy 23.9.2026.

Tehtäviä haetaan Kuntarekryssä Hae työpaikkaa -painikkeesta. Ohjeita hakemiseen löydät https://www.tampere.fi/tyo

Sähköisten hakemusten tulee olla perillä klo 23.59 ja postitse saapuvien hakemusten klo 15.00 mennessä. Myöhässä saapuneita hakemuksia ei voida ottaa haussa huomioon.

Lisätietoa hakemisesta saat Monetra Pirkanmaan rekrytointipalveluista puh. 040 806 3184, rekrytointi.pirkanmaa@monetra.fi.

title: Kotisiivooja pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen, Pirkanmaa
location: Kangasala, Lempäälä, Nokia, Pirkkala, Pälkäne, Tampere, Ylöjärvi, Finland
description:
Haemme asiakkaallemme kotisiivoojaa pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Tampereelle.
Työssä vastaat kotitalouksien ylläpitosiivouksista Tampereen alueella. Työ on itsenäistä ja vaihtelevaa, ja näet oman kätesi jäljen heti.

Työtä tehdään arkisin aamu- ja päivävuoroissa, ja työtunteja kertyy vähintään noin 30 tuntia viikossa. Kohteiden välillä liikutaan autolla. Työautoja on rajallinen määrä vapaana, joten oman auton käyttömahdollisuus erinomaista.

Etsimme reipasta, oma-aloitteista ja luotettavaa työntekijää, jolla on B-ajokortti ja suomenkielen taito asiakaspalveluun asiakkaillamme esimerkiksi vanhemmat eläkeläiset eivät välttämättä puhu kuin suomea. Aiempi kokemus siivoustyöstä katsotaan eduksi, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä – tärkeintä on oikea asenne ja halu oppia.

Tarjoamme pitkäaikaisen työsuhteen, 12,26–13,50 €/h palkkauksen kokemuksen mukaan, palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa, työhön sopivat varusteet sekä päivittäisen tuen työasioissa.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan, nopeallakin aikataululla. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian järjestelmäämme!

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys, joka pelaa reilua peliä. Tarjoamme töitä niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Työntekijöitä autamme löytämään oman visionsa mukaisen työpaikan. Työnantajia taas palvelemme etsimällä oikeat ihmiset avoimiin tehtäviin.

Yhteistyö perustuu jokaisen kolmen tahon kesken vallitsevaan luottamukseen. Mikäli haluat työnantajan, jolle jokainen työntekijä on merkityksellinen ja arvokas, niin se on Visio!

title: Staff Robotics Engineer
description:
We seek a Staff Robotics Engineer to help create the next generation of Physical AI systems on Arm. You will design and build the software foundations that connect sensing, planning, control, and actuation so robots can operate reliably and autonomously on-device, independent of cloud services.

You will provide technical leadership across robotics architecture, platform integration, and developer workflows. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of robotics, embedded systems, real-time computing, and AI, with responsibility for turning advanced algorithms into dependable capabilities on Arm-powered products.

Key Responsibilities

Robotics architecture and systems integration

  • Architect and implement modular robotics software that integrates sensors, state estimation, planning, control, and actuators.
  • Define stable interfaces and system boundaries across the autonomy stack, middleware, operating system, and hardware accelerators.
  • Lead integration of robotics components into production-ready reference platforms and customer-facing demonstrations.

Developer experience and platform tooling

  • Build APIs, SDKs, and reusable components that make robotics capabilities straightforward to develop, configure, and deploy.
  • Improve workflows for simulation, on-target testing, calibration, logging, replay, and over-the-air component updates.
  • Create observability and diagnostic tools that expose timing, resource use, faults, and robot behavior across distributed components.

Real-time performance, reliability, and safety

  • Optimize end-to-end latency, determinism, memory use, and throughput across CPUs and heterogeneous accelerators.
  • Design systems that tolerate sensor degradation, communication faults, resource contention, and changing operating conditions.
  • Establish testing, validation, and engineering practices that support maintainable, safe, and robust robotic behavior.

Technical leadership and collaboration

  • Partner with controls, perception, AI, hardware, product, and customer teams to define requirements and system architecture.
  • Lead design reviews, mentor engineers, and drive resolution of complex cross-stack technical issues.
  • Contribute reference implementations, documentation, examples, and upstream improvements that advance the robotics ecosystem on Arm.

Vital Skills and Experience

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building robotics, autonomous systems, or embedded software used in real-world environments.
  • Proficiency in modern C++ and Python, with strong software design, debugging, and code-quality practices.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Robotics middleware and communication patterns, including ROS 2 or comparable systems
  • Coordinate frames, timing, synchronization, calibration, and sensor and actuator interfaces
  • Linux-based and real-time systems, concurrency, IPC, and distributed component lifecycles
  • 3+ years of experience leading architecture or integration work across multiple parts of a robotics stack.
  • Strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, numerical methods, and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose system behavior across application, middleware, operating-system, and hardware layers.
  • Excellent technical judgment, communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience with navigation, manipulation, motion planning, or autonomous mobile robots.
  • Experience with simulation, software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and automated robotics testing.
  • Familiarity with AI and perception inference pipelines deployed on embedded or edge systems.
  • Experience with heterogeneous computing across CPUs, GPUs, NPUs, or DSPs.
  • Knowledge of functional safety, fault management, secure boot, isolation, or device attestation.
  • Contributions to open-source robotics platforms, middleware, drivers, or developer tooling.
  • Experience working with partners or customers to move robotics prototypes into production.

Why this role matters

Robots must combine complex software and hardware while meeting strict requirements for latency, reliability, safety, and power. A strong robotics platform lets teams focus on differentiated behavior instead of repeatedly rebuilding integration infrastructure.

In this role, you will shape how advanced robotics workloads run on Arm-powered devices across industrial, commercial, and consumer applications. Your work will help developers build capable physical systems that respond intelligently to the real world.

Emergency HEAP benefits are available to eligible households in crisis situations, such as a heating emergency or danger of a utility shut-off. title: Archaeologist - ANDOVER
description:
Archaeologist


Andover


Salary £28,532 - £29,255



Fixed-term (six-month) contracts available, with immediate start dates.


Cotswold Archaeology is one of the largest and most respected archaeological practices in the country, employing over 380 professional staff and carrying out some of the most interesting, complex and largest archaeological and heritage projects across England and Wales.

We are seeking ,Experienced Archaeologists, Archaeologists and Trainees across all four of our offices to work on a range of exciting archaeological projects, spanning different time periods. With a strong ongoing program of fieldwork, we are looking for motivated, dedicated individuals to join our team.

Cotswold Archaeology has projects located in the vicinity of our offices, but for these roles there will be a requirement to be rostered on protracted away projects where we will provide accommodation and the opportunity to accrue lieu and overtime.

Where away work is required good quality accommodation will be provided, along with subsistence payments. (£24 per each night where eligible).

What we offer

Along with a starting salary above the CIfA minimum, we offer a highly competitive benefits package including:

  • 30 days annual leave (including statutory holidays) - please note that the annual leave allowance will be prorated for the duration of contract.
  • Defined contribution pension scheme
  • Life insurance scheme
  • Paid CIfA membership subscription (following qualifying period)
  • Company sick pay - prorated for the duration of contract.
  • A generous lieu scheme operated for all driving time, and time spent in excess of 45 minutes each way as a passenger, outside of the normal 7.5 hour working day (able to accumulate up to 10 days additional lieu time annually)
  • Overnight accommodation and subsistence when working on away projects.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and a network of mental health first aiders across the organisation.
  • Personal protective equipment


Please note all salaries quoted are annual equivalents based on a 37.5-hour week. We are unable to offer contracts with the provision of 7 day a week accommodated away work.

Membership of the CIfA at PCIfA level is desirable, as is possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or CSCS test pass. Although new CSCS cards are not currently being issued to the archaeological sector, successful applicants without a current and valid CSCS card or test pass, will be expected to pass the CITB HS&E Operatives Test, which will be arranged and paid for by CA.

A full manual driving licence is desirable.



The Details



Archaeologists £28,532 - £29,255 Dependent on Experience

We are seeking enthusiastic and skilled individuals to join our existing team. Your core skills and experience should include manual excavation, the recording of archaeological features, proven experience in commercial archaeology and the recovery of artefacts or samples. You should also be able to complete stratigraphic matrices, photograph archaeological features and sites, and compose accurate measured drawings. Familiarity with GPS surveying is desirable.


How to apply



Please submit a CV and cover letter by visiting our careers page.

Closing date: Applications need to be submitted by 5pm Wednesday 30th September

2026



Cotswold Archaeology is an equal opportunities employer. All applications are assessed solely on the candidate’s relevant skills and experience relevant to the role.

We will take into consideration any reasonable adjustments required to support you. Should you need adjustments during the recruitment process, or require additional support related to neurodiversity or for any other reason, please let us know by contacting careers@cotswoldarchaeology.co.uk

Applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in the UK as defined by UK Visas and Immigration



Job Description

Role: Archaeologist

Pay Scale: Scp 9 - 10

Department: Fieldwork

Location: Andover

Reports to: Project Supervisor


Purpose of role

To undertake archaeological field investigations, including manual excavation and the collection and recording of data, under the direction of a designated Project Leader.


Main duties and responsibilities:


Assist in the successful completion of fieldwork projects, including fieldwalking, evaluation, excavation, finds processing, data entry and archiving.


Accurately record investigation data using pro-forma recording sheets and registers, scale drawings and photographs, in accordance with CA procedures.


Recover artefacts and environmental samples in

accordance with CA procedures and recognised industry standards.


Carry out manual excavation of features accurately and efficiently with a wide variety of tools.


Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of archaeological periods and practice.


Deal courteously with sponsors and clients of CA, officers of other bodies and members of the public.

Create and maintain accurate and well organised administrative records.

Assist in the training and support of Trainee Archaeologists.

Undertake all training provided by Cotswold Archaeology applicable to the role.

Perform all duties in line with CA’s Health and Safety Policy and Systems or those for whom CA is working.



Personal specification

Essential

Knowledge and understanding of archaeological practice.


Previous experience of commercial archaeology

The ability to deal efficiently and courteously with clients of CA, officers of other bodies, members of the public and colleagues,

Ability to create and maintain accurate and well organised administrative records.

Ability to work to deadlines.

Ability and willingness to undertake away work including some extended away work when required.


Desirable


Some demonstrable experience of machine supervision/watching brief undertaken in a commercial context

The ability to assist in the training and support of Trainee Archaeologists.

Survey skills, including ability to operate Leica GPS/TST.

Full Manual Driving Licence

Experience of and confidence in driving 4x4 vehicles, vans and minibuses.

Membership of CIfA

CSCS/EUSR card or equivalent

title: Principal Software Engineer, AI Inference Cloud
description:
As a Principal Engineer on Arm’s AI Inference Cloud team, you will shape the technical direction and develop highly available, scalable services for running AI inference workloads. You will guide architecture and actively contribute to development across Kubernetes orchestration, workload management, service delivery, and observability. Partnering with AI compute, Inference Runtime, and product teams to enhance the performance and usability of Arm’s AI platform.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and build the architecture for cloud-based AI inference services.
  • Develop Kubernetes controllers and platform capabilities supporting workload deployment, scheduling, recovery, scaling, upgrades, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish production practices for health validation, progressive rollout, rollback, observability, and service objectives. Improve platform reliability, scalability, performance, and resource efficiency.
  • Lead production readiness reviews and resolve complex issues across services, Kubernetes, networking, and compute infrastructure. Turn incidents and operational bottlenecks into durable platform improvements.
  • Lead design and build reviews, mentor engineers, and drive technical alignment across teams.

Necessary Skills and Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience, or equivalent proven impact, building distributed systems, cloud platforms, or production infrastructure.
  • Deep production experience with Kubernetes, including controllers, operators, scheduling, resource management, networking, and workload lifecycle management.
  • Strong software and production engineering skills, including hands-on programming in Go, C++, Rust, Python, or a similar language, and experience with reliable services, APIs, concurrency, observability, deployment safety, capacity planning, and incident response.
  • A track record of leading complex technical initiatives while remaining hands-on, including architecture, implementation, debugging, mentoring, and influencing technical direction across teams.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and communicate clearly with engineers from different technical backgrounds.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience with AI infrastructure, model serving, or accelerator-backed workloads.
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch, Ray, vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM, or experience qualifying accelerators and tuning distributed workloads.
  • Knowledge of inference performance and resource-efficiency considerations.

In Return:

You will be part of our AI Platforms team - A driven and diverse group passionate about developing foundational production capabilities for AI inference at Arm. We provide a collaborative setting where your ideas can come to life quickly. Your work will directly impact the success of our AI projects, shape Arm’s AI inference capabilities, defining and operating production inference workloads. This is an outstanding opportunity to work with world-class teams and contribute to groundbreaking advances in AI technology. Join us in building the next generation of AI inference infrastructure!

title: Academic Administrative Officer (Rockledge)
description:
Job Overview


The Academic Administrative Officer (AAO) is a key operational leader who partners directly with the Clinical Director to help run the day-to-day operations of the building, ensuring a safe, organized, and well-functioning environment for students, families, and staff. The AAO serves as the primary point of contact for parents, staff, and vendors, and works closely with the Director of Academic Operations to coordinate site calendars, school events, and spirit weeks. This role requires strong ownership of building operations, sound independent judgment, and the ability to keep academic and clinical functions aligned and running smoothly at all times.


The AAO's schedule and planning follow the clinical calendar, ensuring consistency between academic operations and clinical service delivery.


Responsibilities:


Building Operations & Leadership

  • Partner with the Clinical Director to help oversee daily building operations, ensuring a cohesive, well-run academic and clinical environment.
  • Serve as a trusted operational partner and point person in the building, exercising independent judgment to resolve day-to-day issues and escalating as appropriate.
  • Maintain high visibility throughout the facility and assume supervisory responsibilities as needed.
  • Support the enforcement of school rules, policies, and procedures.
  • Manage and maintain the daily functioning of the school following best practices.
  • Monitor for signs of child abuse and report as necessary.
  • Understand and perform all safety protocols and procedures in the best interest of students and staff at all times.


Administrative Support to School and Clinic

  • Maintain office and appointment calendars; provide daily meeting and appointment schedules.
  • Take and transcribe minutes for meetings and official functions as required.
  • Address routine office queries and concerns from staff, parents, and vendors.
  • Coordinate and prioritize clerical tasks, projects, and office administration.
  • Ensure timely routing of HR paperwork (e.g., incident reports, timecards).
  • Process purchase requests and manage inventory of classroom and office supplies.
  • Handle deliveries, outgoing mail, and coordinate office equipment maintenance.
  • Serve as the primary liaison among parents, staff, vendors, and the community.
  • Coordinate vendor communication and scheduling to support building operations and events.
  • Schedule tours for prospective families and maintain follow-up records.
  • Compile client attendance and punctuality reports.
  • Audit and maintain student/client files to ensure compliance standards are met.
  • Maintain both electronic and paper records securely and appropriately.
  • Use various systems for data entry and document preparation.
  • Coordinate facility activities to ensure a clean and productive environment.
  • Prepare facility maintenance reports for management.
  • Attend required meetings, events, and seminars.
  • Assist staff with client-related issues and communication with parents.
  • Stay informed about the best practices for effective office administration.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.


Events & Calendar Coordination

  • Partner with the Director of Academic Operations to plan and coordinate school events, site spirit weeks, and school-wide activities.
  • Build, maintain, and distribute the site's master calendar, ensuring alignment with the clinical calendar.
  • Participate in planning and coordinating meetings, fundraisers, and events.
  • Communicate calendar updates and event details clearly to staff, parents, and vendors.


School Leadership

  • Assist in coordinating meetings for staff and parents to ensure alignment with school objectives.
  • Learn and utilize FACTs Management, ProCare, and Rethink systems for administrative tasks.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Academic Operations es to ensure alignment between academic and clinical services.
  • Escalate issues properly per policies and procedures to the Director of Academic Operations.


Communications

  • Prepare various materials (reports, curriculum materials, correspondence) to document and convey information.
  • Assist with creating parental communications for newsletters and important notices.
  • Utilize Circle/MindMeld for effective parent communication.
  • Promote open communication and positive attitudes among students, staff, and families.


School Management

  • Manage administrative functions related to student discipline, scheduling, and personnel assignments.
  • Coordinate maintenance and custodial activities to promote a healthy environment.
  • Partner with the Clinical Director to ensure cohesion between academic and clinical services.


Community Relations

  • Provide outstanding customer service with positive interpersonal communication.
  • Act as a representative in community forums to foster support for educational goals.
  • Participate in meetings and workshops to acquire and share necessary information.


General Operations

  • Perform related duties to ensure efficient functioning of the school.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


Qualifications

  • Education: High School Diploma required; Associate's Degree preferred.


Experience

  • At least 2 years of relevant administrative experience.
  • Prior experience in a preschool or early intervention setting.
  • Familiarity with ABA therapy or working with children with autism is a plus.


Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, SharePoint, PowerPoint), ProCare, and FACTs.
  • Typing Speed of a minimum of 35 WPM with legible handwriting.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Flexible, reliable, and capable of handling sensitive information with professionalism.


Benefits

We value and support our employees with a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Company-Paid Health Benefits Option for additional coverage available at cost to the employee.
  • Mental Health Days Earn up to 4 paid mental health days per year.
  • PTO Accrual 40 hours of paid time off that accrues.
  • Paid Holidays according to the company clinical calendar
  • Professional Development Opportunities to grow and advance your skills in a supportive environment.


Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a supportive team dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of children and families.
  • Work in a dynamic, rewarding environment where every day brings new opportunities to learn and grow.
  • Enjoy competitive pay and a company culture that prioritizes work-life balance.
  • If you meet these qualifications and are ready to make a difference, we encourage you to apply today!

title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Compute Platform

description:

title: Physical SOC Lead, AWS Security
description:
⚠️ Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance, with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. For more information regarding security clearances please visit (https://www.agsva.gov.au/)

You've found an opportunity that could define your next chapter.

The Mission - Why This Program, Why Now?

Amazon Web Services is a dynamic and rapidly growing business. We provide a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. We provide organisations with building block web services that allow them to innovate faster and operate their software more cost-effectively. The AWS team is building and delivering the next generation of cloud computing that supports public AWS offerings like S3, EC2, and CloudFront. We are innovating new ways of building massively scalable distributed systems.

The team you're joining is growing, and the decisions being made now will shape how we operate for years to come. You won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be leading from the front.

Your Role

Imagine leading a team of physical security professionals protecting AWS infrastructure. As an AWS Physical Security Operations Centre (PSOC) Lead, you'll be the strategic mind and decisive leader directing physical security operations that support the services hundreds of thousands of businesses depend on every single day.

This isn't passive oversight - this is active, intelligent security leadership where your judgment, experience, and ability to guide a team directly safeguards our assets. You'll employ physical security strategies and procedures in accordance with service level agreements, lead incident response to physical security events in real time, coordinate contracted guard forces, administer access control systems, and drive the intelligence gathering that keeps our people, operations, and infrastructure safe.

Every shift brings new challenges. Every decision your team makes matters. And every improvement you champion raises the security bar for an organisation that refuses to stand still.

Why This Team, Why Now?

You're stepping into a leadership role within a team of physical security professionals who are building something extraordinary. The PSOC is where operational excellence meets purpose - where your customer service instincts, your communication skills, and your security expertise converge to protect what matters most. Whether your background is in security operations centres, security dispatch centres, military, or law enforcement, your experience has prepared you for this moment.

This is where careers accelerate, where diverse paths are celebrated, and where the appetite to continuously improve isn't just welcomed - it's essential.

Shift work will also be an eventual requirement for this role.

Key job responsibilities
What does an Physical SOC Lead (PSOC) Lead do at AWS?

As an AWS PSOC Lead you will employ physical security strategies and procedures in accordance with service level agreements concerning AWS security process.

You will work within the AWS PSOC while responding to physical security events affecting or threatening AWS physical infrastructure, associates, operations, and assets region wide.

Daily responsibilities include physical access control administration, monitoring physical access control systems, monitoring a contracted guard force, alarm and incident response, report writing, intelligence gathering and distributing program wide notifications when necessary.

You will also manage internal and external email and phone communications, triage trouble tickets, handle incoming queries, and provide technical support to internal stakeholders.

The successful candidate should have a proven record of accomplishment of customer service, extensive experience in security and risk management, possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, and demonstrate good judgment while multi-tasking. The candidate will also be able to follow PSOC tasks, procedures, and utilise discretion when dealing with sensitive information.

Most importantly the candidate will possess the appetite and inclination to continually identify ways to improve and raise the bar for security.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional

Learning & Development
AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.

Health, Income Protection & Life Cover
Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you.

Military Differential Pay
Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving.

Employee Assistance Program
Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family - mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.

Family-Building Benefit
Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching.

Amazon Extras & Employee Discount
Cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

title: Creative Director, Prime Video Shopping
description:
Prime Video Shopping is seeking an experienced Creative Director to own creative art direction for consumer products tied to Amazon MGM Studios intellectual properties, and to own product development for a portfolio of licensees. This role sits at the intersection of franchise creative direction, licensee product development, and creative operations, requiring a leader who can set the visual bar for consumer products based on iconic Amazon MGM Studios franchises, guide licensees from concept through approval, and help evolve how creative work gets done through process and tooling.

As a Creative Director, you will own the creative direction for assigned franchises’ consumer product programs — working with internal design teams to build style guides and art packs that set the creative course, then disseminating them to a broad base of licensees who use them to build products. Separately, you will own product development for an assigned base of licensee partners whose work spans many franchises, serving as their creative point of contact from concept through approval. Alongside the rest of the team, you will drive operational and tooling improvements to scale creative productivity.
A successful candidate will excel at art direction and design craft, thrive on turning early content materials into franchise creative that recruits licensees, and enjoy improving the processes that let a small team deliver more. The ideal candidate is resourceful, customer-obsessed, and able to think and act both strategically and tactically — balancing subjective and objective feedback across internal and external stakeholders while consistently raising the design bar.

Candidates should have an in-depth understanding of AI tools, Photoshop, Illustrator, PowerPoint, and Figma.

Key job responsibilities
Franchise Creative Art Direction — Own and protect the creative bar for assigned intellectual properties. Develop the comprehensive consumer products style guides and asset systems (compositions, icons, patterns, packaging, color palettes, fonts, and layouts) that set the creative direction for a franchise. Translate the earliest content materials (scripts, set photography, key art) into assets that pitch the franchise to prospective licensees, and inspire final consumer products.

Licensee Product Development — Own product development for an assigned base of licensee partners. Because partners are assigned by relationship rather than by franchise, this base spans many franchises, and you serve as their single point of contact from concept through approval. Review and approve product development (PD) submissions against style guides and brand standards, onboard new partners to the approval workflow, and lead partner presentations and kick-off meetings.

Creative Operations & Process Improvement — Work with the rest of the creative team to move from manual creative toward a more scaled operation. Provide art direction for main style guides and art packs produced in partnership with internal designers, contribute to the processes that hand routine production to the scaled team, and help develop the path to produce direct designs through AI tooling.

Stakeholder Communication — Present creative solutions and franchise direction to senior leadership and licensee partners, anticipate difficult design questions, and defend design decisions with clear rationale. Resolve conflicting feedback across internal and external stakeholders and move decisions forward.

Mentorship & Force Multiplying — Mentor and develop others on the team, document institutional knowledge, and deliver solutions that increase the effectiveness of the group, including championing the use of AI technology in creative contexts.

title: Stockyard Hand
description:
Description:

Looking for a hands-on role working with livestock in a fast-paced environment? Join our team as a Stockyard Hand at V&V Walsh in Bunbury.

About Us:

V&V Walsh is part of the Craig Mostyn Group. The Craig Mostyn Group is a leading food and agribusiness that has operated over the past 100 years across Australia. Our operations are in Western Australia, Victoria, and Tasmania, where we produce premium quality pork, beef, lamb, abalone, protein meal and tallow for clients and suppliers, here locally and internationally. At the Craig Mostyn Group, our purpose is to provide a sense of belonging where you can grow and develop with us as we aspire to provide high quality and ethical food for generations to come. INTEGRITY: We always try to do what’s right;

COLLABORATION: We are one team;

You will be responsible for the safe handling, movement, and care of livestock prior to processing, ensuring strong animal welfare outcomes and smooth operational flow to meet production targets.

About You:

  • Background in stockyards, feedlots, farms, or stations highly regarded
  • Strong understanding of animal welfare or willingness to learn
  • Physically fit and comfortable working outdoors in all conditions
  • Reliable, punctual, and self-motivated

Our Benefits:

  • Competitive Pay: We offer generous pay packages that reward high performers.

Ready to Grow with Us?

If you're ready to bring your skills and passion to a company that values you, click on apply now to join the Craig Mostyn Group family. Start your rewarding career journey with us today!

We embrace diversity and are committed to providing equal opportunities for all qualified applicants, regardless of ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, genetics, disability or age.

title: Johdon sihteeri
description:
Saskyssa osaavat luovat maailmoja - yhdessä tehden! SASKY koulutuskuntayhtymä on ammatillista koulutusta ja yleissivistävää koulutusta järjestävä kuntayhtymä, joka toimii usean kunnan alueella Pirkanmaalla ja Satakunnassa. Henkilöstöä kuntayhtymän palveluksessa on noin 500 ja opiskelijoita Saskyssa on noin 7 500.


SASKY koulutuskuntayhtymä hakee johdon sihteeriä toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen 2.11.2026 alkaen. Mikäli sinulla on kokemusta laaja-alaisista kuntapuolen johdon tuen ja hallinnon tehtävistä, ja työskentelyäsi ohjaavat arvojemme mukaisesti asiakaslähtöisyys, ammatillisuus, vastuullisuus ja avoimuus, tämä tehtävä voi olla juuri sinua varten!


Johdon sihteerinä vastaat kuntayhtymäjohtajan arjen sujuvuudesta ja osallistut monipuolisesti johdon vastuulla olevien asioiden ja päätösten valmistelutyöhön sekä muihin hallinnon työtehtäviin. Työtehtävät ja vastuut ovat kuntayhtymätasoisia ja vaikutukset ulottuvat laajasti niin sisäisiin kuin ulkoisiinkin sidosryhmiin.

Tehtävässä painottuvat erityisesti seuraavat osa-alueet:

Kuntayhtymäjohtajan tuki päivittäisten tehtävien aikataulutuksessa sekä koordinoimisessa
Lausuntojen, sopimusten, tiedotteiden, esitysten, viranhaltijapäätösten sekä muiden materiaalien valmistelutyö
Kokousten ja tapaamisten valmistelu, järjestäminen ja koordinointi sekä sihteerinä toimiminen nimetyissä työryhmissä
Asianhallinnan sekä talous- ja henkilöstöhallinnon tehtävät useita eri järjestelmiä hyödyntäen.
Yhteistyö johdon ja eri yhteistyötahojen kanssa sekä sisäisen ja ulkoisen viestinnän tehtävät eri sidosryhmien välillä




Odotamme sinulta

Tehtävässä onnistumiseksi sinulla on vahvaa kokemusta ja näkemystä johdon avustavien tehtävien hoitamisesta ja hallinnosta kunta-alan organisaatiossa. Toimit sujuvasti yhteistyössä eri sidosryhmien kanssa, viestit laadukkaasti suullisesti sekä kirjallisesti ja työskentelet itsenäisellä ja ennakoivalla työotteella. Sinulla on kykyä kerätä ja raportoida tietoa sekä käyttää sujuvasti eri järjestelmiä työsi tukena. Edellytämme vankkaa kokemusta MS Office -työkalujen käytöstä ja katsomme eduksi monipuolisen osaamisen käytössä olevista järjestelmistämme (mm. Dynasty10, Approval, ESS, M2, Kuntarekry). Muuttuvien tilanteiden keskellä auttaa, kun sinulla on huumorintajua ja suhtaudut vaihteleviin tilanteisiin hyvällä paineensietokyvyllä ja palveluhenkisellä asenteella ja tartut rohkeasti arjessa eteen tuleviin haasteisiin. Tehtävässä edellytetään sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa, johdon sihteerin tulee ajoittain pystyä viestimään myös englanniksi.

Tehtävä edellyttää soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa sekä vähintään kolmen vuoden kokemusta itsenäisistä ja vastuullisista johdon sihteerin tai assistentin tehtävistä. Ammatillisen ja toisen asteen koulutuksen tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.




Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen, monipuolisen tehtävänkuvan ja koko Saskyn tuen vakaassa organisaatiossa. Käytössäsi ovat laajat työterveyshuollon palvelut 6 kk työsuhteen alkamisesta lähtien, Epassi sekä liukuva työaika ja osittainen etätyömahdollisuus.





Palkkaus ja palvelussuhteen ehdot

Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät KVTESin mukaan. Palkkaus on Saskyn paikallisen tasopalkkajärjestelmän mukaisesti 3558,62€/kk + virkaehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät aikaisemman työkokemuksen perusteella. Työaika tehtävässä on 36,25h/vko. Työsuhteen alkamisaika on 2.11.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Palvelussuhteessa noudatetaan 6 kk:n koeaikaa. Valitun on esitettävä todistus terveydentilasta viimeistään kuukauden kuluessa palvelussuhteen alkamisesta sekä työsuhteen alkaessa rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Ensisijainen työskentelypisteesi on sovittavissa Saskyn toiminta-alueella. Ajoittain työtehtävät edellyttävät matkustamista Saskyn toimipisteiden välillä.




Hakeminen ja lisätiedot

Hakemukset tulee toimittaa torstaihin 24.9. klo 23.59 mennessä sähköisellä lomakkeella osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi. Hakuajan jälkeen saapuneita hakemuksia ei voida ottaa huomioon.

Alustavan aikataulun mukaan jatkoon etenevät hakijat kutsutaan haastatteluihin hakuajan päätyttyä ja haastattelut pyritään järjestämään Tampereella Haapasen huvilalla viikolla 40 ja 41. Varsinainen valinta pyritään tekemään mahdollisimman pian haastatteluiden jälkeen.

Mikäli sinulla herää kysyttävää tehtävästä, kuntayhtymäjohtajamme Antti Lahti vastaa sinulle mielellään puhelimitse 050 340 6221. Emme voi valitettavasti vastata sähköpostitiedusteluihin.

title: Medior SAP Integration Suite Consultant - JP055379
description:

The role requires strong hands-on expertise in SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI, SAP BTP, APIs, and SAP S/4HANA, combined with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take a technical lead role in the migration of SAP PI/PO interfaces to SAP CPI.

  • Identify required changes and adaptations for migration to SAP CPI.
  • Evaluate architectural differences between PI/PO and CPI.
  • Collaborate with technical and functional teams to define requirements and migration plans.
  • Design, implement, and configure migrated interfaces.
  • Perform comprehensive testing and validation of migrated interfaces.
  • Execute end-to-end tests to ensure critical business processes continue to operate correctly.
  • Diagnose and resolve technical and integration issues during migration and testing.
  • Document interface modifications, configurations, and integration flows.
  • Establish and promote best practices for SAP CPI development and management.
  • Provide knowledge transfer and training to internal technical and operational teams.
  • Provide post-migration support and resolve incidents related to SAP CPI interfaces.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Advanced knowledge of SAP BTP.
  • Strong experience with SAP PI/PO, including:
    • Interface configuration
    • Message handling
    • Data transformations
    • Integration flow optimisation
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA.
  • Strong knowledge of API and integration concepts.
  • Experience with SAP PI/PO to SAP CPI migration projects.

  • Experience with testing and validating complex integrations.

title: Mobile Operations Leader II
description:
Mobile Operations Leader II


General Summary

The Mobile Operations Leader II will be responsible for the successful execution of medium-scale mobile blood drives. The Leader II will ensure the collection of safe, pure and potent blood products while ensuring the delivery of an exceptional donor experience.

The position is responsible for providing the daily work instruction and feedback to ensure all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) are followed.

The position will actively participate in the formal performance feedback process.

The position is responsible for coaching and mentoring team members to achieve performance goals.

Commit to and abide by the character of BioBridge Global’s Core Values of Accountability, Stewardship, Pioneer, Integrity, Respect and Excellence (ASPIRE).

Support, communicate and reinforce the mission and vision of the enterprise.

Provide world class customer service by capturing and being responsive to the voice of the customer (internal or external, including donors for select positions) through multiple feedback channels in order to


resolve issues and drive satisfaction in accordance with the BBG customer engagement, feedback, and complaint processes.



Major Duties and Responsibilities

Essential Tasks

• Exhibit a positive leadership role for staff.

• Ensure the delivery of an exceptional donation experience.

• Maintain a good working relationship with co-workers.

• Effectively establish rapport with the blood drive sponsor through professional representation of the blood center.

• Provide specific work direction to team members, monitor the collection operations, and deliver feedback on performance.

• Prevent, assess and treat adverse donor reactions.

• Coach and mentor assigned staff in job performance along with completion of formal performance feedback.

• Ensure the effective onboarding of new Mobile team members (may be required).

Performs other duties as assigned.

Non-Essential Tasks

• Provide assistance to other departments as needed.



Education

Preferred Education

Licenses and/or Certifications

• Must maintain knowledge of effective leadership techniques.

• Must display a working knowledge of medical terminology.

• Must have excellent interpersonal and public speaking skills.

• Must have strong computer skills.

• Must have strong customer service skills.

• Must be capable of determining daily blood drive production capacity and having production flow-based conversations.

• Must demonstrate positive leadership skills.

• Must be neat in appearance and well groomed.

• Must be able to provide work direction and feedback on performance to assigned staff members.

ABOUT US

For more than 60 years, Weissman has helped performance creators bring their visions to life. As a third-generation, family-owned company and a leader in the dance industry, we design and deliver beautiful, high-quality costumes, dancewear, and accessories that support dancers and the people who inspire them through every step of the journey from practice to performance.

What makes Weissman special is the people behind the product. Our work brings together creative thinkers, technical experts, problem solvers, and collaborators across design, merchandising, product development, sourcing, marketing, sales, operations, and more. Because so much of what we do happens under one roof, our teams have the opportunity to work closely across functions, see ideas become reality, and understand how their individual contributions connect to our customers and the performers who ultimately take the stage.

Our culture is grounded in curiosity, collaboration, accountability, and a willingness to keep getting better. We believe people with purpose are unstoppable, information fuels growth, and innovation sets us apart. We encourage our employees to ask questions, share ideas, take ownership of their work, and challenge what’s possible. Whether you’re developing a new product, improving a process, solving a customer need, or supporting the people who make it all happen, there is an opportunity to make an impact here.

At Weissman, our customers are center stage in everything we do. We’re proud of our history, energized by where we’re going, and committed to building an environment where talented people can learn, contribute, grow, and do meaningful work together.



RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate the disciplined day-to-day flow of creative work across channels, managing requests from initial intake through final routing.

  • Receive incoming requests from business partners, ensuring all required information is complete to set our teams up for success.

  • Build tasks, timelines, dependencies, and assignments within our project management system to keep initiatives on track.

  • Maintain accurate assigned task dates, provide daily status updates, and reliably monitor progress toward delivery deadlines.

  • Review team workloads collaboratively with creative leadership, recommending assignment adjustments based on timing, capability, and capacity.

  • Proactively identify potential roadblocks such as missing information, delayed approvals, or conflicting priorities to keep our creative engine running smoothly.

  • Escalate issues early to the Creative Project Manager to prevent downstream delays and maintain our commitment to on-time delivery.

  • Route files for review and approval, monitor feedback cycles, and strictly ensure version control for all creative assets.

  • Maintain proactive, empathetic communication with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Merchandising, Sales, Studio) regarding project status, dependencies, and urgent changes.

  • Uphold the accuracy of project records and workflow documentation while continuously identifying pioneering opportunities for process improvement.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred in Advertising, Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

  • Entry-level certification such as Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) is preferred

Experience

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in traffic, project coordination, studio coordination, or creative operations support within an agency or in-house marketing department (Preferred).

  • 1 to 3 years of experience utilizing project management and proofing tools (e.g., Asana, Workfront, Monday.com, Ziflow) and Google Workspace (Preferred).

Knowledge, Skills, + Abilities

  • High proficiency in organization, meticulous attention to detail, and disciplined follow-up.

  • High proficiency in multitasking and time management in a fast-paced environment.

  • Self-directed, collaborative team player with genuine and flexible problem-solving skills.

  • Strong workflow discipline coupled with warm, cross-functional communication abilities.

  • Ability to balance big-picture pioneering thinking with detailed execution.

  • Strong stakeholder relationship skills and robust systems proficiency

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We believe great work starts with supporting our people. As a full-time Weissman employee, you’ll have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, time away from work, and continued growth.

  • Health + Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, including company-paid vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents and a company-funded Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA).

  • Financial Security: 401(k) retirement plan with a company match, plus employer-paid life, AD+D, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability benefits.

  • Paid Time Away: 88 hours of PTO upon hire, increasing with tenure, plus Short Notice PTO and nine company-paid holidays.

  • Family Support: Paid parental and adoption leave for eligible employees.

  • Learning + Career Growth: Professional development through the Momentum Series, Weissman Learning Studio, unlimited LinkedIn Learning, Career Pathways, tuition reimbursement, and certification assistance.

  • Employee Assistance Program: Free and confidential resources for employees and household members, including counseling, financial planning, legal assistance, mental health resources, and personal growth support.

  • Competitive Compensation: A Market-Plus compensation philosophy designed to target pay above the market median while recognizing performance, internal equity, and individual impact.

  • Weekly Pay: Employees are paid every week.

title: Donor Care Specialist I, Fixed Sites (Boerne)
description:

Job Title: Donor Care Specialist I, Fixed Sites

Revision: 0000

Job Code: 700246
