FLSA: OT Eligible

Hybrid? N

CPF Level: TB1

Location: San Antonio

Business Unit: STB&T

General Summary

Responsible for the medical screening, whole blood phlebotomy, and care of blood donors within our service area in accordance with the standard operating procedure (SOP) and BBG/STB&T policies.

Support the blood needs of the community by converting donors to make the most impactful donation based upon current need and their eligibility/blood type.

Commit to and abide by the character of BioBridge Global’s Core Values of Accountability, Stewardship, Pioneer, Integrity, Respect and Excellence (ASPIRE).

Support, communicate and reinforce the mission and vision of the enterprise.

Provide world class customer service by capturing and being responsive to the voice of the customer (internal or external, including donors for select positions) through multiple feedback channels in order to resolve issues and drive satisfaction in accordance with the BBG customer engagement, feedback, and complaint processes.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

Essential Tasks

Report to work as scheduled.

Display a professional image and positive demeanor that contributes to the success of the organization.

Deliver an outstanding donation experience by exceeding donor expectations.

Maintain regulatory compliance by successfully completing training and competency assignments on time. Perform the quality control function (including documentation).

Determine donor eligibility through comprehensive donor verification, medical history interview and medical screening procedures (blood pressure, pulse, temperature, Hgb/Hct via finger stick).

Obtain donor consent prior to donation.

Perform whole blood phlebotomy.

Assess, treat and report adverse donor reactions (including documentation).

Perform record review and data entry.

Pack collected blood products according to defined manufacturing plans.

Ensure all necessary records and blood products are legible, labeled accurately and complete.

Maintain a good working relationship with coworkers and supervisor including reporting issues relating to

donors, donor groups, or departmental operations.

Performs other duties as assigned.

Non‐Essential Tasks

Provide assistance to other departments as needed.

Education

Requires a high school diploma or general equivalency diploma.

Licenses and/or Certifications

Phlebotomy Certification preferred

Experience

No prior specific work experience required.

Prefer phlebotomy experience in a blood or plasma center.

Knowledge

Must acquire a working knowledge of donor processing criteria.

Must acquire a working knowledge of medical terminology and geography.

Must become familiar with the community and area serviced.

Must acquire knowledge of and perform according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and policies.

Skills

Must demonstrate proper equipment use and care.

Must complete documentation in a legible manner.

Must demonstrate adherence to safety procedures.

Must demonstrate strong customer service skills.

Must demonstrate strong computer skills.

Must have excellent written and oral communication skills.

Must demonstrate competency in performing donor registration, screening, labeling, whole blood phlebotomy, monitoring donor safety, product packing and quality control.

Abilities

Must be a team player.

Must be able to keep information confidential.

Must be neat in appearance and well groomed.

Must be professional, organized, detail oriented, communicative, and have the ability to greet the public in a friendly and courteous manner.

Must have the ability to respond effectively to the most sensitive inquiries or complaints is crucial to the success of this position.

title: Project Officers - ANDOVER
description:
PROJECT OFFICERS

Andover


Salary - £37,021 - £39,718



PERMANENT CONTRACTS

Subject to successful completion of 6-month probationary period.



Cotswold Archaeology continues to grow as a sustainable and strong business, which currently employs over 350 full-time staff, working as one company across four offices.

Our success relies on the talent and hard work of all our employees, and we are looking to recruit Project Supervisors along with Project Officers and Senior Project Officers who are ready to take the next step in their career able to lead large and complex archaeological projects.

All of our Project Supervisors and Project Officers are expected to take leading roles in the publication of our work; publication, dissemination and outreach being the fundamental drivers for everything we do.

For Project Supervisor and Project Officer roles, membership of the CIfA at PCIfA level is desirable
(or able to demonstrate that you meet the requirements and a commitment to join if appointed)

Senior Project Officer role membership is essential at least to ACIFA level.

Our awarding winning training programmes provide support throughout all of the stages of your career which is demonstrated by the progression of many colleagues from site archaeologist to managers and technical specialists.



What we offer



A starting salary well above the CIfA minimum,

  • Project Supervisors - £32,977 - £35,665 (Dependent on Experience)
  • Project Officer - £37,021 - £39,718 (Dependent on Experience)
  • Senior Project Officers - £41,075 - £43,792 (Dependent on Experience)

A highly competitive benefits package including:

  • Defined Pension scheme
  • Life assurance scheme
  • 31 days leave (including Bank Holidays) – increasing with length of service
  • A lieu and overtime scheme operated for all driving time, and time spent in excess of 45 minutes each way as a passenger, outside of the normal 7.5 hour working day (accumulate up to 10 days additional lieu time annually)
  • Good quality accommodation, and subsistence payments for all away projects
  • Paid CIfA membership subscription
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Personal protective equipment will be issued for the duration of employment.

Possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or recent CSCS test pass is desirable. Currently new CSCS cards are not being issued to the archaeological sector, successful applicants without either a current and valid CSCS card or test pass, will be expected to pass either the CITB HS&E Operatives or Managers Test, which will be arranged and paid for by CA.


A full driving licence and ability/willingness to drive company vehicles (4x4s, Transit Vans) is essential.

Cotswold Archaeology has projects located in the vicinity of our offices, but in these roles, there will be a requirement to be rostered on protracted away projects where we will provide accommodation and the opportunity to accrue lieu and overtime.

Where away work is required good quality accommodation will be provided, along with subsistence payments (£24 per each night where eligible)

Please note all salaries quoted are annual equivalents based on a 37.5-hour week. We are unable to offer contracts with the provision of 7 day a week accommodated away work.



How to apply



To submit an application and cover letter please visit our recruitment page where you will also find full job descriptions for each role.

Closing date: Applications need to be submitted by 5pm - Wednesday 30th September 2026, however, we will be reviewing applications as they are submitted and making offers where possible.

If you are interested the roles and would like to know more, we would recommend an informal discussion with

Richard Greatorex – Principal Fieldwork Manager – Andover (07703 684031)

Steve Sheldon, Principal Fieldwork Manager – Kemble (07711 849780)

Adrian Scruby, Principal Fieldwork Manager – Milton Keynes (07718 485229)

Stuart Boulter, Principal Fieldwork Manager - Needham Market (07885 223524)

Alternatively, we can arrange for you to speak to one of our existing Project Officers about their experience of working at Cotswold Archaeology.

Cotswold Archaeology is an equal opportunities employer. All applications are assessed solely on the candidate’s relevant skills and experience relevant to the role.

We will take into consideration any reasonable adjustments required to support you. Should you need adjustments during the recruitment process, or require additional support related to neurodiversity or for any other reason, please let us know by contacting careers@cotswoldarchaeology.co.uk

Applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in the UK as defined by UK Visas and Immigration



Job Description

Role: Project Officer

Pay Scale: 17-19

Department: Fieldwork

Location: Andover

Report to: Senior Project Officer

Responsible for : Project Supervisors, Archaeologists and Trainees


Purpose of role

To lead the archaeological direction and site management of larger and more complex fieldwork sites and projects, ensuring performance targets are met (or exceeded), and assuring the quality of archaeological recording and understanding.




Main duties and responsibilities:


  • Site responsibility for managing the delivery of fieldwork to time, budget, quality and health and safety requirements.
  • Line manage and develop staff, ensuring their continuous improvement in performance through performance reviews, constructive feedback, initiating training, coaching and improved practices.
  • Assure the quality of archaeological understanding and site records, and oversee the compilation of archaeological archives to required standards.
  • Author typescript fieldwork reports, stratigraphic accounts, and fieldwork summaries efficiently and accurately.

  • Monitor and provide regular reports to Project Managers on project progress (budgetary and archaeological), logistical, staff and health and safety issues, and to maintain appropriate liaison with clients, Local Government officers, and contractors.
  • Ensure accurate completion and approval of appropriate administrative records, including timesheets, and allocation sheets.
  • Ensure effective deployment, maintenance and care of vehicles, plant and equipment, and maintain/provide accurate records ensuring accidents, damage and malfunctions are reported promptly and appropriately.

  • Ensure fieldwork is carried out in accordance with Actively promote, and develop a greater public awareness and appreciation of the work of CA through displays, publications, contributions to the website, media liaison, lectures etc.
  • Assist Project Managers in pre-project planning and preparation including undertaking the preparation of written schemes of investigation, trench plans, obtaining service information, notifying utility companies prior to excavation and making appropriate contact with landowners and agents and other relevant parties.
  • Deputise for the Senior Project Officer or Project Manager where appropriate.
  • Contribute to departmental processes and working practices via Learning Reports, feedback to Committee Representatives and/or project leaders, and discussion at performance reviews.
  • Actively promote, and develop a greater public awareness and appreciation of the work of CA through displays, publications, contributions to the website, media liaison, lectures etc.
  • Undertake additional duties appropriate to the role as required.


Personal specification

Essential

  • Knowledge and expertise in archaeological practice, including a general familiarity with the archaeology of Britain at all periods.
  • Experience of the supervision of large fieldwork projects (including excavations and large-scale/complex evaluations).
  • The ability to write clear and accurate fieldwork reports, stratigraphic accounts and fieldwork summaries.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to organise, motivate, train, appraise and direct staff.
  • Knowledge, awareness and understanding of business needs, budgets and timescales, within commercial archaeology.
  • Good working knowledge of all relevant Health and Safety requirements, and other relevant legislation.
  • The ability to communicate efficiently and courteously with sponsors and clients of CA, officers of other bodies and members of the public.
  • Administrative ability in the keeping of records and accounts and the submission of reports.
  • A full manual driving licence is essential, as is the ability and willingness to drive company vehicles (4x4, vans and minibuses)
  • Proficient in Microsoft applications – including word-processing, excel and database skills
  • Competent in carrying out first aid.

Desirable


  • Membership of the Chartered Institute for Archaeologists or willingness to join on appointment.
  • Demonstrable potential to competently author, or contribute to, reports/articles for publication.
  • In depth knowledge or expertise in a particular archaeological period, site type or subject (such as finds or environmental archaeology, survey or GIS).
  • Survey skills, including ability to operate Leica GPS/TST, and basic knowledge and understanding of CAD.
  • Possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or recent CSCS test pass.

title: Linen Floor Operator
description:
About Bluewater Linen:

At Bluewater Linen, we strive to create an environment where the skills and creativity of our employees can flourish and will be recognized and rewarded. Bluewater is located in the Sawmill District with state of the art manufacturing exclusively high-quality cleaning of hospitality linen (hotels & resorts only). Bluewater Linen opened in Spring of 2017 to help New Mexico hospitality operators create the most sustainable and cost-effective luxury bed linen product. Bluewater Linen is 9 years young and business is thriving, as people return to travel. We have the latest in automation and technology in the United States, and are looking for a customer-oriented Linen Floor Operator


Why This Role Matters:

We are seeking a Linen Floor Operator to join our team at Bluewater Linen, a state-of-the-art hospitality linen facility serving hotels and resorts across New Mexico. In this role, you will support the accuracy, quality, and flow of our production process by sorting, staging, and preparing hotel linens using automated equipment. Your work directly ensures the timely and professional delivery of high-quality linens to our hospitality partners, contributing to the guest experience at leading hotels throughout the state.


What You’ll Do

  • Operate the sort station to accurately separate incoming linens by type and customer.
  • Break down bundles from carts and load linens onto the conveyor system.
  • Enter customer information and product categories into the computer system with accuracy.
  • Divide linens on the sort deck and place them into correct bins.
  • Move loaded and unloaded carts throughout the plant and sterilize carts as needed.
  • Keep production areas clean, organized, and free of water or debris.
  • Operate additional workstations as trained and assigned by the Floor Supervisor.
  • Assist drivers by loading and unloading carts for deliveries and returns.
  • Review final cart contents at the weight station and stage them according to production sheets.
  • Support general production flow by moving carts into staging areas throughout the shift.
  • Perform other duties as assigned and aligned with production needs.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

  • Competitive pay and comprehensive benefits including a 25% match for 401k!
  • Generous employee discounts across Heritage Hotels, restaurants, spa and retail!
  • Free employee parking!
  • Growth and development opportunities!
  • Inclusive, people-first culture!

title: Maintenance
description:
Primo Center is seeking a qualified, caring individual who wants to make a difference by supporting families experiencing homelessness by working as a Maintenance Tech with our Maintenance and Facilities Team.
ABOUT PRIMO CENTER
The mission of Primo Center is to empower families to become productive, responsible, and independent members of their community. Today, the Primo Center is a leader in providing family shelter and permanent supportive housing, as well as integrated physical, dental, and mental health care, early childhood development, and supportive services to homeless families in Chicago. The organization has considerable capacity and experience as a provider of services to families affected by extreme poverty and homelessness, assisting more than 1100 people each year with the aid of volunteers, over 90 staff members, and an annual operating budget of nearly $10 million.
Primo Center operates facilities in high-need communities across Chicago, with locations in Austin on the city’s west side, Englewood on the south side, and Hermosa on the northwest side.
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Property/Preventive Maintenance (80%)
  • Perform general janitorial duties, cleaning, and trash removal, ensuring clean, presentable spaces for staff and clients
  • Complete necessary repairs, including fixing broken locks, patching walls, and addressing minor maintenance issues.
  • Inspect control panels and electrical wiring to identify and report potential hazards.
  • Install and set up common-use appliances and equipment as needed.
  • Maintain exterior areas, including garden/yard upkeep and seasonal tasks like snow removal.
  • Conduct routine maintenance tasks such as replacing light bulbs and air filters.
  • Troubleshoot and inspect building systems (e.g., HVAC, plumbing, ventilation).
  • Test and verify the functionality of safety systems, including fire alarms and emergency lighting.
  • Perform regular walk-throughs to ensure facility standards are upheld.
  • Follow through on maintenance issues to ensure timely and thorough resolution.
Vehicle Fleet Management (20%)
Maintain the organization’s fleet of vehicles, including coordination of licensing and registration. Ensure insurance documentation is available, and routine maintenance is performed. Coordinate services and requests for auto service.
Minimum Qualifications:
  • Commitment to Primo Center Mission
  • High School Diploma & 2+ years relevant work experience in related field, and/or military service.
  • Comfortable working in a multicultural environment
  • Ability to complete assigned work orders independently, with minimal supervision
  • Must be available for after hours, weekend and on-call work, as needed.
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license and pass background check
  • Capacity to take direction
  • Strong attention to detail
Preferred Qualifications
Advanced mechanical, electrical, plumbing or carpentry skills/certifications
Knowledge of HVAC and other building systems.
Physical Requirements
To ensure effective care and client support, this role requires the ability to:
  • Lift and carry up to 25 lbs. (e.g., supplies, personal belongings)
  • Stand, walk, bend, and climb stairs frequently throughout a shift
  • Respond rapidly to crises—move quickly across the facility and grounds
  • Perform routine inspections of communal areas (bending, reaching)
  • Work in a variety of indoor and outdoor settings; occasional exposure to loud or crowded environments
Reporting Relationship
This position reports to the Facilities Manager and may take additional directions from the Program Director in the absence of the Facilities Manager.
Compensation and Benefits –
  • Salary: $43,437 (non-exempt, full-time). Benefits include:
  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401(k), Flexible Spending Account
  • Paid Time Off, Wellness Days, Paid Holidays
  • Life/AD&D Insurance, Employee Assistance Program, mileage reimbursement
  • Voluntary AFLAC plans
Primo Center is an equal opportunity employer. The agency does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age disability, veteran or military status or any other protected status in accordance with federal and state law.

Haemme Sähköhuoltopäällikköä Pirkanmaalle

Kasvatamme taloteknistä huolto- ja ylläpitotoimintaamme ja haemme sähköhuoltopäällikköä vahvistamaan taloteknistä toimialaamme Pirkanmaan alueella.

Sähköhuoltopäällikkönä vastaat Pirkanmaalla oman vastuualueesi organisaation, asiakkuuksien ja liiketoiminnan johtamisesta sekä kehittämisestä. Vastaat oman vastuualueesi kannattavasta kasvusta ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisuudesta. Osallistut aktiivisesti uusasiakashankintaan sekä asiakassuhteiden ylläpitämiseen ja kehittämiseen.

Johdat henkilöstöäsi hyvän johtamisen periaatteiden mukaisesti hyödyntäen Constin johtamisjärjestelmää. Kehität tiimisi osaamista liiketoiminnan tarpeiden mukaisesti ja huolehdit turvallisen, motivoivan ja tehokkaan työympäristön ylläpitämisestä.

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen päivätyö, jossa työaika painottuu klo 7.00–15.30 välille. Työn aloitus sovitaan valitun henkilön kanssa.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa yksikönpäällikkö Jarkko Viikki, p. 050 592 2499.



Etsimältämme henkilöltä toivomme

- Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta tai vahvaa kokemusta sähköhuollosta, huolto- ja korjaustöiden organisoinnista sekä kunnossapidosta

- Kokemusta tarjouslaskennasta ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisesta johtamisesta

- Kokemusta sähköhuollon pien- ja palvelu-urakointiprojektien läpiviennistä sekä aikataulu- ja kustannushallinnasta

- Hyviä henkilöstöjohtamisen taitoja

- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja

- Huoltopäällikkönä sinulta vaaditaan itsenäistä työskentelyä ja vastuunkantamista

Hakemamme sähköhuoltopäällikkö on aikaansaava ja ratkaisukeskeinen henkilö, joka nauttii toiminnan suunnittelusta, organisoinnista ja kehittämisestä. Sinulla on kyky rakentaa ja ylläpitää pitkäjänteisiä yhteistyösuhteita asiakkaiden, yhteistyökumppaneiden ja alihankkijoiden kanssa.

Henkilöstö on toimintasi keskiössä ja johdat tiimiäsi esimerkillisesti luoden pohjan pitkäaikaisille työsuhteille, hyvälle työilmapiirille ja osaamisen kehittämiselle. Sinulla on hyvät neuvottelutaidot ja toimit toimintaperiaatteidemme mukaisesti. Haluat rakentaa turvallisen ja laadukkaan työympäristön kaikille osapuolille ja olet valmis tekemään töitä sen eteen.




Consti Talotekniikka Oy

Consti on yksi Suomen johtavista korjausrakentamiseen ja taloteknisiin palveluihin keskittyneistä yhtiöistä. Tarjoamme kattavasti korjausrakentamisen ja talotekniikan sekä valikoidusti uudisrakentamisen palveluita taloyhtiöille, yrityksille ja sijoittajille sekä julkiselle sektorille Suomen kasvukeskuksissa. Työllistämme noin 1000 korjausrakentamisen ja talotekniikan ammattilaista ympäri Suomea.

Uudistamme asunto-, teollisuus-, kauppa-, hotelli- ja toimistokiinteistöjä sekä julkisen sektorin kohteita. Consti tarjoaa myös palvelu-urakointia sekä sopimusasiakkaille toteutettavia huolto- ja ylläpitopalveluja.

title: Varasto- ja ostokoordinaattori, Metalaxis Oy, Tampere
description:
Metalaxis Recycling on kasvava suomalainen kierrätysalan yritys, joka on erikoistunut arvokkaiden materiaalien, kuten katalysaattoreiden, piirilevyjen (PCB) ja elektroniikkaromun, ostoon ja kierrätykseen.

Etsimme Tampereen tiimiimme käytännönläheistä, luotettavaa ja kaupallisesti ajattelevaa henkilöä. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät varastotyö, materiaalien ostaminen ja yhteydenpito asiakkaisiin. Oikealle henkilölle tehtävä tarjoaa myös selkeän mahdollisuuden kehittyä laajempiin oston ja asiakkuuksien hoidon tehtäviin.

Työtehtäväsi

  • Saapuvien materiaalien vastaanotto, käsittely ja järjestäminen

  • Varaston järjestyksestä ja varastotilanteesta huolehtiminen

  • Materiaalien ostaminen asiakkailta ja toimittajilta

  • Saapuvien ja lähtevien toimitusten koordinointi

  • Yhteydenpito asiakkaisiin ja toimittajiin

  • Katalysaattoreiden, piirilevyjen ja elektroniikkaromun arvioinnissa ja käsittelyssä avustaminen

  • Osto- ja varastotietojen huolellinen ylläpito

Mahdollisuus kehittyä

Tehtävä painottuu aluksi enemmän varastotyöhön, mutta koeajan aikana on mahdollisuus ottaa asteittain enemmän vastuuta ostoista, neuvotteluista ja asiakassuhteiden hoidosta.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme henkilöä, joka on:

  • Vastuullinen, luotettava ja järjestelmällinen

  • Oma-aloitteinen ja kykenee työskentelemään itsenäisesti

  • Käytännönläheinen ja valmis osallistumaan päivittäiseen varastotyöhön

  • Luonteva asiakas- ja toimittajaviestinnässä

  • Kaupallisesti ajatteleva ja kiinnostunut ostamisesta ja neuvotteluista

  • Halukas oppimaan uutta ja kehittymään tehtävässään

  • Valmis työskentelemään paikan päällä Tampereen toimipisteessämme

Aiempi kokemus kierrätysalalta, autoalalta, romumetallien tai elektroniikan parista, varastotyöstä, ostosta, myynnistä tai asiakaspalvelusta katsotaan eduksi. Arvostamme kuitenkin ennen kaikkea oikeaa asennetta, motivaatiota ja halua oppia.

Palkka ja kehittymismahdollisuudet

Aloituspalkka: 2 100–2 200 € brutto/kk.

Enintään kuuden kuukauden koeajan aikana tehtävässä on mahdollisuus kehittyä laajempaan ostorooliin ja ottaa enemmän vastuuta. Mikäli henkilö kehittyy onnistuneesti tähän rooliin, palkka voi nousta noin 2 600 euroon brutto/kk + tulospohjaiset bonukset.

Tarkemmista vastuualueista, palkkakehityksestä ja bonusmallista keskustellaan valitun henkilön kanssa henkilökohtaisesti.

title: Center Physical Therapy Director
description:
Agile offers a $20,000 Retention Bonus for this position!


Position Summary

As a Center Therapy Director, you will be responsible for providing treatment programs to restore and improve the physical functions of our patients. You will design programs based on the patient's specific goals to get them back to work and life with dignity and confidence. The target is to complete all activities accurately, with high quality, and in a timely manner.


Specialties: Orthopedics, sports medicine, manual therapy, ergonomics, injury prevention


Schedule: Flexible scheduling options - 4 10-hour shifts, 5 8-hour shifts, or 4 9-hour shifts with a half-day

Compensation: Starting compensation range is $115,000-$135,000 annually. This position is also eligible for a $10,000 annual SPIF incentive opportunity, paid quarterly. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.


Responsibilities

Clinical

  • Assesses the therapeutic and rehabilitative status of the patient and develops an appropriate treatment plan
  • Updates and modifies the treatment plan on an ongoing basis.
  • Uses clinical reasoning in treating and planning, implementing, and monitoring patient progress.
  • Instruct and counsel patients effectively in exercises, home programs, and patient education.
  • Maintain open communication with the patient and referring physician (when applicable) regarding the patient's plan of care and progress.
  • Treat team members, patients, families, and others with dignity and respect.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Administrative

  • Manage day-to-day clinic operations to ensure compliance with company medical management model.
  • Offer analysis, information and suggestions with the end goal of developing Ancillary service operational policies; determine productivity, production, quality and patient-services procedures.
  • Management and directing staff including physical therapists, physical therapy assistants, chiropractors, acupuncturists and physical therapy technicians
  • Oversee the hiring, training and development of ancillary staff members.
  • Ensure legal and medical compliance and remain updated on regulations at the local, state and federal levels.

title: Global Brand Senior Director - GI Cancer
location: Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States of America
description:
The Global Brand Director for GI Cancer will be part of the Global IO Commercial Franchise Team and will set and implement the global brand strategy for this priority ADC asset. The role leads integrated commercial planning across launch, growth and lifecycle development, working with global, regional and country teams and with Marketing, Global Analytics & Insights, Digital, Diagnostics, Pricing and Market Access, Global Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Corporate Affairs and other partners.

The role is accountable for creating a differentiated strategy and campaign, generating deep customer and market insights, delivering launch readiness, informing evidence and investment choices, and building market-shaping programs that maximize patient and business impact. It also represents Global Commercial perspectives in relevant cross-functional governance forums.

Typical accountabilities:

1. Global brand strategy and leadership

  • Set and communicate a clear, differentiated and long-term global brand strategy for GI asset aligned with the GI tumour strategy and broader Oncology priorities.

  • Lead annual strategic and operational planning, including positioning, segmentation, customer strategy, value proposition, target market selection and lifecycle priorities.

  • Generate deep customer, patient, market and competitive insights and translate them into choices that address unmet need and maximize value.

  • Develop future-focused revenue forecasts and business cases informed by robust insights and sound commercial judgement.

  • Represent Global Commercial in relevant Global Product Team and investment decision forums, providing commercially rigorous input to evidence generation and Phase III decisions.

​

2. Launch excellence and market shaping

  • Lead global launch strategy, launch readiness and execution for Sone-Ve across priority markets, with clear milestones, decision points and performance measures.

  • Develop a novel global brand campaign, clear and impactful messaging, core launch tactics and an integrated customer experience approach.

  • Build distinctive market-shaping programs that increase understanding of the unmet need, CLDN18.2 testing and the evolving role of ADCs in gastric cancer.

  • Engage regional and country teams early, incorporate market feedback and establish mechanisms to share learning and accelerate adoption of best practice.

  • Lead agency and vendor relationships, ensuring quality, pace, compliance, value and effective use of resources.

​

3. CG-02 indication leadership

  • Lead commercial preparation for the CG-02 indication as a major future growth opportunity for GI asset

  • Define the future market, customer needs, competitive differentiation, positioning, value proposition, and launch approach.

  • Partner with Clinical Development, Medical, Regulatory, Diagnostics and Market Access to ensure commercial insights inform evidence and access strategies.

  • Build an integrated pre-launch roadmap that enables early market shaping and ensures readiness ahead of anticipated regulatory milestones.

  • Identify portfolio and enterprise synergies that strengthen the asset's contribution to AstraZeneca’s gastric cancer ambition.

​

4. China rotation and GI Asia strategic acceleration

The role includes a structured six-month rotation within the China Oncology organization. The explicit purpose is to support the GI Asia focus for the GI asset in line with wider gastric cancer ambitions and to create a two-way flow of insight, capability and best practice between China, Asia and the global organization.

  • Build first-hand understanding of China’s gastric cancer ecosystem, customer needs, competitive dynamics and routes to patient impact.

  • Work closely with China Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Diagnostics and cross-functional leaders to support asset strategy and execution.

  • Ensure China and wider Asia insights are systematically incorporated into global strategy, launch planning and lifecycle choices.

  • Identify, document and actively transfer examples of best practice from asset in China and from wider enterprise work across the organization.

  • Develop a practical China and Asia best-practice playbook, with recommendations for scaling selected approaches across relevant markets.

  • Act as a strategic bridge between Global and China teams, strengthening relationships, decision quality and speed of learning.

5. Business, budget and performance management

  • Own and manage relevant global brand budgets, forecasts and resource allocation to target, with clear prioritization and financial discipline.
  • Define a focused performance framework and use leading and lagging measures to identify gaps, risks and opportunities.
  • Provide high-quality brand and business updates to senior leadership, generating clear decisions and follow-through.
  • Proactively identify and manage strategic, operational, regulatory and reputational risks, ensuring activities comply with policy, legal, regulatory and industry requirements.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test – Apps, Identity Management Services
description:
Summary

Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Join our team, and together we’ll explore all the ways to improve how Apple operates, freeing our employees to do what they do best: craft magical experiences for our customers. Apple’s Identity Management Services (IdMS) Quality Engineering group is looking for a highly motivated, result-oriented Engineer with a strong background in Software Development and Quality Engineering to join its team of highly skilled software engineers. You will be responsible for overseeing quality of the features that customers use on Apple Account Identity platforms and applications in a fast-paced dynamic environment. Your job is to keep our high-quality bar set high, and to help us identify and execute ways to raise it even higher. The Quality Engineer in this role will play a key role in delivering highly critical Identity Management features to customers on iOS, macOS and Web in addition to supporting the development of test frameworks for automation & test management tools.

Description

Join Apple’s Identity Management Services (IdMS) team as a Software Development Engineer in Test and be part of building the next generation of innovative software applications. We are looking for a passionate and driven engineer with experience in Quality engineering, developing tools and testing complex systems. In this role, you’ll be involved in testing the features on Web, iOS, macOS and other operating systems. Develop test plans and test cases with the goal of 100% automation and reduction of regression test cycles You will help with developing and maintaining automated test frameworks for exercising various features and continuously look for opportunities to improve efficiency and performance. As part of IdMS team, you’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, project teams and clients to develop test plans, execute test plans and test cases, and deliver high quality products Act as a strong advocate for quality in the software development process. Identify gaps or inefficiencies in workflows and suggest necessary process improvements. This is an opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where your contributions directly impact millions of Apple users around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Defining, implementing, and continuously evolving automated test frameworks, monitoring CI performance, test result analysis, as well as test triage and reporting.
  • Able to identify gaps in existing test plans and close them with scalability and maintainability in mind.
  • Drive all the quality work and also be a strong advocate for quality in the overall software development process.
  • Self-motivated and dynamic individual with strong technical and communication skills who can contribute in a team environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and able to work with various cross functional teams to deliver high quality products.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of proven experience in Software Development/Quality Engineering.
  • Strong passion for quality assurance in software, including developing and maintaining automated test libraries and tools.
  • Strong programming and software design skills, preferably in Java, Swift and/or Python.
  • Excellent knowledge of and experience with test methodologies ranging from functional unit tests to non-functional exploratory testing.
  • Experience in building automated UI and non-UI tests for user facing applications or system frameworks. Experience with testing on iOS, macOS, Web, Android and Windows.
  • Creative problem solver with a knack for building scalable solutions in a collaborative and cross-functional space.
  • Ability to proactively triage, investigate, and debug difficult technical and UX problems independently as well as collaboratively.
  • BA/BS in Computer Science/ Engineering or equivalent experience in related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Identity Management Services fundamentals.
  • Expertise in build tools and CI/CD integrations.
  • Proven ability to deliver high quality work in tight schedules.
  • Experience with Generative AI technologies (e.g., LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI-assisted developer tools).
  • Knowledge of the Apple development ecosystem using Xcode, Xcode Cloud, and XCT est/XCUIT est preferred, but not required.

Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. Apple provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities and in accordance with local requirements. Apple is a drug-free workplace.

title: Shift Lead
description:
• Opens and closes the store in the absence of store management, including all required systems start-ups, required cash handling, and ensuring the floor and stock room are ready for the business day. Responsible for opening back door of store for deliveries.

Customer Experience

  • Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).
Operations

title: Senior Delivery Consultant, Emerging Tech
description:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Senior Emerging Tech (Physical AI, Robotics and Supply Chain) Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives—with a specialized focus on Physical AI, robotics, simulation, and supply chain transformation including warehousing and assembly/production line environments. You'll drive customer success by providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

You have built a deep solutions implementation and delivery understanding of Physical AI's building blocks—AI for Automation, digital twin, robotics, edge solutions, simulation, and autonomous systems—as well as supply chain technologies. Proficient in architecting and deploying autonomous systems, robotics, simulation, digital twins, and industrial AI workloads on AWS, you'll provide a secure, reliable, and scalable Physical AI infrastructure for innovation by our customers. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:

- Architecting and delivering Physical AI solutions on AWS—including digital twin environments, discrete event simulation, robotic policy training pipelines, edge inference, and autonomous system deployments for manufacturing, logistics, and warehousing customers
- Engaging with customers end-to-end: from pre-sales discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, testing, and production handoff
- Designing and implementing simulation and synthetic data pipelines using tools such as NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, and AWS-native services (SageMaker, IoT, Greengrass, VAMS) to train and validate robotic and autonomous systems
- Providing subject matter expertise on warehousing, fulfillment, and production line transformation—conducting on-site assessments, identifying automation opportunities, and building customer trust through demonstrated domain knowledge
- Developing packaged offerings, reusable delivery accelerators, reference architectures, and training materials in the supply chain and Physical AI space to support delivery teams and go-to-market motions

A day in the life
This team partners with our customers to increase their shareholder value and assist in disrupting their business models. We enable our customers to drive competitive advantage by enhancing their digital capabilities that will enable them to innovate on new products and services.

Our key focus areas include: Emerging technologies including supply chain innovation, high-performance computing (HPC), quantum computing, spatial computing, robotics, blockchain, IoT, end-user computing, media solutions, and other innovative technologies that represent strategic innovation areas for our customers.


About the team
You'll join the ProServe Emerging Tech practice, a team focused on helping customers across manufacturing, logistics, and supply chain industries adopt Physical AI, robotics, and simulation technologies on AWS. We work directly with customers to solve real-world automation problems—from warehouse optimization to production line transformation—and you'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including solution architects, data scientists, and partner engineers. Our team values hands-on builders who are curious about the intersection of physical and digital systems, and we're committed to creating an environment where every team member can grow, contribute, and innovate.

ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Canada’s Best Managed

title: Senior Project Officers - KEMBLE
description:
SENIOR PROJECT OFFICERS


Kemble



Salary - £41,075 - £43,792



PERMANENT CONTRACTS

Subject to successful completion of 6-month probationary period.




Cotswold Archaeology continues to grow as a sustainable and strong business, which currently employs over 350 full-time staff, working as one company across four offices.

Our success relies on the talent and hard work of all our employees, and we are looking to recruit Project Supervisors along with Project Officers and Senior Project Officers who are ready to take the next step in their career able to lead large and complex archaeological projects.

All of our Project Supervisors and Project Officers are expected to take leading roles in the publication of our work; publication, dissemination and outreach being the fundamental drivers for everything we do.

For Project Supervisor and Project Officer roles, membership of the CIfA at PCIfA level is desirable
(or able to demonstrate that you meet the requirements and a commitment to join if appointed)

Senior Project Officer role membership is essential at least to ACIFA level.

Our awarding winning training programmes provide support throughout all of the stages of your career which is demonstrated by the progression of many colleagues from site archaeologist to managers and technical specialists.



What we offer



A starting salary well above the CIfA minimum,

  • Project Supervisors - £32,977 - £35,665 (Dependent on Experience)
  • Project Officer - £37,021 - £39,718 (Dependent on Experience)
  • Senior Project Officers - £41,075 - £43,792 (Dependent on Experience)

A highly competitive benefits package including:

  • Defined Pension scheme
  • Life assurance scheme
  • 31 days leave (including Bank Holidays) – increasing with length of service
  • A lieu and overtime scheme operated for all driving time, and time spent in excess of 45 minutes each way as a passenger, outside of the normal 7.5 hour working day (accumulate up to 10 days additional lieu time annually)
  • Good quality accommodation, and subsistence payments for all away projects
  • Paid CIfA membership subscription
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and a network of mental health first aiders across the organisation
  • Personal protective equipment will be issued for the duration of employment.

Possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or recent CSCS test pass is desirable. Currently new CSCS cards are not being issued to the archaeological sector, successful applicants without either a current and valid CSCS card or test pass, will be expected to pass either the CITB HS&E Operatives or Managers Test, which will be arranged and paid for by CA.



A full driving licence and ability/willingness to drive company vehicles (4x4s, Transit Vans) is essential.

Cotswold Archaeology has projects located in the vicinity of our offices, but in these roles, there will be a requirement to be rostered on protracted away projects where we will provide accommodation and the opportunity to accrue lieu and overtime.

Where away work is required good quality accommodation will be provided, along with subsistence payments (£24 each night where eligible)

Please note all salaries quoted are annual equivalents based on a 37.5-hour week. We are unable to offer contracts with the provision of 7 day a week accommodated away work.



How to apply



To submit an application and cover letter please visit our recruitment page where you will also find full job descriptions for each role.

Closing date: Applications need to be submitted by 5pm - Wednesday 30th September 2026, however, we will be reviewing applications as they are submitted and making offers where possible.

If you are interested the roles and would like to know more, we would recommend an informal discussion with

Richard Greatorex – Principal Fieldwork Manager – Andover (07703 684031)

Steve Sheldon, Principal Fieldwork Manager – Kemble (07711 849780)

Adrian Scruby, Principal Fieldwork Manager – Milton Keynes (07718 485229)

Stuart Boulter, Principal Fieldwork Manager - Needham Market (07885 223524)

Alternatively, we can arrange for you to speak to one of our existing Project Officers about their experience of working at Cotswold Archaeology.

Cotswold Archaeology is an equal opportunities employer. All applications are assessed solely on the candidate’s relevant skills and experience relevant to the role.

We will take into consideration any reasonable adjustments required to support you. Should you need adjustments during the recruitment process, or require additional support related to neurodiversity or for any other reason, please let us know by contacting careers@cotswoldarchaeology.co.uk

Applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in the UK as defined by UK Visas and Immigration



Job Description


Role: Senior Project Officer

Pay Scale: 20-22

Department: Fieldwork

Location: Kemble

Report to: Fieldwork Manager



Responsible for: Project Officers, Project Supervisors, Archaeologists and Trainees




Purpose of role

To lead the archaeological direction and site management of Cotswold Archaeology‘s most prestigious fieldwork projects, with principal responsibility for ensuring performance targets are met (or exceeded), and for assuring the quality of archaeological recording and understanding.


Main duties and responsibilities:


  • To be the lead officer on site responsible for managing the delivery of their projects to time, budget, quality and health and safety requirements.
  • To manage and develop staff, ensuring their continuous improvement in performance through initiating training, coaching and improved practices.
  • To assure the quality of archaeological understanding and site records, and oversee the compilation of archaeological archives to required standards.
  • To author reports to publication standard.
  • To monitor and provide regular reports to Project Managers on project progress (budgetary and archaeological), logistical, staff and health and safety issues, and to maintain appropriate liaison with clients, Local Government officers, and contractors.
  • To ensure accurate completion and approval of appropriate administrative records, including timesheets, plant and allocation sheets.
  • To ensure effective deployment and maintenance of vehicles, plant and equipment, and maintain/provide accurate records.
  • To take lead responsibility for ensuring that projects are carried out in accordance with the CA Health and Safety policy, and to prepare risk assessments and other relevant documentation.
  • To assist Project Managers in pre-project planning and preparation including undertaking the preparation of written schemes of investigation, trench plans, obtaining service information, notifying utility companies prior to excavation and making appropriate contact with landowners and agents and other relevant parties.
  • To deputise for the Project Manager where appropriate.
  • To actively promote, and develop a greater public awareness and appreciation of the work of CA through displays, publications, media liaison, lectures etc.
  • To carry out any other duties as required and appropriate to the role.


Personal specification

Essential

  • Knowledge and expertise in archaeological practice, including a general familiarity with the archaeology of Britain at all periods.
  • Experience of the supervision of large fieldwork (including excavation) and desk-based projects.
  • Knowledge, awareness and understanding of business needs, budgets and timescales, within commercial archaeology.
  • The ability to write reports to publication standard.
  • The ability to organise, motivate, train, appraise and direct staff.
  • Good working knowledge of all relevant Health and Safety requirements, and other relevant legislation.
  • The ability to communicate efficiently and courteously with sponsors and clients of CA, officers of other bodies and members of the public.
  • Administrative ability in the keeping of records and accounts and the submission of reports.
  • A full manual driving licence is essential, as is the ability and willingness to drive company vehicles (4x4s, vans and minibuses).
  • Proficient in Microsoft applications including Word, Excel and database skills.
  • Membership of the Chartered Institute of Archaeologists to a minimum of ACIFA or able and willing to become a member at this level.
  • Competent in carrying out First Aid.

Desirable


  • In depth knowledge or expertise in a particular archaeological period, site type or subject (such as finds or environmental archaeology, survey or GIS).
  • Demonstrable potential to write authoritative academic discussions for archaeological publications.
  • Survey skills, including ability to operate Leica 1200 series GPS/TST, and basic knowledge and understanding of CAD.
  • Possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or recent CSCS test pass.

title: MIG/MAG-hitsaaja teräsrakenteiden valmistukseen

Tarjoamme

- Määräaikaisen työn vuoden loppuun asti
- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä vaativien teräsrakenteiden parissa
- Ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön ja modernin tuotantoympäristön
- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa hitsausosaamista monipuolisissa projekteissa
Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä paikat täytetään sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

title: Ammatillinen ohjaaja, ajoneuvoala / Tredu
description:
Tampereen seudun ammattiopisto Tredu on Suomen toiseksi suurin ammatillisen koulutuksen järjestäjä. Tredu toimii kahdeksan kunnan alueella Pirkanmaalla. Tredussa opiskelee vuosittain noin 17 000 nuorta tai aikuista. Henkilöstöä on noin tuhat. Tredu palvelee yrityksiä henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämisessä. Koulutamme osaavia työntekijöitä ja opiskelijoita oppisopimuksella ja koulutussopimuksella. Aikuisille kohdennamme täsmällisiä, työelämän osaamistarpeeseen vastaavia koulutuksia. Ammatilliseen koulutukseen hakeudutaan sekä jatkuvan haun, että yhteishaun kautta. Lisäksi Tredu järjestää Tampereella aikuisten perusopetusta. Koulutus on suunnattu yli 17-vuotiaille henkilöille, joilla peruskoulu on kesken tai jotka haluavat täydentää aiempia opintojaan.

Haemme määräaikaiseen tehtävään ajalle 1.10.2026 - 6.6.2027 ajoneuvoalan ammatillista ohjaajaa. Pääasiallinen toimipiste palvelussuhteen alkaessa on Tredun Pallotien kampus Ylöjärvi.

Tehtävänäsi on ajoneuvoalan ajoneuvomekaanikko-opiskelijoiden (1, 2 ja 3. luokkien) ammatillinen ohjaus alan työsaliympäristössä. Ohjaajana toimit alan opettajien kanssa yhteistyössä ja tehtävänantojen mukaan, keskittyen tukemaan erityisesti hitaammin oppivia opiskelijoita sekä ylläpitämään työsalin oppimisympäristöä omalla työpanoksellasi.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on vähintään auto- tai ajoneuvoalan perustutkinto.

Eduksi katsotaan autoalan työkokemus, kouluttaja- tai ohjaajakokemus, esihenkilö- tai vastaavassa tehtävässä toimiminen.

title: Tuotantotyöntekijä Kanta-Hämeeseen
description:
Olemme vahvasti kasvava, mutta työntekijöistämme huolehtiva henkilöstöalan yritys. Missionamme on rakentaa kestävää työelämää sekä työntekijöille että työnantajille. Toimimme usealla alueella Suomessa ja pääkonttorimme sijaitsee Tampereella.

Haemme nyt asiakkaallemme Kanta-Hämeeseen

TUOTANTOTYÖNTEKIJÄÄ

Haluatko työn, jossa pääset näkemään konkreettisesti oman kädenjälkesi ja työskentelemään osana modernia, kehittyvää tuotantoympäristöä? Tässä tehtävässä pääset mukaan tuotannon sydämeen – paikkaan, jossa arjen tuotteet syntyvät tehokkaasti, turvallisesti ja tiimityön voimin. Työ sopii sinulle, joka nautit tekemisestä, opit nopeasti ja arvostat selkeitä prosesseja sekä vaihtelevia työpäiviä.

Työpäiväsi kuluvat tuotantolinjojen parissa, joissa jokainen vaihe on tärkeä osa kokonaisuutta. Tehtäväsi voivat vaihdella linjan valvonnasta ja käytöstä aina materiaalivirtojen hallintaan ja laadun tarkkailuun. Työssä yhdistyvät käytännön tekeminen, tarkkuus ja vastuullisuus, samalla saat mahdollisuuden oppia uutta tuotantotekniikasta ja prosesseista.

Työympäristö on moderni ja hyvin organisoitu, ja jokainen työntekijä on tärkeä osa sujuvaa tuotantoketjua. Päivittäisiin tehtäviin voi kuulua esimerkiksi tuotantolinjojen valvonta ja käyttö, materiaalien käsittely ja siirtäminen, laadun tarkkailu ja mittaukset sekä muut erilaiset tuotantoa tukevat avustavat tehtävät.

Työ on vuorotyötä, ja vuoroihin sisältyy myös ilta-, yö- ja viikonlopputyötä. Vuorotyö tuo vaihtelua arkeen ja mahdollistaa myös vapaita arkipäiviä.

Odotamme sinulta:

* kokemusta tuotanto-, varasto- tai prosessityöstä
* trukin tai muiden koneiden käyttökokemusta
* perustason teknistä ymmärrystä
* turvallista ja huolellista työskentelytapaa
* vähintään 18 vuoden ikää
* suomen kielen osaamista
* mahdollisuutta kulkea työpaikalle autolla
* reipasta, oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta
* halua oppia uutta ja toimia osana tiimiä
Tehtävässä noudatetaan teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimusta. Peruspalkka on 12 € / h, ja lisien kanssa kokonaisansio sijoittuu noin 15 € ja 16 € / h tasolle. Työsuhde alkaa määräaikaisena kokoaikatyönä. Hyvän tekijän löytyessä tehtävässä on mahdollisuus rekrytoitua myöhemmin suoraan asiakkaalle.

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, laita hakemuksesi meille CV:n kera ilmoituksen linkin kautta. Hakemukset otetaan vastaan ainoastaan rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta, jotta voimme käsitellä henkilötietoja turvallisesti ja tietosuojakäytäntömme mukaisesti.

Lisätietoja saat myös puhelimitse tai sähköpostilla:

Tina Dahlgren 050 369 2348 / tina.dahlgren@armstrong.fi tai Veera Penttinen 050 373 8691 / veera.penttinen@armstrong.fi

Armstrong on valtakunnallinen henkilöstöalanyritys, joka yhdistää osaavat tekijät ja hyvät työnantajat. Toimimme ihmisläheisesti ja uskomme, että onnistuneet työsuhteet syntyvät avoimesta vuorovaikutuksesta, luottamuksesta ja aidosta välittämisestä. Tukenasi on kokenut henkilöstöalan ammattilaisten tiimi koko työsuhteesi ajan. Huolehdimme työntekijöistämme tarjoamalla yksityisen työterveyshuollon sekä laadukkaat ja turvalliset työvarusteet työtehtävien vaatimusten mukaisesti.

Yhdellä hakemuksella voit avata oven useisiin työmahdollisuuksiin. Meille tärkeintä on löytää juuri sinulle sopiva työ ja varmistaa, että työsuhteesi sujuu alusta alkaen mutkattomasti ja luotettavasti.

description:
Haemme vapaaehtois- ja perhetoiminnan koordinaattoria vanhempainvapaan sijaisuuteen lasten ja nuorten toimintaa järjestävään yksikköömme, Toimelaan. Teemme ennalta ehkäisevää sosiaalityötä matalan kynnyksen vapaa-ajan toiminnan kautta. Kohderyhmämme ovat 7-13-vuotiaat lapset ja heidän perheensä. Meillä on lapsille tarkoitettua avointa toimintaa ja harrastusryhmiä. Järjestämme erilaisia teema- ja tapahtumapäiviä sekä retkiä. Teemme työtä perheiden kanssa esim. retkeilemällä yhdessä tai järjestämällä perhetapahtumia Toimelassa. Kaikki toimintamme on maksutonta.

Koordinaattorin työtehtävät koostuvat vapaaehtois- ja perhetoiminnan suunnittelusta, kehittämisestä sekä toteuttamisesta yhdessä tiimin muiden työntekijöiden kanssa, toiminnan valvonnasta sekä sen aikataulujen toteutumisesta. Hän osallistuu Toimelan kävijöiden sekä muiden toiminnassa mukana olevien kohderyhmien ohjaukseen, toiminnan suunnitteluun, toteutukseen ja kehittämiseen, tiedottamiseen sekä raportointiin. Koordinaattori osallistuu ja kehittää yhteistyötä eri verkostojen kanssa. Työ tapahtuu pääsääntöisin klo 9.00-17.00 välisenä aikana, mutta voi sisältää myös ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä.

Tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä edellytetään alalle soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa, kuten esimerkiksi sosionomin tutkintoa, sekä vähintään viiden vuoden työkokemusta sosiaalialalta. Eduksi luetaan kokemus vapaaehtoistoiminnan koordinoinnista, järjestötyön ja rahoitushakemusten tuntemus sekä työkokemus lasten kanssa työskentelystä. Työntekijältä odotetaan hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja työyhteisössä, kykyä organisoida omaa työtään, sujuvaa suullista ja kirjallista viestintää, sopeutumista muuttuviin tilanteisiin, kehitysmyönteisyyttä sekä huumorintajua. Tärkeänä nähdään oma-aloitteisuus ja idearikkaus. Työote on itseohjautuva, joten pääset vaikuttamaan monipuolisesti työn suunnitteluun, kehittämiseen ja toteuttamiseen esihenkilöiden tuella.

Tarjoamme sinulle joustavan ja kehittämismyönteisen työympäristön ja keskustelevan työyhteisön, jossa toimitaan vankalla ihmislähtöisellä arvopohjalla. Tehtävässäsi pääset kehittämään kolmannen sektorin yhteisösosiaalityötä ja vaikuttamaan myönteisesti lasten ja perheiden hyvinvointiin.

title: Workplace Experience Coordinator
description:
At Tecsys Inc., your work doesn’t just move products, it helps ensure patients get what they need, when they need it!

What You’ll Be Part Of

You will help power the supply chains behind critical industries like healthcare, where reliability isn’t optional, it’s essential.

We’re a growing global company rethinking how supply chains operate in a digital-first world. Here, people are trusted, empowered, and supported to do their best work, wherever they are. We are a remote first company! We earn trust daily through integrity and consistency, build each other up by recognizing every person's strength and working as one team, and explore boldly by staying curious and embracing change to drive real impact. That's who we are, and it's who you'll be joining.

You’ll join a culture driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and people who challenge what’s possible.

Why This Role Matters

As a Workplace Experience Coordinator, you will join our Workplace Experience Management group; a team at the heart of Tecsys’s commitment to creating an exceptional workplace experience for both employees and visitors. You’ll be responsible for the day-to-day coordination of office operations, facilities, employee services, workplace programs, and company events.

The Workplace Experience Coordinator serves as a trusted partner to employees and vendors, ensuring that the workplace environment supports productivity, collaboration, well-being, and Tecsys' culture. The role requires a high level of organization, attention to detail, customer service, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Coordinates daily office operations and serves as the first point of contact at reception, greeting employees, candidates, and visitors while managing calls, inquiries, and visitor registration/badging.
  • Manages office, kitchen, and workplace supplies, and coordinates facility maintenance, cleaning, and vendor relationships with building management and contractors.
  • Maintains common areas, conference rooms, and amenities, and supports office moves, workspace reconfigurations, and physical setup for meetings and events.
  • Acts as the primary contact for workplace-related employee requests, supporting onboarding/offboarding logistics (workstation readiness, equipment, shipping) in partnership with HR and IT.
  • Supports employee engagement, training coordination, and welcome experiences that reinforce a positive workplace culture.
  • Plans and executes employee events, celebrations, and wellness/recognition programs, handling logistics like catering, vendor coordination, and invoice tracking.
  • Supports health, safety, and security initiatives, including emergency preparedness, visitor access protocols, workplace inspections, and compliance with building regulations.

Requirements

What You Bring

We’re less focused on checking every box and more interested in what you bring to the team. If most of this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply:

  • Bilingualism (effective verbal & written communication skills in both English and French) is a must.
  • 3-5 years of experience in office administration, facilities coordination, workplace experience, or a related operations role, ideally within a corporate or fast-paced office environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills, with experience serving as a primary point of contact for employees, visitors, and stakeholders in a professional, welcoming manner.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience supporting planning and executing employee events, engagement initiatives, or workplace programs, including logistics such as catering, vendor coordination, and budget/invoice tracking.

English is required for this position because the selected candidate will need to communicate regularly with colleagues, clients, or partners located outside Quebec.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • A dynamic, in-office environment where you're at the heart of our workplace culture, working 5 days a week to support our team during core office hours.
  • Benefits and Vacation as of day one!
  • Pension Plan with competitive employer contribution.
  • Engaging Employee Events and Community Initiatives
  • Learn, stretch, and take on new challenges
  • Collaborate with global teams in a culture that values partnership, innovation, and shared success
  • We foster an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.

Let’s start the conversation and if this opportunity speaks to you even if you’re not actively looking, we’d love to connect.

Apply today and discover what you could build, solve, and achieve with Tecsys!

#LI-TECSYS

title: Customer Experience Team Lead (Weekend), International
description:
🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

💻 Role

The Customer Experience team is responsible for driving the best possible user experience through process improvement, order management, and problem-solving. As a leader of this team, you will be responsible for ensuring that our team of agents dig into every ticket to the lowest level of detail so they can best solve customer issues and provide critical user insights to the business. You’ll take those insights and make Whatnot 1% better every day by partnering with driving cross-functional teams to fix gaps in our product or experience that negatively impact our customers. You will also be responsible for driving team productivity through performance metrics while delivering a quality experience, ensuring our users are getting a quick, and quality experience.

  • Lead team performance and drive results in team productivity, quality, and customer experience

  • Manage, coach, encourage, and be responsible for the performance and culture of a team of agents

  • Maintain functional knowledge of, and act as a subject matter expert of processes, product, and projects related to day-to-day operations

  • Handling escalations from the team

  • Drive accountability on policies and other guidelines

  • Create new and use existing reporting to identify areas to improve performance metrics and productivity

  • Build a culture of insights generation to improve product, process, experience and overall business by reviewing Sigma & Zendesk metrics regularly

  • Identify and report on trends early and often.

  • Partner with training and content to reinforce compliance with new launches, processes, and policies.

  • Address and resolve critical issues from partners and other teams

  • Identify and call out areas of opportunity for Whatnot, helping improve or develop new processes to improve the user experience and business by understanding customer needs

  • Other ad-hoc project work as the business requires

We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in-person time for planning, problem-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our Dublin hub.

👋 You

People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it.

A hungry individual looking to continue their career in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment. Someone willing to take on any role or task, learn new skills, and be a part of building a great company. A customer service mentality with passion to reach the best possible outcome. As our next Customer Experience Team Lead you should have (e.g. 5+ years of support operations experience managing support KPIs such as CSAT), plus:

  • Experience as a leader with a strong desire and natural ability to motivate a team, set and achieve targets, and manage career growth and team performance

  • Experience driving operational excellence, quality improvements, and performance-managed multiple agents.

  • An analytical and data-driven approach, with experience distilling large data sets to actionable insights.

  • You are an owner, always looking for opportunities to better your work, team, product or customer experience

  • You are comfortable making tough decisions that balance the trade-off between quality and quantity

  • Knowledge of Zendesk, data platforms such as Sigma, familiar with excel/google Sheets

  • Experience in startups, marketplaces, or e-commerce preferred

  • Experience working within multichannel support operations (chat, email, sms)

  • You have familiarity with working with large, diverse customer support, and operations organizations preferred

  • You have the flexibility to work weekends

  • Fluent English (with the ability to work in an additional European language being an advantage)

🎁 Benefits

  • Generous Holiday and Time off Policy

  • Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision

  • Work From Home Support

    • Home office setup allowance

    • Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet

  • Care benefits

    • Monthly allowance for wellness

    • Annual allowance towards Childcare

    • Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses

  • Pension plans internationally

  • Monthly allowance to dogfood the app

    • All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!).

  • Parental Leave

    • 16 weeks of paid parental leave + one month gradual return to work *company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence.

💛 EOE

Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
