title: Legal Content Director
description:
The Legal Content Director leads Illinois Legal Aid Online’s (ILAO) Legal Content Team and is responsible for the quality, accessibility, usability, and effective management of ILAO’s legal information. The director creates and implements content strategies aligned with ILAO’s mission, organizational priorities, and users’ needs; supervises and develops a team of five content staff; and ensures the team delivers accurate, understandable, and actionable legal resources.

The Legal Content Director also serves as a functional leader in cross-team and cross-organizational initiatives. The director works collaboratively with ILAO’s Product Team, Community Engagement Team, leadership, operations, and external partners to ensure that ILAO’s legal expertise and content contribute effectively to shared products, structured knowledge resources, and service-delivery systems.


ILAO is a primarily remote organization, with a small office in Chicago. This role is expected to attend periodic in-person meetings. We welcome applications from across Illinois.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and implement ILAO’s legal content strategy - 30%

  • Develop and implement content strategies that advance organizational goals and respond to users’ needs.
  • Use performance data, user research, and other evidence to assess content impact, identify gaps, and establish improvement priorities.
  • Align the Content Team’s plans and resources with organizational priorities and approved cross-organizational initiatives.
  • Collaborate with the Product and Community Engagement Teams to develop effective models, interfaces, and methods for delivering legal information.
  • Monitor emerging technologies and content-management practices and recommend appropriate improvements.
  • Build productive relationships with internal teams, legal aid partners, subject-matter experts, and other collaborators.
  • Represent the Content Team’s expertise, capacity, and operational needs in organizational and collaborative planning.

Govern ILAO’s legal content and knowledge - 30%

  • Establish, document, and enforce standards, roles, workflows, and decision-making processes for creating, reviewing, structuring, publishing, updating, reusing, evaluating, and retiring legal content.
  • Ensure ILAO’s legal information meets quality standards for legal accuracy, readability, accessibility, usability, cultural responsiveness, and consistency.
  • Oversee monitoring of legal, policy, court, and program changes that may affect ILAO’s content or users.
  • Maintain and enforce ILAO’s content style guide and related content- and knowledge-management standards.
  • Own content performance measures, reporting, and analysis, and ensure findings lead to appropriate improvements.
  • Apply appropriate search engine optimization, generative engine optimization, and content-discovery practices.
  • Partner with the Product Team on user research and usability testing, and ensure that legal content and design support user needs and organizational objectives.

Lead the legal content team and its production - 30%

  • Set clear team goals, priorities, work plans, roles, and performance expectations.
  • Lead implementation and adoption of improved content models, governance practices, tools, and ways of working within the Content Team.
  • Supervise, coach, develop, and evaluate Content Team staff and oversee the work of volunteers and contractors, as applicable.
  • Hold team members accountable for quality, deadlines, collaboration, and compliance with established standards and processes.
  • Plan and allocate team capacity to meet ongoing publishing responsibilities and organizational project commitments.
  • Develop and manage the Content Team’s budget and make recommendations concerning staffing, contractors, technology, and other resources.
  • Foster an inclusive, collaborative, accountable, and continuously improving team culture.
  • Maintain direct responsibility for an appropriate section of ILAO’s published legal content.
  • Represent ILAO on one or more of the Illinois Supreme Court Access to Justice Commission's statewide forms subcommittees.

Other activities - 10%

  • Contribute legal-content expertise to funding strategies, grant proposals, grant implementation, and reporting.
  • Participate in appropriate fundraising activities, events, and campaigns.
  • Participate in staff, leadership, and administrative meetings.
  • Perform other responsibilities consistent with the position, as assigned.

Education/Experience:

  • Active Illinois law license, or ability to become an active Illinois attorney.
  • Minimum of 7 years’ experience publishing digital content, knowledge management, or legal content technology.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience supervising others, including staff, volunteers, and contractors.
  • Experience working in or with legal aid, access to justice, or public interest legal services.
  • Expertise in distilling complicated concepts into understandable, actionable resources.
  • Experience developing and executing content workflows and using content management systems.
  • Experience using Google Analytics or similar tools to evaluate content performance.
  • Knowledge of or ability to grow expertise in search engine optimization (SEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO).
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional work involving people outside the candidate’s direct supervisory authority.
  • Experience developing or implementing content-governance, knowledge-governance, or comparable information-management practices.
  • Experience building collaborative processes, clarifying roles and decision rights, and resolving competing priorities.
  • Working knowledge of structured content, metadata, taxonomies, information architecture, or other methods of making knowledge reusable across systems.
  • Experience helping staff adopt new tools, processes, roles, or ways of working.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with technical and nontechnical colleagues on products or systems involving complex subject matter.
  • Strong proficiency in using computers, mobile devices, and software, including fluency in using the Internet, mobile apps, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), with the ability to quickly learn new software programs.

Preference is given to candidates with:

  • Legal aid practice experience.
  • Experience with structured content, taxonomies, ontologies, knowledge bases, knowledge graphs, or comparable knowledge systems.
  • Experience participating in multi-organizational initiatives with shared governance.
  • Familiarity with source provenance, versioning, legal-change monitoring, and structured review workflows.
  • Familiarity with the responsible use of generative AI or retrieval-based systems for legal information.
  • Experience with Drupal.
  • Experience using legal technology, such as form preparation programs and case management systems.
  • Proficiency or fluency in Spanish.

Apply online at https://illinoislegalaid.bamboohr.com/careers/33. No recruiters and no snail mail, please. Must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer.

Deadline to Apply: Friday, October 2, 2026

Salary: $94,000 - $104,000

Benefits: ILAO offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health and dental insurance, life insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, health and dependent care flex spending account; 15 paid days off and 15 holidays in the first calendar year of employment; and, 403(b) retirement plan, to which ILAO contributes a required 1% of salary monthly. ILAO has a flexible workplace policy that supports remote work, wellness, and work-life balance.

About ILAO

At ILAO, we believe in justice. We believe the law is for everyone. We know, however, that not everyone is equal in the eyes of the legal system. People with intersectionalities of historically oppressed identities face the greatest barriers to using the law to get justice. ILAO seeks to break these barriers. ILAO believes that, equipped with the right tools, opportunities, and connections, people can shift the power differentials and get the justice they deserve.

For more than 20 years, Illinois Legal Aid Online (ILAO) has opened opportunities for justice so that people can resolve their problems, especially those from historically oppressed communities and groups who have the least access to lawyers.

Through innovation, we make the law understandable and accessible. We mobilize people with plain-language, 24/7, self-help tools - in three languages - so they can understand and assert their legal rights. ILAO helps people, who are unable to find or afford attorneys, overcome legal barriers and open opportunities for justice.

title: Operations Lead (Internal)
description:
At Arux Group, we protect what matters most: our people, our property, and our community. We are looking for an experienced operational leader who can bring structure, accountability, and momentum to our day-to-day operations across every program we run.


If you have a track record of leading teams, managing complex schedules, and driving process improvement in a fast-paced, compliance-heavy environment, this is your opportunity to lead operations for Arux Group across our Corso, Fossa, and Merlin programs.


What You Will Do


  • Oversee all company operations across the Corso (Static Site Security), Fossa (Executive Protection), and Merlin (Private Investigation) programs.
  • Work with the Operations Coordinator to manage the company schedule, specialist staffing, work assignments, and related operational tasks.
  • Manage full-cycle hiring, onboarding, disciplinary actions, and termination processes for specialists and operational staff in accordance with company policy and applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  • Oversee and maintain HR systems and processes related to employee records, scheduling, certifications, compliance tracking, and personnel management.
  • Manage compliance, including licensing and certifications, to ensure specialists meet eligibility requirements for work in each state.
  • Coordinate with the training program on recertifications and ongoing eligibility for specialists.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor day-to-day operational systems and processes to provide visibility into the goals, progress, and obstacles of company initiatives.
  • Draw on relationships with program heads, external partners, and vendors to make decisions on operational activity that align with strategic company goals and vision.
  • Devise strategies to grow all company programs and implement process improvements that maximize output and minimize costs.
  • Adhere to company policies and standards, and ensure laws, regulations, and compliance are being followed.
  • Be willing and able to assist with field duties as needed to ensure no dark hours (open shifts).


Schedule


Standard work hours are Monday through Friday, with flexibility for evenings, weekends, or field support as required to meet operational demands. We work to support work-life balance where possible while meeting client and company needs.


Who We Are Looking For


  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Valid state-issued armed security officer license (OR/WA/ID) and CPL.
  • Must possess armed certifications in all states in which Arux Group operates.
  • Prior experience in law enforcement, military, or security preferred.
  • Proven experience in an operational leadership or management role, with a track record of successful process improvement and team management.
  • Experience with HR systems, hiring/termination processes, and personnel management preferred.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with company executives, the Operations Coordinator, and other departments and leaders.
  • Knowledge of industry best practices and operational standards, including licensing and compliance requirements across relevant states.
  • Must obtain OR DPSST Supervisory Manager certification within 90 days of hire.


This role reports directly to the CEO and carries direct supervisory responsibility over the Operations Coordinator. You'll be the operational backbone connecting our Corso, Fossa, and Merlin programs, with a direct line to leadership and real ownership over how the company runs day to day.


Why Join Arux Group


As Operations Lead, you'll sit at the center of everything Arux Group does. You'll have direct access to executive leadership, ownership over operational strategy, and the opportunity to shape how we scale across all three programs.


Compensation


  • $80,200/year flat annual salary, including through the 90-day probationary period.
  • Annual review period.


We invest in our people with ongoing training, professional development, and a culture built on tenacity, integrity, innovation, and courage. Join a team where your leadership directly shapes company success and growth.

title: Software Developer
description:
PRIMARY OBJECTIVE

The Software Developer will be responsible for creating new web-based applications and maintaining and enhancing internal custom applications using Angular, C#, Entity framework, and SQL. They will be responsible for the high-level function and technical requirements based on direct interactions with the users and knowledge of enterprise architecture. Developing and implementing moderate to complex applications will be necessary. They will be developing primarily internally used applications – we prioritize getting it right for our staff vs. having it done fast.

You will be working with a small team that brainstorms and whiteboards and occasionally goes down rabbit holes that can lead nowhere or somewhere. Utilizing AI (Claude Code) to aid in coding is encouraged and we provide access. Having it create code with no HITL is considered sub-optimal – you must be able to debug and write code if Anthropic is down. We all work Monday-Friday during regular office hours; you’ll have most of your nights and weekends off. We encourage people who may not fit all the requirements to apply. If you have the basics and want to learn and grow, we’re looking for you.

MAJOR DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create and maintain new software as needed for internal and external users.
  • Maintain existing legacy software and convert it to a web-based platform.
  • Troubleshoot and fix applications as needed.
  • Identify and improve application performance.
  • Design, develop and implement unit and scenario testing for existing code base and for new functionality under development.
  • Work with current internal staff to help scope and find new opportunities to help operations.
  • Follow best practices for coding, testing and validation.
  • Continue to learn, go to conferences, complete training (work provided), so that you can see what new technologies need to be implemented and how.

This list is not all-inclusive and is subject to additions, revisions, and deletions as the business necessitates.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE/EDUCATION

  • 1-5 years of related experience (bachelor’s in computer science or related field may substitute for up to 2 years of experience)
  • Agile and Waterfall development methodologies

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS

  • Experience developing and working with a variety of design patterns, architectures, and styles including: REST API's, background services, rich web-based UIs, and desktop
  • Backend: C#, modern .NET Core 3.1 through .NET 10+, .NET Framework 4.8+, SQL Server 2019+
  • Frontend: HTML5, TypeScript, Angular, XML
  • Desktop Development: WinForms, WPF (phasing out)
  • Cloud & DevOps:
  • Experience using Source Control tools required; Git preferred

  • Experience with one or more Cloud providers encouraged, Azure preferred.
  • AI: Experience using AI development tools encouraged; Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex etc.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • High degree of attention to detail, accuracy, initiative, and dependability.
  • Maintain positive relationships and provide effective communication with customers, employees, and management.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
  • Willingness to learn banking regulations, laws, and procedures.
  • Authorization to work in the U.S. without employer sponsorship

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

  • Primary workspace designation is hybrid. In office 3 days a week with flexibility.
  • Professional environment in a secure high-rise office suite in downtown Denver, CO.
  • Working hours may vary between 5:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. The primary hours are 7:30 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. Monday through Friday, with infrequent overtime as needed.

Who is Giles Automotive?
We pride ourselves in living out our mission to be a “vehicle" that improves the lives of our employees, our customers, and our community. Come work for a great company and earn a great living. If you have a great attitude and love serving the people of our community, we want you to apply. We’d love to meet you!

title: Rakennusapulainen
location: Kangasala, Pirkkala, Lempäälä, Tampere, Nokia, Finland
description:
Rakennusapulainen
Sopisiko muiden töiden oheen hommia raksalla vai haluaisitko opintojen ohessa päästä välillä näkemään arkipäivää työmaalla?
Etsimme rakennusapulaisia vaihteleviin työtehtäviin satunnaisille työkeikoille. Meillä on tarjolla tehtäviä eri työmailla vaihtelevan mittaisia pätkiä päivästä viikkoihin. Kaipaamme joukkoomme reippaita tekijöitä, joilla on intoa fyysiseen työhön ja kiinnostus oppia raksan toimintaa.
Rakennusapulaisen työhön kuuluu monipuoliset tehtävät työmaalla. Työt voivat sisältää esimerkiksi työmaan puhtaanapitoa, tavaroiden siirtämistä, rakennusmateriaalien suojausta, aidan rakennusta sekä pieniä, avustavia rakennustöitä. Rakennusapulaisena työskentelet osana työmaan toimintaa ja työsi mahdollistaa työmaan jouhevaa etenemistä.
Odotamme hakijalta:
Intoa kehittyä rakennusalan ammattilaiseksi
Jo hieman kokemusta alalta tai alan opintoja suoritettuna/kesken
Halua oppia työskentelemään erilaisissa työtehtävissä työmaalla
Reipasta, toimeen tarttuvaa asennetta
Halua työskennellä turvallisesti ja ohjeita noudattaen
Voimassa olevaa työturvakorttia
Työtehtävissä tulee pärjätä suomella
Tarjoamme:
Mahdollisuuden päästä näkemään ja kokemaan erilaisten rakennustyömaiden arkipäivää
Monipuoliset tehtävät
Työvarusteet
Asioinnin tutun yhteyshenkilön kanssa Eezyllä
Tehtävässä noudatetaan rakennusalan työehtosopimusta, palkkaus kokemuksen mukaisesti 13,46 -14,50 €/h välillä. Työtehtävät sijoittuvat arkipäiville klo 6-16.00 välille. Työmaat sijaitsevat Tampereella ja naapurikunnissa, auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan tehtävässä eduksi.
----------
Kiinnostuitko?
Hae tehtävään hakulomakkeen kautta, emme käsittele sähköpostitse tulleita hakemuksia tietoturvasyistä. Täytäthän hakemukselle perustietosi ja tiedot aiemmasta työkokemuksestasi ja koulutuksesta. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jatkuvasti.
For this position, we require proficiency in Finnish as the working language.
----------
Lisätiedot:
Jos haluat tiedustella lisää, olethan rohkeasti yhteydessä.

title: Transportation Security Officer (TSO)
description:

You are required to perform various tasks such as: wanding pat down searches operation of x-ray machines lifting of baggage (up to 50 pounds) and screening and ticket review using electronic and imaging equipment. title: Lähihoitaja, vakituinen ja määräaikainen, Kyterinhoviin Janakkalaan
description:
Etsimme kahta lähihoitajaa: toinen tehtävistä on vakituinen ja toinen määräaikainen ajalle 30.9.2026-23.4.2027. Meillä on tarjolla merkityksellistä työtä asumispalveluissa. Tervetuloa osaksi huolehtivaa ja osaavaa tiimiä Janakkalan Kyterinhoviin asumispalveluyksikköön.

Kyterinhovin asumispalveluyksikkö on 60-paikkainen ikäihmisten pitkäaikaista asumispalvelua tarjoava yksikkö Turengissa, Janakkalan kunnassa. Yksikkömme on jakautunut neljään kotialueeseen, joissa hoitajamme työskentelevät.

Lähihoitajana vastaat ikäihmisten päivittäisestä hoidosta ja hyvinvoinnista yksikössämme. Työpäiväsi koostuu monipuolisista tehtävistä, kuten perushoidosta, lääkehoidosta, hoitotoimenpiteistä, sekä monialaisesta yhteistyöstä. Näiden lisäksi pääset toteuttamaan myös saattohoitoa.

Saat mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa työtäsi niin arjessa, kuin erilaisten monipuolisten koulutusmahdollisuuksien avulla. Tiimissämme on osaava joukko lähihoitajia, sairaanhoitajia sekä tiimikoordinaattori. Työ on 3-vuorotyötä.

Sinulta toivomme hyviä tiimityötaitoja, kehittämismyönteisyyttä sekä taitoa toimia osana moniammatillista tiimiä. Tehtävän kelpoisuusehtona sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinto tai muu vastaava tutkinto. Edellytämme rekisteröitymistä sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöiden keskusrekisteriin. Lääkehoitoon osallistumisen edellytyksenä on voimassa oleva lääkehoitokoulutus, jonka voit tarvittaessa päivittää meillä työsuhteen alussa.

Järjestämme rekrytointikeskusteluja jo hakuaikana, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Oma Hämeellä on käytössä laajalti työsuhde-etuja:
- Työmatkaetu
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetu Epassi Flex
- Työterveys Terveystalossa
- Työkokemuksen perusteella jopa 38 päivää lomaa vuodessa (lauantaita ei kuluta lomapäiviä)
- Monipuoliset kouluttautumismahdollisuudet koko henkilöstölle

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2647,17 €/kk. Tehtäväkohtaisen palkan lisäksi maksamme kokemukseen perustuvaa lisää, jonka määrä voi olla 0%-8%. Palvelusajan perusteella määräytyy myös lomapäivien kertymä. Työaika on 38,25 tuntia viikossa. Hakemuksen tulee olla perillä hakuajan päättymiseen mennessä, hakemus tulee jättää Kuntarekry -järjestelmän kautta.

Iäkkäiden ja vammaisten kanssa työskentelevän tulee esittää sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain (741/2023) 28.1 §:n mukainen rikosrekisterilain 6.4 §:n tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote.

Palkkaus ja muut palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät SOTE-sopimuksen mukaan. Koeaika on kuusi kuukautta. Välittömässä potilas- ja asiakastyössä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48 §:n edellyttämää rokotussuojaa ja 55 §:n mukaista hengityselinten tuberkuloosia koskevaa selvitystä. Oma Hämeessä haluamme tukea tieteellisen tutkimustyön tekemistä myöntämällä palkallisia vapaita esimerkiksi väitöskirjan tekemiseen, ylemmän korkeakoulututkinnon lopputyön tekemiseen tai muun tieteellisen tutkimuksen tekemiseen. Edistämme strategiamme mukaisesti henkilöstömme monimuotoisuutta ja yhdenvertaisuutta.

title: Research Coordinator
description:
Batterjee Medical College is seeking a qualified and highly organized Research Coordinator to support the administration, coordination, and development of the College’s research activities.

The role supports the day-to-day operations of the Research Unit, including research projects, ethical approval processes, research documentation, data management, faculty and student research activities, and regulatory compliance. The successful candidate will work closely with faculty members, students, research supervisors, academic departments, and relevant internal and external stakeholders to facilitate efficient and compliant research operations.

Key Responsibilities

Research Operations & Administration

  • Coordinate the daily administrative activities of the Research Unit.
  • Assist in preparing research proposals, ethics applications, and documentation for Institutional Review Boards (IRB).
  • Maintain accurate research records, databases, and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate research-related meetings, workshops, events, and activities.
  • Prepare regular research reports and operational updates.
  • Monitor ongoing research activities and follow up on required deliverables.

Research Support & Facilitation

  • Provide administrative and operational support to faculty members and students throughout research processes.
  • Respond to research-related inquiries and guide researchers on required processes and documentation.
  • Support data collection, data entry, and basic research analysis when required.
  • Promote research activities and encourage faculty and student participation.
  • Support research initiatives in accordance with institutional guidelines and ethical standards.

Coordination & Communication

  • Coordinate with academic departments, research supervisors, and institutional committees.
  • Act as a liaison between researchers and supporting units, including laboratories, the Library, IT, and Quality & Accreditation.
  • Facilitate communication with external research stakeholders, collaborators, and relevant organizations when required.

Research Ethics, Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure research activities comply with institutional research policies, IRB requirements, and ethical procedures.
  • Monitor the progress of ongoing research projects and follow up on required milestones and deliverables.
  • Support the preparation of research-related documentation and evidence for accreditation purposes.
  • Maintain confidentiality of research materials, data, and sensitive information.

Faculty & Student Research Engagement

  • Organize research orientation sessions, training programs, workshops, and awareness activities.
  • Provide first-line academic and administrative support to students undertaking research projects.
  • Guide students toward appropriate research resources and escalate academic matters to research supervisors when necessary.
  • Support strategic research initiatives and participate in institutional research activities as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific, medical, health sciences, or research-related field.
  • Master’s degree in a relevant field is preferred and considered an advantage.
  • Additional training or certification in Research Methodology, Research Ethics, Clinical Research, or related areas is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in research coordination, research administration, academic administration, or a related role.
  • Previous experience supporting research projects, ethics/IRB applications, research documentation, or faculty and student research activities is preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of research processes, research ethics, and documentation requirements.
  • Excellent administrative and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage research data, maintain accurate records, and support basic research analysis.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple research projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and research management tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English.
  • Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills.
  • High attention to detail and strong time-management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality.
  • Adaptability and commitment to supporting faculty and student research.

title: Senior Security Engineer, AWS Foundational Services Security
description:
We're looking for a Security Engineer to join the team that secures the foundational Identity and crypto systems powering AWS.

You'll work directly with service teams across some of the most critical systems in cloud computing to find and fix security risks before they become problems. You will design security controls and provide architectural guidance for systems that operate at massive scale and underpin the core cloud platform millions of customers depend on. You'll also work closely with fast-paced engineering teams to pioneer new ways of securing AI-first and AI-native development, shaping how security keeps up as the industry transforms.



Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain automated security guardrails and paved paths that enable secure-by-default practices
- Engage early with development teams at the ideation and design stage to embed security into applications from the start, providing guidance on secure architecture and coding practices
- Build automated, continuous security assessment capabilities that replace manual security reviews and scale across our business unit
- Contribute code for security fixes and paved path solutions directly alongside developers, making the secure path the easy path
- Partner with developers to build scalable, self-service security tools that enable teams to identify and remediate security risks without bottlenecking on security teams
- Design and implement preventive and detective security controls that provide continuous assurance rather than point-in-time assessments
- Collaborate with security stakeholders to define and drive the long-term security strategy and participate in periodic on-call rotations to support security incidents
- Leverage AI tools and techniques to accelerate security assessments, automate threat detection, and drive innovation in how we secure systems at scale


About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Bulk Technician
description:
As a Bulk Technician, you'll help keep apartment communities clean by removing furniture, oversized trash, and bulk items from resident properties. This is a physical, hands-on role involving route driving, heavy lifting, and hauling materials to the landfill. We're looking for dependable team members who work hard, move efficiently, and take pride in getting the job done right.

Schedule & Pay:

  • Full Time
  • Monday- Friday
  • Start time: 02:00 AM
  • Overtime may be required
  • Pay $19-$21/ hr. (Depending on experience)

Bulk Tech Driver Responsibilities:

  • Drive a company truck and trailer to service properties along an assigned daily route.
  • Check in, photograph, and document bulky items using our mobile app.
  • Load and secure oversized items using proper lifting and stacking techniques.
  • Haul collected items to the assigned disposal facility and unload upon arrival.
  • Complete scheduled pickups efficiently within established timeframes.
  • Communicate property concerns, access issues, or service exceptions to management promptly.

title: Trainee Archaeologist - KEMBLE
description:
Trainee Archaeologists


Kemble


Salary £27,278



Fixed-term (six-month) contracts available, with immediate start dates.


Cotswold Archaeology is one of the largest and most respected archaeological practices in the country, employing over 380 professional staff and carrying out some of the most interesting, complex and largest archaeological and heritage projects across England and Wales.

We are seeking ,Experienced Archaeologists, Archaeologists and Trainees across all four of our offices to work on a range of exciting archaeological projects, spanning different time periods. With a strong ongoing program of fieldwork, we are looking for motivated, dedicated individuals to join our team.

Cotswold Archaeology has projects located in the vicinity of our offices, but for these roles there will be a requirement to be rostered on protracted away projects where we will provide accommodation and the opportunity to accrue lieu and overtime.

Where away work is required good quality accommodation will be provided, along with subsistence payments. (£24 per each night where eligible).

What we offer

Along with a starting salary above the CIfA minimum, we offer a highly competitive benefits package including:

  • 30 days annual leave (including statutory holidays) - please note that the annual leave allowance will be prorated for the duration of contract.
  • Defined contribution pension scheme
  • Life insurance scheme
  • Paid CIfA membership subscription (following qualifying period)
  • Company sick pay - prorated for the duration of contract.
  • A generous lieu scheme operated for all driving time, and time spent in excess of 45 minutes each way as a passenger, outside of the normal 7.5 hour working day (able to accumulate up to 10 days additional lieu time annually)
  • Overnight accommodation and subsistence when working on away projects.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and a network of mental health first aiders across the organisation.
  • Personal protective equipment

Please note all salaries quoted are annual equivalents based on a 37.5-hour week. We are unable to offer contracts with the provision of 7 day a week accommodated away work.

Membership of the CIfA at PCIfA level is desirable, as is possession of a current and valid CSCS Health and Safety Card or CSCS test pass. Although new CSCS cards are not currently being issued to the archaeological sector, successful applicants without a current and valid CSCS card or test pass, will be expected to pass the CITB HS&E Operatives Test, which will be arranged and paid for by CA.


A full manual driving licence is desirable.



The Details

Trainee Archaeologists £27,278

Like many of those that join our award-winning trainee archaeologist program you might be a recent graduate with a degree or masters in a relevant subject; you may have graduated some time ago but never realised your ambitions to enter the profession; or you may have no formal archaeology related qualifications but your passion and interest in the subject is attracting you to developing a career in the sector.

For a candidate without a formal degree, we would expect to see:

  • Exposure to a range of archaeological periods (e.g. prehistoric, Roman, medieval etc.)
  • Experience on multiple site types and contexts (urban, rural, eval etc.)
  • An understanding of core excavation methods including excavation methods, stratigraphy, recording and post-excavation
  • Evidence of working in varied outdoor conditions, which is part of the day-to-day realities of archaeological fieldwork.

Our trainee programme has been developed with the flexibility to accommodate a broad spectrum of educational ability and work experience. The training includes all the core skills required to be effective as an Archaeologist including excavation, drawing, photography and sampling.



How to apply



Please submit a CV and cover letter by visiting our careers page.

Closing date: Applications need to be submitted by 5pm Wednesday 30th September 2026



Cotswold Archaeology is an equal opportunities employer. All applications are assessed solely on the candidate’s relevant skills and experience relevant to the role.

We will take into consideration any reasonable adjustments required to support you. Should you need adjustments during the recruitment process, or require additional support related to neurodiversity or for any other reason, please let us know by contacting careers@cotswoldarchaeology.co.uk

Applicants must already have the legal right to live and work in the UK as defined by UK Visas and Immigration

title: Silicon SoC Analog Integration Lead, Google Cloud
description:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As the SoC Analog Integration Lead, you will play a critical role in driving the strategy, selection, architectural and physical integration, and silicon execution of high-speed analog and mixed-signal IPs— including PCIe, SerDes, DDR, HBM PHY etc.—into complex, high-performance SoCs.

In this role, you will engage with external and internal IP providers, SoC architects, package/board engineering teams, physical design, timing and floorplan teams and post-silicon validation teams. You will own the full life cycle of analog IP integration, ensuring that strict performance, power, thermal, area, floorplan, signal integrity, and system-level interface requirements are met from early architecture through volume production.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

  • Lead the evaluation and selection of third-party analog/mixed-signal IPs (e.g., PCIe, SerDes, HBM PHY), establishing detailed technical SLAs, functional specifications, and delivery schedules.
  • Serve as the primary technical interface to IP vendors, overseeing technical reviews, bug tracking, silicon errata evaluations, and waiver processes.
  • Collaborate with floorplan and physical design teams to define integration requirements, ensuring alignment on placement, power delivery, clocking, and functional interfaces.
  • Partner with packaging, PCB, and SI teams to optimize high-speed trace and power delivery, driving the die-package co-design process.
  • Oversee AMS simulations and netlist checks, while leading post-silicon bring-up, lab characterization (BER, jitter), and validation to support the product ramp.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in analog and mixed-signal IPs such as PCIe, UCIe, Serdes, HBM or DDR PHYs in advanced technology nodes.
  • Experience negotiating technical specifications and managing technical deliverables with IP vendors.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Experience across architectural requirements, physical design, packaging and board constraints and system considerations for high speed IO and memory PHYs.
  • Experience planning or utilizing DFT hooks and on-chip telemetry to support silicon health monitoring and bring-up workflows.
  • Track record of successfully integrating complex Ios and mixed signal IPs into an SoC and experience in post-Si taking SoCs to production quality.
  • Proven expertise managing end-to-end technical evaluations, performance assessment, and QA sign-offs with third-party analog IP vendors.

title: Sr. Electronic Designer
description:
AEM (Advanced Environmental Monitoring) is the global leader in innovative mission critical weather, wildfire and water monitoring and intelligence solutions. We aim to be the world’s essential source for environmental insights – enabling decisive action and positive outcomes for our customers and their constituents. Our family of innovators offers world-class hydrometeorological technologies and services, including sensors, dataloggers, telemetry, and advanced analytics and software. Our technology and services empower the communities and organizations to survive – and thrive – in the face of escalating environmental risks.


AEM is seeking a Senior/Inter. Electronic Designer with deep experience in product development within a manufacturing environment.


This role is responsible for end-to-end ownership of electronic hardware systems, from architecture through production release and lifecycle support. The ideal candidate brings a strong bias toward designing for manufacturability, testability, reliability, and cost efficiency, and has a track record of supporting products through NPI, production ramp, and field performance feedback loops.


This is a hands-on, production-critical role — not just a research-only or prototype-focused position.


Job Responsibilities:


Product Architecture with Manufacturing in Mind

  • Lead system architecture with explicit consideration for DFM, DFA, DFT, and lifecycle cost
  • Evaluate design tradeoffs across performance, cost, yield, and supply chain risk
  • Define scalable hardware platforms that support production repeatability and field reliability

Hardware Design & Implementation

  • Design complex multi-layer PCB systems (analog, digital, mixed-signal)
  • Develop robust power architectures and noise mitigation strategies
  • Select components with attention to availability, obsolescence risk, and multi-sourcing
  • Produce complete and production-ready schematics, layouts, and BOMs

Design for Test & Validation

  • Define and implement test strategies from prototype through production
  • Design and release test fixtures and manufacturing test processes
  • Develop validation plans that ensure traceability between requirements, test coverage, and field performance

NPI & Production Ramp Ownership

  • Lead hardware through ECO, release, and configuration control processes
  • Partner with manufacturing teams to ensure smooth NPI transitions
  • Actively monitor and improve production yield, scrap rates, and rework drivers
  • Troubleshoot and resolve line-level failures and systemic production issues

Failure Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead root cause analysis for production and field failures
  • Drive corrective actions that improve design robustness and manufacturability
  • Support legacy product sustainment, including redesign for obsolescence
  • Use field and production data to inform next-generation design improvements

Cross-Functional Manufacturing Integration

  • Work closely with manufacturing engineering, quality, supply chain, and test teams
  • Interface with contract manufacturers and internal production teams
  • Collaborate with firmware and mechanical engineering to ensure system-level integration
  • Mentor junior engineers and technicians on production-aware design practices

This job description may not be inclusive of all assigned duties, responsibilities, or aspects of the job described, and may be amended at any time at the sole discretion of the Employer.

title: Staff Perception Scientist
description:
We seek a Staff Perception Scientist to advance how Physical AI systems understand the world on Arm. You will research and develop perception methods that transform camera, depth, radar, lidar, audio, and other sensor data into reliable representations for robotic and autonomous decision-making.

You will provide scientific and technical leadership from problem formulation and experimentation through optimized on-device deployment. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of computer vision, machine learning, multimodal sensing, robotics, and edge computing.

Responsibilities:

Perception research and algorithm development

  • Develop innovative methods for detection, segmentation, tracking, localization, scene understanding, and multimodal sensor fusion.
  • Formulate research questions, design controlled experiments, and translate promising ideas into robust production algorithms.
  • Advance model architectures and representations that remain accurate under motion, occlusion, domain shift, and sensor degradation.

Data, evaluation, and scientific rigor

  • Define datasets, labeling strategies, metrics, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols that reflect real-world product requirements.
  • Build reproducible training and analysis pipelines, investigate failure modes, and communicate findings with quantitative evidence.
  • Develop methods for efficient data selection, synthetic data, weak or self-supervision, and continuous model improvement.

Edge deployment and performance

  • Optimize models and algorithms for latency, power, memory, and accuracy across Arm CPUs and heterogeneous AI accelerators.
  • Partner with systems engineers to integrate perception pipelines with sensor I/O, runtimes, robotics middleware, and downstream consumers.
  • Create reference implementations and diagnostics that make perception behavior observable, testable, and maintainable on-device.

Scientific leadership and collaboration

  • Partner with robotics, controls, hardware, product, and customer teams to define perception requirements and system tradeoffs.
  • Lead research reviews, mentor scientists and engineers, and guide the technical roadmap for on-device perception.
  • Publish, patent, or contribute open work when appropriate, and represent Arm in relevant research and developer communities.

Required Skills and Experience :

  • 6+ years of experience in applied perception, computer vision, machine learning, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in Python and C++ with PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Deep learning for visual or multimodal perception, training, evaluation, and failure analysis
  • Probability, optimization, 3D geometry, coordinate transforms, calibration, and sensor fusion
  • Efficient inference, numerical precision, model compression, and edge deployment constraints
  • 3+ years of experience moving perception research into real-time or production systems.
  • A record of impact through deployed systems, publications, patents, or widely used research artifacts.
  • Ability to design rigorous experiments and explain results to research, engineering, and product audiences.
  • Excellent scientific judgment, problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :

  • PhD or equivalent experience in computer vision, machine learning, robotics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Experience with 3D perception, SLAM, visual-inertial estimation, tracking, occupancy, or world models.
  • Experience with multimodal models, self-supervised learning, domain adaptation, or continual learning.
  • Familiarity with synthetic data, simulation, active learning, and dataset curation.
  • Experience with quantization, pruning, distillation, compilers, or heterogeneous accelerators.
  • Background in robotics, autonomous systems, industrial vision, or other safety- or reliability-sensitive applications.
  • Contributions to open-source perception systems, benchmarks, datasets, or research communities.

Why this role matters:

Physical AI depends on perception that is accurate, efficient, and resilient outside controlled cloud environments. Models must interpret changing scenes and imperfect sensors while meeting strict limits on latency, power, memory, privacy, and connectivity.

In this role, you will shape perception technology for Arm-powered devices used in robotics, industrial systems, and consumer products. Your work will help intelligent machines understand and respond to the physical world in real time.

Kemble

  • Overnight accommodation and subsistence when working on away projects.

Archaeologists £28,532 - £29,255 Dependent on Experience

Please submit a CV and cover letter by visiting our careers page.

2026

title: Energy Efficiency Specialist
description:
This is a highly technical field work involving the instrumented diagnosis of building heat loss characteristics, the development of detailed analysis of diagnostic findings, the preparation of technical contractor work order specifications, the inspection and quality assurance of all work in progress, and the final instrumented inspection of completed work. An employee in this class is responsible for insuring the energy efficiency integrity of small construction projects and all aspects of weatherization projects. The interpretation of more complex building and furnace heat loss dynamics based on measurable conditions using a blower door, infrared camera, combustion analyses and other instrumented test procedures is a significant aspect of this work. The use of a portable computer as well as manual calculation of house “leakage curves” and the regression analysis of curve data points are routinely required.

Work is performed under the direct supervision of a Technical Supervisor or Project Manager. Assignments require evaluative thinking carried out in accordance with accepted heat loss diagnostic and construction inspection standards and applicable codes and regulations. The employee in this class works with the client, contractor and PHDC staff to insure all weatherization and construction projects result in maximum attainable energy efficiency. Work requires moderate physical effort.

  • Superior health insurance (including prescription, vision, and dental)
  • Generous retirement plan
  • Life insurance
  • Deferred compensation
  • Paid vacation and sick time
  • And much more!

(The following statement represents the minimum training and experience standards which will be used to admit or reject applicants for tests.)

  • Completion of a two-year program with major coursework in building science or civil engineering technology at a technical institute or two years at an accredited college or university with major coursework in civil, electrical, or mechanical engineering or architectural design, and
  • Three years of experience performing technical field work in building renovation, weatherization, furnace repair, and replacement, with at least three (3) years’ experience in energy conservation retrofitting either in design, installation, or quality control capacity, and attendance at least one State-sponsored weatherization seminar.

title: Ravitsemistyöntekijä
description:
Virtain kaupunki hakee ruokapalveluihin positiivisen asenteen omaavaa ravitsemistyöntekijää määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Työn aloitus sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin mahdollisimman pian. Toimen ensisijainen sijoituspaikka on keskuskeittiö. Nykyaikainen keskuskeittiö toimii vuoden jokaisena päivänä, joten viikonlopputyö on myös mahdollista. Työvuorot sijoittuvat klo 7-15 välille.

Pääsääntöisesti päivittäisiin työtehtäviin kuuluvat ravitsemistyöntekijän työtehtävät: ruokien ja välitystuotteiden keräily ja pakkaus, astiahuolto, puhtaanapito, kuormien vastaanotto ja omavalvonnan suorittaminen.

Toivomme sinulta kykyä niin itsenäiseen kuin tiimistyöskentelyyn. Tehtävä vaatii vastuullisuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja joustavuutta työjärjestelyissä päivän aikana. Viihdyt ajoittain vilkkaassakin työympäristössä. Hallitset hyvät työyhteisötaidot ja tuet toiminnallasi työyhteisösi hyvää yhteishenkeä. Työskentelet sujuvasti suomen kielellä ja sinulla on perustaidot tietotekniikasta.

Tehtävään valittavalta edellytämme tehtävään soveltuvaa työkokemusta tai alan tutkintoa, esimerkiksi ruokapalvelualan perustutkintoa. Arvostamme alalta hankittua työkokemusta. Hygieniapassi on tehtävässä eduksi.

Olemme savuton työpaikka.

Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Alkuperäiset tutkinto- ja työtodistukset tulee esittää mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä, johon kutsutaan erikseen.
Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunnallisen työ- ja virkaehtosopimuksen (KVTES) mukaan. Tuemme työhyvinvointiasi ateriaedulla.
Tehtävä tulee ottaa vastaan sopimuksen mukaan.
Toimessa sovelletaan koeaikaa.

Hakemus tulee tehdä sähköisesti www.kuntarekry.fi

title: Leipomopäällikkö
description:
Leipomo Juuri on myymäläleipomoihin erikoistunut yritys, jolla on leipomot Riihimäellä, Hyvinkäällä, Keravalla, Tampereella, Salossa, Espoossa, Vantaalla, Helsingissä, Kirkkonummella, Porissa, Oulussa, Naantalissa, Turussa, Mäntsälässä, Lahdessa, Nokialla, Valkeakoskella sekä Kuopiossa ja ensi vuoden alussa myös Forssassa ja Porvoossa. Valmistamme laadukkaat juureen leivotut artesaanileivät sekä herkulliset kahvileivät käsityönä. Haluamme olla Suomen ykkösleipomo niin työnantajana, yhteistyökumppanina, kuin asiakkaille tuotteiltamme.

Haemme nyt tammikuussa avattavaan K-Citymarket Forssan leipomoomme leipomopäällikköä. Tehtävässä toimit esihenkilönä leipomosi työntekijöille, vastaat oman leipomosi toiminnan organisoinnista sekä kannattavuudesta. Meillä pyritään hyödyntämään ihmisten vahvuudet eikä yritetä tunkea kaikkia samaan muottiin. Kevyt organisaatio tarkoittaa vähemmän raporttien täyttelyä ja enemmän keskustelua. Tukenasi sinulla on yrittäjä, jolla on yli kahdenkymmenen vuoden kokemus myymäläleipomoista, sekä aluepäällikkö, jolla on laaja kokemus esihenkilötyön ja tiimien onnistumisen tukemisessa.

Odotamme sinulta vahvaa leivontaosaamista, kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä sekä järjestelmäosaamista (Excel ja muut Microsoft Office -ohjelmat).

title: Employee Relations Partner
description:
About the role and team

Working in Employee and Labor Relations (ELR) at Uber means navigating the high-stakes, "messy" reality of workplace dynamics. You aren’t just a neutral observer; you are a restorative practitioner tasked with clearing the path for an empowered employee experience. This role requires the grit to dive into complex interpersonal conflicts and allegations of misconduct—from harassment to retaliation—where the answers aren't always clear and the emotional stakes are high.

Success here requires a mindset of extreme ownership and the resilience to move fast without sacrificing care. You will be part of a team where excellence is the norm, but you must be a self-starter who thrives in the ambiguity of a global organization. We are looking for a teammate who stays calm under pressure, balances empathy with decisive action, and is motivated by the challenge of turning workplace friction into a healthy, productive culture through sound judgment and restorative interventions.

What you’ll do

  • Manage a high volume of complex ELR cases involving interpersonal conflict and misconduct allegations, conducting thorough, objective investigations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Analyze context, facts, and documentation to develop balanced, actionable recommendations that hold people accountable while actively seeking to restore damaged workplace relationships.
  • Lead high-stakes restorative conversations and mediated discussions between employees, focusing on repairing harm and establishing sustainable paths forward.
  • Maintain absolute confidentiality and data integrity within our global case management systems, leveraging data to identify organizational trends and develop measured responses.
  • Foster action-oriented relationships with HR, Employment Legal, and business leaders at all levels, influencing outcomes through clarity, expertise, and persuasion.
  • Take ownership of ELR priority projects, building scalable processes that improve how we support our global community during critical moments of conflict.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employee relations case management (e.g., Title IX investigations, mediation, HR, or employment law).
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in a high-volume case management role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with Restorative Practices, Restorative Justice, or similar interventions such as Community Circles and Action Plans focused on harm reduction.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to persuade and influence stakeholders at all levels of a matrixed organization.
  • Strong systems thinking with the ability to manage competing priorities and time-sensitive tasks with extreme attention to detail.
  • Deep expertise in analyzing and applying HR policies, standards, and global employment principles.
  • Demonstrated resilience and the ability to navigate complex people issues with critical thinking and a positive, solution-oriented outlook.

For Chicago, IL-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $107,000 per year - USD $119,000 per year.

You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
description:
Sigma Software is an international technology partner with over 24 years of experience delivering impactful digital solutions for global businesses.

With a team of 2,000+ professionals, the company collaborates with leading brands such as AstraZeneca, Viaplay, Volvo, and Scania, helping them scale, innovate, and stay competitive in rapidly evolving markets.

Operating across more than 20 countries, with 40+ offices in Europe and the Americas, Sigma Software combines global reach with strong local expertise. The company has delivered projects for over 500 clients, spanning industries such as fintech, healthcare, automotive, and media.

CUSTOMER

Our Customer is a Sweden-based AdTech company specializing in advanced self-serve advertising platforms that automate direct transactions between advertisers and major global publishers. Their solutions improve transparency and operational efficiency in digital advertising and are trusted by globally recognized brands including TripAdvisor, Bloomberg, The Washington Post, Opera, and Dow Jones. The company processes millions of advertising transactions worldwide and is actively investing in AI-driven data capabilities.

PROJECT

The project focuses on building a modern data platform from the ground up with an emphasis on immutable event streams, governed canonical models, semantic layers, and scalable analytics infrastructure. The platform will support analytical workloads, operational data products, AI applications, and future customer-facing data experiences.

As a Principal / Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will own key architectural decisions, define scalable engineering standards, and help deliver the first production-ready version of the platform in a high-scale AdTech environment.

Key Technologies: Apache Iceberg, Spark, Flink, Trino, AWS, Python, Scala, Java, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code

Job Description

Lead the technical design and architecture of a modern enterprise-scale data platform

  • Define scalable data flows from Iceberg-based event storage into analytical and operational data products
  • Evaluate and select technologies for orchestration, transformation, querying, serving, and storage
  • Design reusable canonical entities and data models across advertising, campaigns, inventory, billing, and customer domains
  • Establish scalable engineering patterns for batch and near-real-time processing
  • Build reliable and observable data pipelines for high-volume AdTech workloads
  • Implement data quality, lineage, observability, and reconciliation capabilities
  • Collaborate with Platform Engineering teams to introduce CI-enforced data contracts and governance standards
  • Define tenant isolation, access control, and regional data boundary strategies
  • Establish standards for testing, deployment automation, schema evolution, and versioning
  • Optimize platform performance, scalability, and infrastructure costs
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering excellence across the team
  • Partner closely with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders

Qualifications

8+ years of experience designing and operating production-grade data platforms

  • Strong expertise in distributed data systems and high-volume event-driven architectures
  • Deep understanding of modern lakehouse architectures and Apache Iceberg
  • Advanced SQL skills and production experience with Python, Java, Scala, or similar languages
  • Experience with distributed processing and query technologies such as Spark, Flink, or Trino
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling, partitioning strategies, and performance optimization
  • Proven experience building batch and near-real-time data pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud infrastructure
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and production observability
  • Experience implementing data contracts, schema evolution, and data quality frameworks
  • Ability to make pragmatic architectural decisions in greenfield environments
  • Upper-Intermediate or higher English level
  • Strong communication and technical leadership skills

WILL BE A PLUS

  • Experience in AdTech or other high-volume event-processing domains
  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS data architectures
  • Familiarity with semantic layer technologies
  • Experience supporting both analytics and ML/AI workloads
  • Understanding of privacy regulations and data residency requirements

title: DIRECTOR OF SURGICAL SERVICES ($30,000 Recruitment Compensation & $5,000 Relocation Assistance Available)
description:
Under the general direction and in communication with the CNO, the Director of Surgical Services is a registered professional nurse who is responsible for developing, implementing, evaluating and improving the processes for patient surgical services, and for providing safe, prudent and economical nursing care according to regulatory standards. S/he coordinates all patient care and safety activities in Surgical Services, manages the department routines, caregivers, and serves as a member of the leadership team. She/he serves as a positive representation of Gila Regional Medical Center within GRMC and out in the community.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

· Works in all ways to positively support and improve the quality, efficiency and effectiveness of GRMC’s approach to patient-centered care and safety, and in serving our caregivers, customer’s and community.

· Works as a positive, change oriented, transformational leader in alignment with, and as a model for GRMC’s Organizational values, and leadership culture and approach.

· Is accountable for the achievement of assigned objectives, goals, projects and outcomes.

· Demonstrates strategic direction, operational and fiscal oversight to assigned Departments, and ensuring accountability with goals and directives.

· Facilitates patient care services, and safety, develops and implements policies and procedures and standards of nursing care, ensuring safe and efficient care. Participates in Quality Improvement activities to improve key measures and outcomes.

· Functions as a member of the management team; participates in the planning and development of hospital policies and procedures most pertinent to the perioperative setting.

· Participates in strategic planning as it relates to Surgical Services, the hospital, and the healthcare industry.

· Serves as a liaison between the medical and nursing staff as well as Gila Regional’s clinical services. Collaborates with medical staff to best use limited resources and to ensure the best patient care. Fosters physician and staff satisfaction.

· Works with medical staff to develop and implement staffing patterns and ratios to meet patient care, safety and the organization’s block scheduling integrity.

· Maintains strong interdepartmental relationships in order to collaboratively achieve positive outcomes in providing excellent patient care and safety.

· Provides orientation and ongoing education, and serves as a resource, to ensure competency of nursing staff.

· Analyzes and reports on the quality of patient care and safety according to regulatory agencies, such as The Joint Commission, CMS, GRMC Peer Review, GRMC nursing clinical Peer review.

· Prepares and manages the department operational and capital budgets. Anticipates long-range capital needs. Monitors productivity.

· Manages department staff, including scheduling, payroll, hiring, evaluation, discipline, recognition, and conflict resolution, according to Human Resources policies.

· Reports on dash boards, quality efforts and projects to the Surgical Section committee.

· Conducts staff meetings.

· Investigates errors, complaints and process opportunities.

· Conducts documentation reviews.

Functions as a Registered Nurse, providing direct patient care, as needed.

title: Full-Stack .NET Developer
description:
Wij zoeken onze eerste interne Full-Stack .NET Developer.

Niet zomaar een developer, maar een nieuwsgierige en innovatieve bouwer.

Iemand die graag nieuwe technologie verkent. Die AI ziet als een hulpmiddel om slimmer te werken. Die energie krijgt van complexe technische vraagstukken en voldoening haalt uit het bouwen van oplossingen die echt gebruikt worden.

Geen repetitief werk. Wel veel afwisseling, innovatie en zichtbare impact.


  • Je ontwikkelt zelfstandig features doorheen onze volledige softwareomgeving, van backend tot frontend.
  • Je vertaalt functionele analyses naar gebruiksvriendelijke en performante toepassingen.
  • Je werkt mee aan oplossingen die dagelijks gebruikt worden binnen onze verschillende afdelingen.
  • Je bouwt integraties tussen verschillende systemen.
  • Je zet AI-tools en nieuwe technologieën in waar ze een meerwaarde bieden.

Jouw tech stack: .NET 10, ASP.NET Core, RabbitMQ (MassTransit), MySQL (EF Core) en Angular met DevExtreme, draaiend op Kubernetes (Azure AKS)

Met wie werk je samen?

Je werkt nauw samen met onze IT Business Analyst, die jouw dagelijkse aanspreekpunt is. Hij vormt de brug tussen de business en development, verzorgt de functionele analyses en bewaakt de eindvalidatie.

Dat betekent dat je duidelijke analyses aangereikt krijgt waarmee je meteen aan de slag kan. Je hoeft dus niet voortdurend te schakelen tussen verschillende stakeholders, maar krijgt de ruimte om je te focussen op wat je het liefst doet: bouwen.

Architecturale vraagstukken pak je in principe zelf op. Loop je tegen iets aan waar je even wil sparren of dieper wil gaan, dan kan je terugvallen op externe specialisten.


  • 5+ jaar ervaring als full-stack .NET developer, waarvan minstens 2 jaar ervaring met projecten waarbij je zelf verantwoordelijkheid droeg voor de technische uitwerking van analyse tot oplevering.
  • Sterk in C#/ .NET 8+ en ASP.NET Core (async/await, DI, Web APIs).
  • Solide Angular-ervaring (wij zitten op een recente versie) met TypeScript en RxJS. Ervaring met een component-library zoals DevExtreme is een sterke plus. Je vertaalt een ontwerp zelfstandig naar een werkende UI.
  • Ervaring met messaging/ een service bus-architectuur en de bijhorende principes (asynchrone communicatie, pub/sub, retry, idempotency). Kennis van een concreet product zoals RabbitMQ of Azure Service Bus is een plus.
  • MySQL + EF Core, inclusief query optimalisatie.
  • Engineering hygiëne: Git, unit & integration tests, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Azure cloud-omgeving: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Database for MySQL, Key Vault, Application Insights.
  • Ook een goede kennis van het Nederlands is een must.

Jouw AI-mindset?

Je zet AI-tools zoals GitHub Copilot, Claude Code of Cursor actief in om efficiënter te werken. Je gebruikt AI als hulpmiddel, maar beoordeelt de output steeds kritisch.


Database, Business, Messaging, Analyse, ASP.NET, Functionele analyse, Front-end, RabbitMQ, .NET, Full Stack, Engineering, Windows Azure, Hygiëne, Git, AngularJS, C#, Ontwerpbeginselen, Git, Entity Framework, User Interface, Communicatie, TypeScript, MySQL, Nederlands, Docker

title: IT Infrastructure Technician
description:
F&P Brands is seeking motivated, hands-on individuals to join our IT team for a specialized 1-2 month overnight project. With over 30 years of experience operating more than 40 restaurants, including Dairy Queen and Schlotzsky’s, we are currently upgrading our infrastructure and need dedicated "boots on the ground" to help us scale.

If you enjoy active work, aren’t afraid of heights or power tools, and are looking for a short-term role with steady hours, we want to hear from you!

Project Scope & Primary Responsibilities

This is a labor-intensive technical role focused on the physical installation of network infrastructure during non-business hours. You will support our lead technicians with:

Overnight Infrastructure Work: Executing technical tasks during late-night/early-morning shifts to ensure zero disruption to restaurant guests.

Cabling: Pulling and routing Cat5/Cat6 cables through restaurant environments, kitchens, and offices.

Termination: Properly terminating Cat5/Cat6 cables and testing connections for reliability.

Hardware Installation: Mounting and installing Wireless Access Points (WAPs), security cameras, and Kitchen Display Systems (KDS).

Physical Labor: Climbing ladders, opening ceiling tiles, and using power tools to mount equipment.

Site Support: Assisting with the physical placement of Point of Sale (POS) components and credit card terminals.

title: Operations Delivery Manager
description:
The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei, Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission

The Operations Delivery Manager is based within our Account Operations team and reporting into the Senior Delivery Manager.

The Operations Delivery Manager will play a crucial role in overseeing and executing multiple clients focused projects within the account operation team.

The Operations Delivery Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and collaborating efficiently with internal and external stakeholders to define objectives, create proper project plans, monitor project progress, resolve any issues that may arise during the project lifecycle, and adhere to deadlines established.

The Operations Delivery Manager must be a strategic thinker who can influence others and successfully work and manage multiple tasks across several teams. This role requires strong organizational skills and a highly motivated candidate with proven experience managing complex projects from initiation to delivery.

The Operations Delivery Manager will be responsible for creating and presenting the project status to internal stakeholders and clients.

Customer experience is mandatory with strong communication skills and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Be the main driver behind the execution of multiple complex clients’ projects.
  • Scope, create, plan, track and manage tasks against the plan.
  • Create and share project status update after every meeting.
  • Serve as a liaison between all internal and external teams, coordinate, and set up recurring meetings as required.
  • Monitor project timelines and deliverables against the plan, Identify and mitigate risks to ensure on-time completion.
  • Facilitate meetings and discussions using necessary tools to communicate goals, status updates, and blockers.
  • Communicate and present the project progress effectively to stakeholders at all levels, including management
  • Create lessons learned and ensure implementation.
  • Ability to work flexible hours to accommodate a global workforce.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in payment processing technology.

Requirements

  • Excellent communication skills and customer focus.
  • 2-3 years’ experience in a client-facing project management role, experience within the financial services industry.
  • Experience within the Payments industry, either PSP/Acquirer an advantage.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with Project Management tools (like MS Project, Smartsheet, Monday, Jira or similar)
  • Experience managing multiple deliveries simultaneously.
  • Self-motivated, independent, pro-active and team player.
  • Problem solving, investigative and multi-tasking skills with highest attention to detail.
  • Innovative, energetic, and enthusiastic.
  • Ability to adapt to a regularly changing environment.
  • Ability to work well under pressure.
  • Proactive and can-do attitude, with the ability to take ownership of projects and drive them to completion.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver results on time.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Continuous learning mindset to stay updated on emerging technologies and best practices.
  • A desire to progress and develop yourself personally and professionally.
  • Excellent written and verbal English

Benefits

Employees in Bulgaria enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Competitive holiday allowance
  • Health insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Sport membership card
  • eVouchers

Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can’t wait to meet you.

English (written and spoken) is the language used most of the time, as work colleagues, clients, and strategic suppliers are geographically dispersed.

Our recruitment process may use automated tools, including AI, to support application management and candidate shortlisting.

The annual salary range for this role is EUR €35,000-€42,341 (Gross). This range represents the expected starting salary for candidates hired into this role in the specified location. If the position is filled in a different location, a different salary range may apply due to objective factors such as local labor market conditions and cost of living.

This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Nuvei and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.
